blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: In psychiatric practice, the clinical intake interview remains a primary diagnostic instrument, requiring the clinician to establish rapport while disentangling complex, overlapping presentations. Here, we show that multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) in simulation environments improves language model performance on structured text-based psychiatric intake, spanning history-taking, differential diagnosis, and initial management planning. In a randomized, double-blind crossover study ($N = 60$ matched scenario pairs, 120 encounters) comparing the RL-trained agent against its identically prompted base model, 32 board-certified psychiatrists role-played standardized patients while a separate panel of 15 independent, board-certified psychiatrists scored the de-identified transcripts. The trained agent outperformed the base model in 76.7% of matched scenario pairs ($p < 0.0001$), with gains on an adapted clinical-examination rubric ($d_z = 0.77$, $p < 0.0001$), patient-centered communication (82.0% vs. 65.2%, $p < 0.001$), and differential diagnosis appropriateness (68.3% vs. 33.3%, $p < 0.001$). Across 127 psychiatrist-validated simulated intake scenarios, the trained agent nearly doubled its base model's clinical rubric score (0.706 vs. 0.379; composite reward 0.564 vs. 0.294, $p < 0.0001$). To systematically probe conversational safety, we established two Delphi-consensus taxonomies, of clinical safety risks and relational competencies, from which 256 challenging adversarial presentations were derived; we find that training in simulation environments more than halved under-triage of acute safety risks (12.9% vs. 30.5%, $p < 0.0001$). Simulation environments thus provide a controlled testbed for training and stress-testing psychiatric conversational agents, with gains that transferred to psychiatrist-enacted encounters, though residual gaps require safeguards and clinician oversight.
blocks.zh: 在精神病学实践中,临床摄取的面谈仍然是初级诊断工具,要求临床医生建立关系,同时解开复杂,重叠的介绍. 在这里,我们表明,模拟环境中的多回合强化学习(RL)在结构化的基于文本的精神病摄入量,跨越历史记录,差异诊断,以及初步管理规划上,改善了语言模型的性能. 在随机的双盲交叉研究中(一美元=60美元相匹配的情景配对,120次相遇)将RL训练剂与其同样激发的基模进行比较,32名经董事会认证的精神病医生角色扮演标准化患者,而由15名独立,经董事会认证的精神病医生组成的单独小组则得分解识别的笔录. 受过训练的药剂在76.7%的对应假想配对(p < 0.0001美元)中超过了基本模型,在适应性临床检查(d_z=0.77美元,p < 0.0001美元)、以病人为中心的通信(82.0%对65.2%,p < 0.001美元)和诊断适当性(68.3%对33.3%,p < 0.001美元)上都有收益。 在127个心理医生验证的模拟摄入情况中,受过训练的药剂几乎是其基本模型临床分数的两倍(0.706对0.379;复合奖励0.564对0.294,0.0001美元)。 为了系统地探索对话安全,我们建立了两个关于临床安全风险和关系能力的Delphi-consensus分类系统,从中得出256个具有挑战性的对抗性陈述;我们发现,模拟环境的培训将急性安全风险的不足比例减半(12.9%对30.5%,0.0001美元)。 因此,模拟环境为培训和压力测试精神病谈话代理人提供了一个可控的测试床,其收益可转移到精神病患者的接触,尽管剩余差距需要保障措施和临床医生的监督。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Clinical dialogue is foundational to patient-facing medicine, but in psychiatry, the clinical interview itself remains a principal diagnostic instrument 144 . In psychiatric presentations, the psychopathology itself can directly compromise how history is communicated, and patients often do not recognize the relevance of prior treatment failures or comorbid medical conditions causing their symptoms 25 ; 10 ; 39 . As a result, the quality of the history depends on both systematic inquiry into these complex causes and interpersonal trust, with a stronger therapeutic alliance supporting more complete diagnostic formulation and improved treatment outcomes 149 ; 119 ; 180 . Competent clinical dialogue couples two skill domains, diagnostic reasoning (differential diagnosis, psychopharmacology, risk stratification) and interpersonal processing (reading affect and psychological defenses, crisis de-escalation, shared decision-making, stigma-sensitive communication) 92 ; 2 ; 176 . In psychiatry, both dimensions are especially entangled. A clinician who probes aggressively risks rupturing rapport; one who overprioritizes validation may never arrive at a diagnosis. Here we investigate whether language models can acquire these capabilities through training in simulated clinical environments.
blocks.zh: 临床对话是治疗病人的药物的基础,但在精神病学中,临床访谈本身仍然是主要的诊断工具144。 在精神病学的介绍中,精神病学本身可以直接地损害历史的传播方式,患者往往不承认前期治疗失败或导致其症状的病症的相关性 25; 10; 39. 因此,历史的质量既取决于对这些复杂原因的系统调查,也取决于人际信任,一个更强大的治疗联盟支持更完整的诊断制剂并改进治疗结果 149;119;180。 有能力的临床对话夫妇有两个技能领域:诊断推理(不同诊断、精神药物、风险分层)和人际处理(阅读影响和心理辩护、危机缓解、共同决策、对耻辱敏感的交流)92;2;176。 在精神病学中,两个维度特别被缠绕. 积极调查的临床医生冒着破坏关系的风险;对验证进行过分优先的临床医生可能永远不会得到诊断。 在这里,我们调查语言模型是否能够通过模拟临床环境的培训获得这些能力.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of contributions. The proposed framework involves training a language model in a simulated environment and evaluating it with human experts. Left (Training in Simulation), The training process comprises three components: a, Scenario Generation, which synthesizes clinical, behavioral, and demographic data into verified patient scenarios using a language model; b, Simulation, where the model engages in multi-turn interactions with a simulated patient; and c, Reinforcement Learning, which uses an autorater to grade conversation transcripts against a clinical rubric and updates the policy via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Top Right (Evaluating with Standardized Patients), The trained model (trained in simulation) and its base model act as the clinician in randomized, double-blind text conversations with board-certified psychiatrists acting as standardized patients. Separate independent, board-certified psychiatrist evaluators (blinded to whether transcripts came from the trained or base model) and the role-playing clinician-patients score the encounters across multiple dimensions (e.g., perceived empathic behavior, diagnostic formulation, clinical safety, and management plan), as compared across normalized domain scores in the radar chart. Bottom Right (Evaluating in Simulation), Automated evaluation across expert-validated scenarios shows that the simulation-trained agent achieved a higher composite clinical reward than its base model overall and across all four difficulty tiers (overall, 0.56 vs. 0.29; easy, 0.65 vs. 0.34; edge, 0.51 vs. 0.25; all p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ; left chart). Under 256 adversarial stress-testing presentations (right chart), the trained agent reduced measured safety failure rates relative to its base model, including contraindications (0.8% vs. 6.2%, p = 0.001 p=0.001 ), missed red flags (6.2% vs. 10.9%, p = 0.04 p=0.04 ), and clinical under-triage (12.9% vs. 30.5%, p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ).
blocks.zh: 图1:捐款概况。 拟议框架涉及在模拟环境中培训一种语言模型,并与人类专家一道加以评价。 左 (模拟训练), 培训过程包括三个部分:a, " 情景生成 " ,利用语言模型将临床、行为和人口数据综合到经核实的病人情景中;b, " 模拟 " ,即模型与模拟病人进行多回合互动;c, " 强化学习 " ,即利用自动解析器对临床语气进行谈话记录,并通过群体相对政策优化(GPRO)更新政策。 右上(与标准化患者一起评估), 训练有素的模型(在模拟中受过训练)及其基础模型在随机,双盲的文字对话中扮演临床医生的角色,与被董事会认证的精神病医生作为标准化的病人. 与雷达图中正常域分相比,独立、经董事会认证的心理医生评估员(不清楚记录来自训练有素的模型还是基准模型)和角色扮演的临床医生-病人在多个层面(例如,感知到的情感行为、诊断制剂、临床安全和管理计划)对遭遇进行评分。 右下方(模拟评估),跨专家验证假想的自动评价显示,模拟训练剂在临床上的回报率高于其基本模型的整体和所有四个困难层次(总体,0.56对0.29;简单,0.65对0.34;边缘,0.51对0.25;所有p < 0.0001 p < 0.0001;左图)。 在256个对抗性应激测试演示(右图)下,受过训练的药剂相对于其基本模型降低了测量的安全故障率,包括反差(0.8%对6.2%,p=0.001p=0.001),漏取了红旗(6.2%对10.9%,p=0.04p=0.04)和临床不足(12.9%对30.5%,p < 0.0001p < 0.0001)。

blocks.en: Large language models now perform strongly on clinical question-answering 162 ; 163 , clinical reasoning 127 ; 14 ; 109 ; 81 , and conversational diagnosis 176 ; 15 ; 99 , and a growing body of work applies them to mental health 31 ; 166 ; 134 ; 47 , including psychiatric evaluation datasets 128 ; 104 ; 35 , clinician-facing decision support 183 , and patient-facing conversational systems. Evaluations of conversational medical AI have nonetheless largely excluded psychiatric presentations 176 ; 15 ; 99 ; 75 . In the general medical settings those systems target, the conversation gathers a history that physical examination and laboratory testing can subsequently supplement; in psychiatry, where critical history and risk factors often emerge through skilled inquiry, the quality of the conversation itself determines the quality of the diagnostic information obtained 144 ; 55 ; 161 . If eventually validated for clinical use, conversational intake systems may supplement static screening questionnaires in supervised pre-visit workflows by gathering preliminary history, conducting a medical review of systems (i.e., a structured inventory of physical symptoms across organ systems to screen for somatic causes) and medication reconciliation, and organizing a provisional differential diagnosis for the evaluating clinician to review and verify 75 ; 131 .
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型现在在临床回答162;163;临床推理127;14;109;81;和谈话诊断176;15;99,越来越多的工作将其应用于心理健康 31;166;134;47,包括心理评估数据集128;104;35,临床分析决定支持183;病人对话系统。 然而,对谈话医学的AI的评价基本上排除了精神病治疗176;15;99;75。 在这些系统所针对的一般医疗环境中,对话收集了身体检查和实验室测试可以随后补充的历史;在精神病学中,关键历史和风险因素往往通过熟练的询问而出现,对话的质量本身决定了获得的诊断信息的质量 144; 55; 161。 如果最终被验证为临床用药,对话摄取系统可以通过收集初步病史,对系统进行医学审查(即对器官系统的身体症状进行结构化清点,以检查身体原因)和药物调节,以及组织评估临床医生进行临时差别诊断,以审查和核实75; 131.

blocks.en: In medical education, clinical competence is developed through structured practice with standardized patients and assessed through Objective Structured Clinical Examinations (OSCEs) 7 ; 61 ; 68 . Psychiatry uses the same instrument to rehearse de-escalation, risk stratification, and rapport building under acute ambiguity 137 ; 67 . Language models can likewise acquire conversational and sequential decision-making capabilities by interacting with simulated clinical environments, with reported generalization to unseen patient profiles, out-of-distribution diagnostic categories, and multi-turn dialogue settings 100 ; 32 ; 41 ; 88 ; 176 , and generative patient simulators increasingly incorporate behavioral phenotypes, biases, and changing emotional states 152 ; 151 ; 86 . Whether these approaches are sufficient to improve conversational psychiatric competence remains untested.
blocks.zh: 在医学教育中,临床能力是通过与标准化病人的有条理的做法发展出来的,并通过客观结构临床检查(欧安组织)7、61、68进行评估。 精神科使用同一种仪器来排练降级,风险分层,和关系建筑在极端模糊的137; 67. 语言模型同样可以通过与模拟临床环境的相互作用,获得对话和相继的决策能力,据报告,这些环境将一般化为看不见的病人特征、分配外的诊断类别和多回合对话设置100;32;41;88;176;基因病人模拟器越来越多地包含行为酚类、偏见和不断变化的情绪状态152;151;86。 这些方法是否足以提高对话的心理能力,仍然没有经过测试。

blocks.en: Here, we trained a large language model with multi-turn reinforcement learning across simulated psychiatric encounters, optimizing jointly for diagnostic accuracy, patient-centered communication, and clinical safety (Fig. 1 ). To isolate the effect of training, the simulation-trained agent and its base model were prompted and evaluated identically within each evaluation, sharing the same clinical system prompt and structured tools. We validated the resulting agent in three complementary evaluations: 1. Blinded human expert evaluation (Section 2.1 ): To test whether competencies acquired in silico transfer to encounters with human experts, we conducted a randomized, double-blind crossover evaluation ( N = 60 N{=}60 matched scenario pairs, 120 text-based consultations) in which the agent occupied the clinician role, 32 board-certified psychiatrists role-played the patients, and a separate panel of 15 blinded, independent, board-certified psychiatrists scored de-identified transcripts. The trained agent received a higher score than the identically prompted base model in 76.7% of matched scenario pairs ( p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ), with gains over the base model on an adapted Practical Assessment of Clinical Examination Skills (PACES) clinical-examination rubric 40 ( d z = 0.77 d_{z}=0.77 , p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ), patient-centered communication 108 ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), differential diagnosis appropriateness ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), and management plan appropriateness ( p = 0.018 p=0.018 ). 2. Automated psychiatric intake evaluation suite (Section 2.2 ): To support automated multi-turn evaluation of psychiatric interviewing, we curated 127 psychiatrist-validated clinical intake scenarios ( AC1 = 0.93 \text{AC1}=0.93 ) covering eight diagnostic domains and four difficulty tiers that gate diagnostically critical information behind rapport and clinical inquiry. Across these scenarios, as graded by a language-model autorater (Gemini 3.1 Pro), the trained agent nearly doubled its base model’s clinical rubric score (0.706 vs. 0.379; composite reward 0.564 vs. 0.294, p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ), with substantial gains across all four difficulty tiers, an overall advantage preserved under an independent out-of-family judge model (OpenAI GPT-5.6-Luna, p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ). 3. Adversarial stress-testing grounded in Delphi-consensus safety taxonomies (Section 2.3 ): To systematically probe conversational safety, two multidisciplinary Delphi panels established consensus taxonomies of clinical safety risks (6 domains, 21 risks) and relational competencies (5 domains, 18 competencies), from which we derived 256 adversarial patient presentations designed to elicit unsafe clinical behavior. Training more than halved under-triage of acute safety risks relative to the base model (12.9% vs. 30.5%, p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ), though residual failures remained.
blocks.zh: 在这里,我们训练了一个大型语言模型,在模拟的精神病治疗中进行多回合强化学习,共同优化诊断准确性、以病人为中心的交流和临床安全(图1)。 为了孤立培训的效果,每次评价都鼓励和评价经过模拟训练的药剂及其基本模型,分享同样的临床系统迅速和结构化的工具。 我们在三项补充评价中验证了其结果: 1. 盲目的人类专家评估(第2.1节): 为了检验在硅化物转移过程中获得的能力是否与人类专家相遇,我们进行了随机的双盲交叉评价(N = 60 N{=}60匹配情景配对,120个以文字为基础的诊疗),特工占据了临床医生的角色,32名经董事会认证的精神病医生扮演了病人的角色,另外还有由15名失明,独立,经董事会认证的精神病医生组成的一个小组打出了去识别的笔录. 在76.7%的对应情景对(p < 0.0001 p < 0.0001)中,受过训练的药剂得到的分数高于同样诱导的基准型号,比调整后的临床检查技能实际评估基准型号40(dz=0.77 d_{z_{0.77,p < 0.0001 p < 0.0001),以病人为中心的通信108(p < 0.001 p < 0.001),差分诊断适当性(p < 0.001 p < 0.001),以及管理计划适当性(p=0.018 p=0.018)。 2. 自动精神病接收评估套件(第2.2节): 为了支持对精神病患者面谈进行自动的多回合评价,我们研究了127个精神病患者经鉴定的临床摄入情况(AC1 = 0.93\text{AC1}=0.93),涵盖8个诊断领域和4个困难层次,这些困难层次将诊断性的关键信息置于关系和临床调查背后。 在整个这些情景中,经培训的代理人通过一个语言模型自动鉴定人(Gemini 3.1 Pro)分级,几乎是其基准模型临床分数的两倍(0.706对0.379;复合奖励0.564对0.294,p < 0.0001 p < 0.0001),在所有四个困难等级中都取得了巨大收益,在独立的家庭外法官模式下保持了总体优势(OpenAI GPT-5.6-Luna,p < 0.0001 p < 0.0001)。 3. 在Delphi-consensus安全分类法中进行负面压力测试(第2.3节): 为了系统地探索对话安全,两个多学科的德尔菲小组确定了临床安全风险(6个领域,21个风险)和关系能力(5个领域,18个能力)的共识分类,我们从这些分类中得出了256个针对病人的介绍,旨在引起不安全的临床行为。 相对于基准型号,培训的急性安全风险小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小

blocks.zh: 以Delphi-consensus安全分类法为基础的负面压力测试(第2.3节): 为了系统地探索对话安全,两个多学科的德尔菲小组确定了临床安全风险(6个领域,21个风险)和关系能力(5个领域,18个能力)的共识分类,我们从这些分类中得出了256个针对病人的介绍,旨在引起不安全的临床行为。 相对于基准型号,培训的急性安全风险小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小于小

blocks.en: All evaluations used synchronous English-language text consultations with standardized or simulated patients grounded in US psychiatric practice guidelines, demonstrating interviewing and diagnostic competence in controlled settings rather than outcomes, safety, or efficacy in real care, where any clinical use would require direct clinician oversight instead of autonomous operation.
blocks.zh: 所有评价都采用了与基于美国精神病实践指南的标准化或模拟患者同步的英语文本咨询,展示在受控制环境中的面谈和诊断能力,而不是结果、安全或实际护理的疗效,因为任何临床使用都需要临床医生的直接监督而不是自主操作。

blocks.en: 2 Results
blocks.zh: 2 结果

blocks.en: We report three findings. First, in a randomized, double-blind OSCE with psychiatrists role-playing patients, the simulation-trained agent outperformed its identically prompted base model, with gains in clinical examination skills, patient-centered communication, differential diagnosis formulation, and initial management planning (Section 2.1 ). Second, under automated evaluation the same advantage held across 127 expert-validated intake scenarios, and a three-way comparison on the 60 OSCE scenarios located where simulated evaluation departs from the human study (Section 2.2 ). Third, under adversarial presentations, training reduced but did not eliminate unsafe behavior, and the residual failures were mainly under-triage and missed red flags, including errors of omission that post-hoc output filters cannot intercept because no overtly harmful text is generated, such as failing to ask the probing questions needed to uncover a concealed crisis or failing to escalate care (Section 2.3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们报告三项调查结果。 首先,在随机、双盲的欧安组织中,与精神科医生角色扮演病人一起,模拟训练的药剂的性能超过了其同样激发的基本模型,在临床检查技能、以病人为中心的沟通、差别诊断制剂和初步管理规划方面都有了进步(第2.1节)。 第二,在自动评价中,127种经专家鉴定的摄入情况具有同样的优势,对模拟评价偏离人类研究的欧安组织60种情况进行了三相比较(第2.2节)。 第三,在对抗性陈述中,培训减少但没有消除不安全的行为,其余的失败主要是不足和错过了红旗,包括漏出错误,即由于未产生明显有害的文字,后热输出过滤器无法截取,例如没有提出发现隐性危机所需的测试问题,或未能提升护理(第2.3节)。

blocks.en: 2.1 Simulation-trained agent improves upon base model in blinded human evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.1 模拟训练剂在盲目的人类评价中改进基本模式

blocks.en: To test whether clinical competencies acquired in simulation transfer to human encounters, we compared the simulation-trained agent against its base model (Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite 51 ) in a randomized, double-blind crossover OSCE ( N = 60 N{=}60 matched scenario pairs, 120 synchronous English-language text consultations; Fig. 2 a) covering mood, anxiety, psychotic, personality, and substance use disorders, occult somatic mimics, and acute crises. Both models operated under the exact same detailed clinical system prompt instructing structured history-taking, rapport-building, safety screening, and differential formulation, alongside identical tools and prompts, isolating the effect of multi-turn reinforcement learning in simulation from prompt engineering (Methods, Section 4.5 ).
blocks.zh: 为了测试在模拟转移到人类相遇时获得的临床能力,我们将模拟训练的剂与其基础模型(Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite 51 )在随机的双盲交叉式欧安组织(N=60 N{=}60匹配情景配对,120同步英语文本咨询;图2a)相提并论,涵盖情绪,焦虑,心理,个性,以及药物使用失调,神秘的声波模仿和急性危机等. 这两种模型在完全相同的详细临床系统下运行,即时指示结构化的历史记录、关系构建、安全筛选和有差别的配方,以及相同的工具和提示,将模拟中多回合强化学习的效果同即时工程隔离开来(Methods, 第4.5节)。

blocks.en:
In each pair, one of 32 board-certified psychiatrists (Supplementary Table 5 ; Appendix A.1 ) enacted the same standardized patient across separate consultations with both models. Psychiatrists served as patient actors in this preliminary study to avoid exposing real patients to an unvalidated system and to adjudicate each scenario’s clinical information-gating protocol in real time, judging turn by turn whether the agent established rapport, navigated alliance ruptures, and conducted targeted inquiry before disclosing diagnostically critical facts (such as prior treatment responses, underlying medical symptoms, or guarded risk factors), prior to the agent submitting a ranked differential diagnosis and structured management plan at consultation end. Encounters were evaluated from two complementary clinical perspectives using a battery adapted from prior clinical OSCE benchmarks 176 to capture distinct levels of interaction (Appendix A.4 ): immediately after each chat, the role-playing clinician-patient rated discrete communication behaviors via the 11-item binary Patient-Centered Communication Best Practice (PCCBP) checklist 108 , global consultation satisfaction via the General Medical Council Patient Questionnaire (GMCPQ) 17 , core empathy and welfare via four patient-facing PACES items 40 , and longitudinal psychotherapeutic goal, task, and bond alignment via the Working Alliance Inventory Short Revised (WAI-SR) 62 ; independently, a separate panel of 15 blinded, board-certified psychiatrists (Appendix A.2 ) graded the de-identified transcripts and clinical outputs against the corresponding 18-item specialist PACES clinical-skills rubric 40 , four differential diagnosis scales, and management appropriateness criteria.
Encounters had no turn limit; the simulation-trained agent took a median of 60 clinician turns (maximum 165) and the base model 8 (maximum 17; Supplementary Fig. 1 a).
blocks.zh:
在每对医生中,32名经董事会认证的精神病医生中有1名(补充表5;附录A.1)在与两个模型的单独诊疗中颁布了同一标准化病人。 精神病学家在这项初步研究中充当了病人的行为者,以避免使真正的病人暴露在未经验证的系统之下,并实时裁定每种情况的临床信息分享程序,然后依次判断代理人是否建立了关系、导航联盟破裂,并进行有针对性的调查,然后才披露诊断性的关键事实(如事先的治疗反应、潜在的医疗症状或谨慎的风险因素),然后在咨询结束时提交排名不同的诊断和结构化的管理计划。 从两个互补的临床角度对会议进行了评价,利用了从欧安组织先前临床基准176 改编的电池来捕捉不同层次的相互作用(附录A.4):在每次聊天后立即通过11项二进制患者-以患者为中心的交流最佳做法清单108,角色扮演临床医生-病人的离散通信行为评级;通过一般医疗理事会病人问卷17,全球咨询满意度;通过四个病人的PACES项目40,核心同情与福利;通过工作联盟清单修订(WAI-SR)62,纵向心理治疗目标、任务和结合;独立地由一个15名盲目、董事会认证的精神病医生组成的单独小组(附录A.2),对照相应的18项专家的PACES临床技能问卷40,四个差别诊断尺度以及管理适当性标准,对去识别的笔录和临床产出进行了评级。
相遇没有转弯限制;模拟训练的剂取了60个临床医生转弯(最大165个)和基模8(最大17个;补充图1a)。

blocks.en: The simulation-trained agent received a higher aggregate independent transcript rating than the base model in 76.7% of matched scenario pairs (46 of 60, 95% CI [64.0%, 86.6%], p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 , two-sided exact sign test; Fig. 2 b). The same ratings favored the trained agent over the base model in 80.7% of decisive (non-tied) pairs for PACES clinical skill (46 of 57, p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ), 77.8% for diagnostic reasoning and differential formulation (42 of 54, p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ), and 64.3% for PACES management and behavioral-enablement sub-dimensions (Items 12 and 17: 36 of 56, p = 0.044 p=0.044 ; Appendix A.5 ; the standalone overall management appropriateness item also reached significance, p = 0.018 p=0.018 , below).
blocks.zh: 在76.7%的匹配情景配对中(46对60分95%CI [64.0%,86.6%],p < 0.0001 p < 0.0001,双侧精确标志测试;图2b),模拟训练过的代理获得了高于基准模型的综合独立记录誊本评级. 同样的评级有利于受过训练的药剂在PACES临床技能(57分46分,p < 0.0001 p < 0.0001),诊断推理和分化配方(54分42分,p < 0.0001 p < 0.0001),以及64.3%的PACES管理和行为适应分化(项目12和17:56分36分36分,p=0.044 p=0.044;附录A.5;独立的整体管理适当性项目也具有意义,p=0.018 p=0.018,下)。

blocks.en: The simulation-trained agent scored higher than the base model on the adapted 18-item PACES clinical-skills rubric (3.04 vs. 2.32 out of 5.0, shifting mean performance from the Unfavorable [ 2.0 2.0 ] range above the Satisfactory [ 3.0 3.0 ] scale anchor while remaining below Favorable [ 4.0 4.0 ]; mean paired difference + 0.73 +0.73 from unrounded scores, 95% CI [ + 0.49 +0.49 , + 0.96 +0.96 ]; d z = 0.77 d_{z}=0.77 , p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 , Wilcoxon signed-rank test; Fig. 2 c). Immediate post-encounter ratings from the live clinician-patients on the four patient-facing PACES items were concordant in direction and magnitude (3.18 vs. 2.63, d z = 0.45 d_{z}=0.45 , p = 0.0017 p=0.0017 ).
blocks.zh: 模拟训练剂在经过调整的18个项目PACES临床技能分数上得分高于基准模型(5.0分中3.04分对2.32分),从超过[3.0 2.0分]比例锚地的不合格范围改变平均性能,但仍低于可喜程度[4.0 4.0分];在未四舍五入的分数中,平均成对差+0.73分+0.73分;在95%CI[+0.49分+0.49分,+0.96分+0.96分];dz=0.77分=0.77分=0.7分=0.77分;p < 0.0001分 <0.0001分=0.0001分;Wilcoxon签名作恶作试验;F. 2 c)。 临床医生-病人现场对4个病人的PACES项目立即进行场后评分,其方向和规模一致(3.18对2.63,dz=0.45 d_{z_{0.45,p=0.0017 p=0.0017)。

blocks.en: As rated by independent evaluators, the simulation-trained agent scored higher than the base model on all 18 PACES clinical-skills sub-dimensions (Fig. 2 c; item definitions in Supplementary Table 1 ), reaching nominal statistical significance on 17 (all except fostering the relationship, + 0.20 +0.20 , d z = 0.12 d_{z}=0.12 , p = 0.38 p=0.38 ). The largest gains concentrated in foundational history-taking, including past medical history ( + 1.21 +1.21 , d z = 0.87 d_{z}=0.87 , p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ), review of systems ( + 1.10 +1.10 , d z = 0.86 d_{z}=0.86 , p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ), presenting complaint characterization ( + 0.82 +0.82 , d z = 0.62 d_{z}=0.62 , p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ), medication history reconciliation ( + 0.81 +0.81 , d z = 0.53 d_{z}=0.53 , p = 0.0006 p=0.0006 ), and family history ( + 0.64 +0.64 , d z = 0.51 d_{z}=0.51 , p = 0.0019 p=0.0019 ). Information gathering ( + 0.81 +0.81 , d z = 0.72 d_{z}=0.72 , p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ) and differential diagnosis construction ( + 0.95 +0.95 , d z = 0.60 d_{z}=0.60 , p = 0.0009 p=0.0009 ) also improved substantially, alongside gains across all explanation quality, shared decision-making, management selection, and emotional responsiveness sub-dimensions ( d z = 0.32 d_{z}=0.32 – 0.53 0.53 , all p ≤ 0.028 p\leq 0.028 ).

blocks.en: The simulation-trained agent produced better-rated diagnostic formulations than the base model on all four dimensions assessed by independent psychiatrists (Fig. 2 d; item definitions in Supplementary Table 2 ), including differential appropriateness (3.73 vs. 2.82), differential comprehensiveness (2.80 vs. 1.88; 1–4 scale, n = 59 n{=}59 complete pairs), inclusion of the probable diagnosis (3.93 vs. 3.13), and identification of plausible alternative causes (3.83 vs. 3.05; 1–5 scale; d z = 0.36 d_{z}=0.36 – 0.71 0.71 , all p ≤ 0.0074 p\leq 0.0074 ). Dichotomizing each dimension at a favorable rating ( ≥ 4 \geq 4 on 5-point scales; ≥ 3 \geq 3 on the 4-point comprehensiveness scale) preserved this advantage across all four dimensions (appropriateness: 68.3% vs. 33.3%, h = 0.72 h=0.72 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ; comprehensiveness: 67.8% vs. 32.2%, h = 0.73 h=0.73 ; probable diagnosis: 68.3% vs. 40.0%, h = 0.58 h=0.58 ; alternative diagnoses: 63.3% vs. 40.0%, h = 0.47 h=0.47 ). Averaged across the four dimensions, clinical reasoning scores were higher for the trained agent than for the base model (3.57 vs. 2.73, d z = 0.55 d_{z}=0.55 , p = 0.00014 p=0.00014 ). Evaluator-rated clinical confabulation (inventing unmentioned clinical details during the consultation or falsely recording in the post-encounter summary that the patient endorsed or denied symptoms never discussed; Item 28 in Supplementary Table 2 ) occurred in 1 of 60 trained-agent encounters (1.7%) versus 5 of 60 for the base model (8.3%; p = 0.22 p=0.22 , McNemar’s exact test). In absolute terms, mean ratings for the trained agent remained below the favorable anchor on all four dimensions (below 4 on the three 5-point scales [3.73–3.93] and below 3 on the 4-point comprehensiveness scale [2.80]).
blocks.zh: 模拟训练过的药剂在独立精神病学家评估的所有四个维度(图2d;补充表2中的项目定义)上都产生了比基准模型更好的诊断配方,包括差别适当性(3.73对2.82)、差别全面性(2.80对1.88;1至4级,n=59n{=}59整对),包括可能的诊断(3.93对3.13),以及查明可能的其他原因(3.83对3.05;1至5分;dz = 0.36 d_{z}=0.36 = 0.71 0.71;全部为 0.0074 p\leq 0.0074)。 将每个维度按有利的评级进行分化(在5分尺度上为4分;在4分综合尺度上为3分;在4分综合尺度上为3分);在所有四个维度上保持这一优势(适当性:68.3%对33.3%,h=0.72 h=0.72;p <0.001 p<0.001;全面性:67.8%对32.2%,h=0.73 h=0.73;可能诊断:68.3%对40.0%,h=0.58 h=0.58;替代诊断:63.3%对40.0%,h=0.47 h=0.47)。 跨越四个维度的平均临床推理分数高于基准数(3.57 vs 2.73,dz=0.55 d_{z}=0.55,p=0.00014 p=0.8014)。 评估员临床诊断表(在咨询期间未提及临床细节;在60分量试验模型中被证实或有错误记录) 按绝对值计算,受过训练的代理人在所有四个方面(三个5分级[3.73-3.93]低于4分,全面性4分级[2.80]低于3分)的平均评级仍然低于有利的主锚。

blocks.en: Clinician-patients recorded higher adherence for the simulation-trained agent than for the base model across the 11-item patient-centered communication checklist (PCCBP 108 ) completed immediately after each encounter (82.0% vs. 65.2%, d z = 0.49 d_{z}=0.49 , p = 0.00054 p=0.00054 ; Fig. 2 g; item definitions in Supplementary Table 3 ), with directionally higher adherence across all 11 items across encounters (and 10 of 11 on complete non-N/A pairs). The largest gains concentrated in relational competencies, including partnership building (68.8% vs. 35.4%, p = 0.0017 p=0.0017 ), encouraging patient participation (86.8% vs. 54.7%, p = 0.0002 p=0.0002 ), expressing care and commitment (84.9% vs. 56.6%, p = 0.0011 p=0.0011 ), building rapport (76.4% vs. 56.4%, p = 0.022 p=0.022 ), and greeting the patient appropriately (100.0% vs. 85.7%, p = 0.0082 p=0.0082 ; McNemar’s tests). Differences on the remaining six items, where baseline adherence was already high or the item rarely applied in a single intake (such as using appropriate language, appearing open and honest, acknowledging mistakes, or discussing roles and privacy), did not reach significance ( p ≥ 0.059 p\geq 0.059 ).
blocks.zh: 临床医生-病人在每次接触后立即填写的以病人为中心的11项通信清单(PCCBP 108)的基本模型中,模拟训练剂的坚持率高于基准模型(82.0%对65.2%,dz=0.49 d_{z_{0.49,p=0.00054 p=0.00054;图2克;补充表3中的项定义),所有11项的坚持率都高于基准模型(11项中10项完全非N/A对)。 最大的收益集中在相关能力,包括伙伴关系建设(68.8%对35.4%,p=0.007:p=0.0017),鼓励患者参与(86.8%对54.7%,p=0.0002:p=0.0002),表达关爱和承诺(84.9%对56.6%,p=0.001:p=0.0011),建设关系(76.4%对56.4%,p=0.022:p=0.022),适当迎接患者(100.0%对85.7%,p=0.0082:0082;麦克内马尔的检测)。 在其余六个项目上,基准遵守率已经很高,或者很少将该项目用于单一的条目(例如使用适当的语言,看起来公开而诚实,承认错误,或讨论角色和隐私),这些方面的分歧没有意义(第0.059页,p\ geq 0.059)。

blocks.en: The same battery included four patient-facing PACES communication items, on all of which the trained agent scored higher than the base model: perceived empathy (3.39 vs. 2.89), confirming patient understanding (2.69 vs. 2.08), maintaining patient welfare (3.60 vs. 3.02), and detecting and addressing patient concerns (2.91 vs. 2.40; all p < 0.02 p<0.02 , d z = 0.35 d_{z}=0.35 – 0.46 0.46 ). On the General Medical Council Patient Questionnaire (GMCPQ; 9 Likert communication items in Supplementary Table 3 ), scores were directionally higher for the trained agent without reaching significance (3.01 vs. 2.79, d z = 0.19 d_{z}=0.19 , p = 0.091 p=0.091 ; Fig. 2 f). Clinician-patients marked the Working Alliance Inventory Short Revised (WAI-SR) 62 as entirely not applicable in 41.7% (50 of 120) of encounters, reflecting that its longitudinal psychotherapy items (such as agreeing on ongoing therapy tasks and goals) often do not apply to a single diagnostic intake. Among the 21 pairs with evaluable data, WAI-SR scores did not differ significantly between conditions (2.45 vs. 2.48, p = 0.75 p=0.75 ), and we treat this comparison as inconclusive (Appendix A.3 ).
blocks.zh: 同样的电池包括4个与病人相适应的PACES通信项目,所有项目都比基准模型高:感觉同情(3.39对2.89),确认病人的理解(2.69对2.08),维持病人的福利(3.60对3.02),检测和解决病人所关心的问题(2.91对2.40;全部p < 0.02 p < 0.02, dz=0.35 d_{z}=0.35 – 0.46 0.46;关于一般医疗理事会病人调查表(GMCPQ;补充表3中的9个类似通信项目),对受过训练的病人的分数方向较高(3.01对2.79, dzz=0.19 d_{z}=0.19;p=0.091 p=0.091;Fig.2f)。 临床医生-病人将工作联盟的《修订短清单》(WAI-SR)62标记为完全不适用于41.7%(120人中的50人)的遭遇,这反映出其纵向心理治疗项目(如商定正在进行的治疗任务和目标)往往不适用于单一的诊断摄入量。 在有可评价数据的21对中,WAI-SR的分数在条件(2.45对2.48,p=0.75p=0.75)之间没有显著差别,我们把这种比较视为没有定论(附录A.3.).

blocks.en: The simulation-trained agent recommended comprehensive and appropriate treatments (46.7% vs. 26.7%, p = 0.023 p=0.023 , McNemar’s test; Fig. 2 e) and diagnostic investigations (50.0% vs. 28.3%, p = 0.020 p=0.020 ) significantly more often than the base model, and achieved higher overall management plan appropriateness (3.67 vs. 3.18, d z = 0.31 d_{z}=0.31 , p = 0.018 p=0.018 , Wilcoxon signed-rank test; Item 27 in Supplementary Table 2 ), concordant with gains on the PACES sub-dimensions for selecting an appropriate management plan (3.23 vs. 2.62, d z = 0.34 d_{z}=0.34 , p = 0.018 p=0.018 ) and enabling treatment-related behavior (2.69 vs. 2.20, d z = 0.38 d_{z}=0.38 , p = 0.028 p=0.028 ). Both models avoided inappropriate treatments (88.3% vs. 80.0%, p = 0.20 p=0.20 ) and inappropriate investigations (83.3% vs. 83.3%, p = 1.00 p=1.00 ) in most encounters, though management remained more challenging than history elicitation or diagnostic formulation, with less than comprehensive treatment recommended in 53.3% of trained-agent encounters and an inappropriate treatment recommended in 11.7% (versus 20.0% for the base model).
blocks.zh: 模拟训练剂建议比基准模型多得多地进行综合和适当的治疗(46.7%对26.7%,p=0.023p=0.023;McNemar试验;图2 e)和诊断调查(50.0%对28.3%,p=0.020p=0.020),并取得了较高的总体管理计划适当性(3.67对3.18,dz=0.31 d_{z-0.31;p=0.018;Wilcoxon签名作恶性试验;补充表2中项目27,与PACES子底片上的收益一致,用于选择适当的管理计划(3.23对2.62;dz=0.34 d_{z}=0.34;p=0.018),并促成与治疗有关的行为(2.69vs 2.20;dz=0.38 d_{z}=0.38;p=0.028;p=0.028;在试验中避免了8.30-%;在试验中,在试验中,在试验中试验中,在试验中,在试验中,试验中,试验中,试验中试验中,试验中,试验中,试验中,试验中试验中,试验中,试验中试验中

blocks.en: 2.2 Training gains hold across domains and difficulty tiers in automated evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.2 培训成果在自动化评价中跨越领域和困难层次

blocks.en:
To evaluate interactive interviewing across a broader diagnostic spectrum, we assessed the models across 127 simulated psychiatric intake scenarios independently validated by 54 board-certified psychiatrists (inter-rater agreement Gwet’s AC1 = 0.93 \text{AC1}=0.93 ; Fig. 3 a; Methods, Section 4.6 ; Supplementary Table 4 ). Covering eight clinical domains across four difficulty tiers ( Easy , Medium , Hard , and Edge ), each scenario pairs the candidate model with a dynamic patient simulator that updates patient mood and communicative reliability in response to clinician empathy and inquiry, gating diagnostically critical facts behind rapport and targeted probing (Methods, Section 4.2 ). At consultation end, an automated evaluator (Gemini 3.1 Pro) grades the full trajectory and submitted clinical outputs against a 28-item clinical rubric ( R clinical ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] R_{\text{clinical}}\in[0,1] ) spanning five categories (diagnostic appropriateness, psychiatric management, alliance and communication, psychiatric assessment, and documentation quality; Supplementary Table 7 ), combined with safety and completeness penalties to yield a normalized composite clinical reward (Methods, Section 4.3 ; Appendix C.2 ).
To test how substituting the patient actor and rater affects measured gains, we compared all three settings across the 60 shared OSCE scenarios (Fig. 3 c–f; Methods, Section 4.7 ).
blocks.zh:
为了评估更广泛的诊断范围的互动性面谈,我们评估了由54名经董事会认证的精神科医生独立验证的127个模拟精神病患者的模型(判决间协议Gwet的AC1=0.93\text{AC1\\0.93;图3a;方法,第4.6节;补充表4)。 涵盖8个临床领域,涉及4个困难层次(易、中、难、边),每种情景都将候选模型与动态病人模拟器相配,该模拟器可响应临床医生的同情和询问,更新病人的情绪和沟通可靠性,将诊断性的关键事实归结为关系和有针对性的检测(方法,第4.2节)。 在磋商结束时,一名自动化评价员(Gemini 3.1 Pro)对照28项临床科目(R临床分数[0, 1] R_{\text{临床分数[0,1])对全轨进行评定并提交临床结果,该分数包括五类(诊断适当性、精神管理、结盟和交流、精神评估和文献质量;补充表7),再加上安全和完整性处罚,以获得正规的综合临床奖励(方法,第4.3节;附录C.2)。
为了检验病人角色和评分器的替代如何影响所计量的收益,我们比较了欧安组织60个共同方案的所有三种设置(图3c-f;方法,第4.7节)。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Performance in expert-validated simulated psychiatric intake scenarios, and decomposition of rater and patient effects on the OSCE subset. a, Board-certified psychiatrists ( N = 54 N{=}54 ; Supplementary Table 4 ) reviewed, revised, and validated every scenario in the evaluation cohort (127 scenarios), grading each against an eight-point quality rubric. b, Per-domain scores across the five clinical categories evaluated, comparing the simulation-trained agent against its base model (Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite; all p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 except documentation quality, p = 0.018 p=0.018 ). Training approximately doubled scores in management (0.678 vs. 0.377), diagnostic appropriateness (0.682 vs. 0.369), and psychiatric assessment (0.673 vs. 0.323), with the largest gain in alliance and communication (0.827 vs. 0.321). Documentation quality showed modest improvement (0.689 vs. 0.647). c–f, Three-way comparison on the 60 OSCE scenarios, a stratified subset of the 127 in b (Methods, Section 4.7 ), crossing rater (human rater: evaluating psychiatrist, 22-item composite; AI rater: autorater pre-penalty clinical score) and patient (human patient: clinician-patient; AI patient: patient simulator, 4 rollouts per scenario and model, means in d, e , single rollouts in f ). c, Human- vs. AI-rater score on the same transcripts. d, AI-rater score with the AI vs. human patient (dashed line, equal score). e, Spearman ρ \rho with the human study within each model and on scenario-level differences ( Δ \Delta , trained minus base). f, Paired d z d_{z} overall and by category against the nearest human instrument (Supplementary Tables 9 and 10 ; error bars in e, f , 95% bootstrap CIs).
blocks.zh: 图3:经专家鉴定的模拟精神病摄入情况的表现,以及率和病人对欧安组织子集的影响的分解。 a 董事会核证的精神病医生(N = 54 N{=}54;补充表4)审查、修订和验证了评价组中的每个假设情况(127个假设情况),对照一个8分质量分数对每个假设情况进行分级。 b,被评价的5个临床类别的人均分数,将模拟训练剂与其基准模型进行比较(Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite;除文件质量外,所有p < 0.0001 p < 0.0001,p=0.018 p=0.018)。 在管理(0.678对0.377)、诊断适当性(0.682对0.369)和精神评估(0.673对0.323)方面,培训的分数大约翻了一番,在结盟和交流方面收益最大(0.827对0.321)。 文件质量略有改善(0.689对0.647)。 c-f, (中文(简体) ). 与60个欧安组织假设情况进行三相比较,这是127个分类子集(b分数(方法,第4.7节)),跨度分数(人评分数:评估精神病医生,22项综合;AI评分数:自动判决前临床分数)和病人(人评分:临床医生-病人;AI病人:病人模拟器,每个假设和模型4个分数,在d、e分数和f分数中表示)。 c,同一笔录上的Human-vs. AI-raters得分. d,AI-raters与AI对人病人的分数(dashed line,等分). e, Spearman ^\rho, 在每个模型中进行人类研究, 并研究情景级别差异( \\ Delta, 训练为负基) 。 f, 相对于最近的人体仪器,总体和类别为Paired d z d_{z}(补充表9和10; e, f中错误栏, 95%的靴子夹 CIS)。

blocks.en:
The simulation-trained agent achieved a pre-penalty clinical rubric score of 0.706 vs. 0.379 (+86%) and a normalized composite clinical reward of 0.564 [0.529, 0.599] vs. 0.294 [0.281, 0.308] ( + 0.270 +0.270 on the [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] normalized reward scale, p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ; Fig. 1 , Fig. 3 b, Supplementary Table 6 , Appendix C.2 ). Substantial gains occurred across all four difficulty tiers ( Easy : 0.646 vs. 0.335, + 0.311 +0.311 ; Medium : 0.571 vs. 0.318, + 0.253 +0.253 ; Hard : 0.536 vs. 0.277, + 0.259 +0.259 ; Edge : 0.513 vs. 0.250, + 0.263 +0.263 ), such that the trained agent’s Edge -tier score (0.513) exceeded its base model’s Easy -tier score (0.335). Across the five clinical rubric categories, training approximately doubled scores relative to the base model in management (0.678 vs. 0.377), diagnostic appropriateness (0.682 vs. 0.369), and psychiatric assessment (0.673 vs. 0.323), with the largest gain in alliance and communication (0.827 vs. 0.321) and a smaller gain in documentation quality (0.689 vs. 0.647; Supplementary Table 7 ). Training also reduced the automated hallucination penalty rate (unsupported factual assertions, invented clinical guidelines, or fabricated patient statements) from 46.5% to 3.1% and the critical-question omission rate from 96.9% to 60.6%.
Under an independent out-of-family judge (OpenAI GPT-5.6-Luna), the advantage held in every difficulty tier but was smaller (0.443 [0.415, 0.471] vs. 0.278 [0.268, 0.289] , p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ; difference between models 0.165 vs. 0.270 under Gemini 3.1 Pro; Supplementary Table 8 ).
blocks.zh:
被模拟训练的药剂实现了刑前临床分数0.706分对0.379分(+86%),正常综合临床分数0.564分[0.529分,0.599分]对0.294分[0.281分,0.308分](在[0,1分]上+0.270分[0,1分],规范奖励等级,p < 0.0001分;图1分,图3b分,补充表6分,附录C.2分). 在所有四个困难等级中都取得了显著的成绩(容易:0.646对0.335,+0.311+0.311;中:0.571对0.318,+0.253+0.253;硬:0.536对0.277,+0.259+0.259;边缘:0.513对0.250,+0.263+0.263),因此被训练的代理人的Edge-等级分数(0.513)已超过其基准型的Eight-等级分数(0.335)。 在五个临床分类中,培训的分数比基本模型增加了大约一倍:管理(0.678对0.377)、诊断适当性(0.682对0.369)和精神评估(0.673对0.323),在联盟和沟通方面收益最大(0.827对0.321),文件质量收益较小(0.689对0.647;补充表7)。 培训还将自动幻觉处罚率(无根据的事实陈述、发明的临床指南或伪造的病人陈述)从46.5%降至3.1%,将关键问题遗漏率从96.9%降至60.6%。
在一名独立的家庭外法官(OpenAI GPT-5.6-Luna)的领导下,每个困难层次的优势都较小(0.443 [0.415, 0.471] vs.0.278 [0.268, 02.89], p < 0.0001 p < 0.0001;双子座3.1 Pro下的型号为0.165 vs. 0.270;补充表8).。

blocks.en: Error analysis identified incomplete diagnostic inquiry as the dominant failure mode for both conditions. At least one critical scoring-key topic was left unasked in 96.9% of base-model encounters and 60.6% of trained-agent encounters. Because this indicator triggers whenever any single item on the multi-topic diagnostic checklist is omitted (in contrast to the acute-harm red-flag metric in Section 2.3 ), these rates reflect the exhaustive completeness required across all gated history domains rather than an acute safety error rate. Training substantially reduced but did not eliminate the tendency to end encounters before eliciting all gated clinical information (median of 16 clinician turns [IQR 14–20] per simulated intake versus 9 turns [IQR 6–11] for the base model).
blocks.zh: 错误分析确定不完整的诊断询问是两种情况的主要故障模式。 在96.9%的基建型碰头和60.6%的训练有素的特务碰头中,至少有一个关键分数题被置之不理。 由于这一指标在省略多专题诊断清单中的任何单一项目时都会触发(与第2.3节中的急性伤害红旗度量相反),因此,这些比率反映了所有封闭历史域所需的详尽完整,而不是急性安全误差率。 培训大幅减少,但并没有消除在获取所有封闭临床信息之前结束接触的趋势(基准模型每模拟摄入16个临床医生转接[IQR 14-20]转接9个转接[IQR 6-11]转接)。

blocks.en: We compared three settings across the 60 OSCE scenario pairs: scores from the evaluating psychiatrists grading the human-patient transcripts (Section 2.1 ), the autorater grading the same transcripts, and the autorater grading simulated representations of the encounter using the patient simulator that the agent was trained in (Fig. 3 c–f; Methods, Section 4.7 ; Appendix C.3 ). Across the same transcripts, autorater scores show moderate correlation with the psychiatrists’ 22-item primary specialist composite within simulation-trained ( ρ = 0.58 \rho=0.58 , 95% CI [0.37, 0.73]) and base-model encounters ( ρ = 0.57 \rho=0.57 [0.34, 0.75]) and on per-scenario score differences between the two models ( Δ \Delta ; ρ = 0.40 \rho=0.40 [0.17, 0.59]; Fig. 3 c, e). Across the 60 pairs, the autorater preferred the simulation-trained transcript in 55 and the psychiatrists in 46 (both in 41, autorater only in 14, psychiatrist only in 5, both base in 0; 68.3% raw agreement vs. 72.2% chance agreement under skewed marginals; Cohen’s κ = − 0.14 \kappa=-0.14 ). Both raters favored the trained agent in every clinical category, with a larger standardized effect under the autorater (paired d z = 1.48 d_{z}=1.48 [1.21, 1.86] vs. 0.71 0.71 [0.47, 1.02] on the composite; Fig. 3 f; Supplementary Table 10 ), as d z d_{z} scales each rater’s mean gain by its own within-pair variability.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了欧安组织60个假想对中的3个设置:评估精神病医生对人-病人笔录进行分级的分数(第2.1节),对同一笔录进行自评的分数,对接触进行自评的分数,使用患者模拟器模拟该剂受过训练的分数(图3c-f;方法,第4.7节;附录C.3)。 在同一笔录中,自动评分显示与精神病医生的22项主要专家复合材料在模拟训练(ρ=0.58\rho=0.58, 95%CI [0.37, 0.73])和基模相遇(ρ=0.57\rho=0.57 [0.34, 0.75])以及两种模型的每例评分差异(Δ==Delta;ρ=0.40\rho=0.40 [0.17, 0.59];图3c, e)之间有中度的相关性。 在60对中,自动鉴定人更喜欢55对的模拟训练记录,46对的精神病医生(41对,只有14对,只有5对,都是0;68.3%的原始协议与72.2%的概率协议在被扭曲的边缘之下;Cohen = − 0.14\kappa=-0.14)。 两位评级人都倾向于每种临床类别中受过训练的制剂,在自动制剂下具有更大的标准化效应(paired d z = 1.48 d_{z}= 1.48 [1.21, 1.86] vs. 0.71 0.71 [0.47, 1.02]; 图3 f; 补充表 10),作为dz d_{z}按每个评级人自身内部可变性的平分。

blocks.en: Under the same autorater, replacing the clinician-patients with simulated patients shortened the trained agent’s interviews (median 16 vs. 60 clinician turns; 8 in both settings for the base model on this 60-scenario set; Supplementary Fig. 1 ), raised scores for both models ( + 0.23 +0.23 [0.19, 0.27] trained; + 0.10 +0.10 [0.08, 0.12] base), and enlarged the mean trained–base gain from 0.21 0.21 to 0.34 0.34 (difference + 0.13 +0.13 [0.09, 0.17]; Fig. 3 d). Across scenarios, simulated and clinician-patient scores under the autorater correlated moderately for the base model ( ρ = 0.68 \rho=0.68 [0.50, 0.82]) and for the trained agent ( ρ = 0.43 \rho=0.43 [0.18, 0.62]), and weakly on per-scenario differences Δ \Delta ( ρ = 0.14 \rho=0.14 [ − 0.12 -0.12 , 0.40]; against the psychiatrists’ ratings, ρ = 0.35 \rho=0.35 [0.11, 0.56] within base, 0.21 0.21 [ − 0.04 -0.04 , 0.44] within trained, and 0.09 0.09 [ − 0.17 -0.17 , 0.35] on Δ \Delta ; Fig. 3 d, e; Supplementary Table 9 ). Even so, simulated evaluation reproduced the direction of the training gain overall ( d z = 2.11 d_{z}=2.11 [1.84, 2.52] per rollout) and in every clinical category, with psychiatric assessment the largest effect across all three settings (Fig. 3 f).
blocks.zh: 在同一自动处理器下,用模拟病人取代临床医生-病人缩短了受训代理人的面谈时间(中间16人对60名临床医生转接;在这60-情景集上的基础模型在两种情况下都有8人;补充图1),提高了两种模型的分数(+0.23+0.23 [0.19,0.27] 训练;+0.10+0.10 [0.08,0.12] 基础,并将受训人员的平均基数从0.21 0.21增加到0.34 (差异+0.13+0.13 [0.09,0.17;图3 d)。 在各种情景中,模拟和临床医生-病人在自动计分器下的分数与基数模型(ρ = 0.68\rho= 0.68 [0.50, 0.82])和受过训练的代理人(ρ = 0.43 [0.18, 0.62])的分数有中度关联,在受训练的代理人(ρ = 0.43 [0.18, 0.62])的分数中度相差不大,在受训练的代理人(ρ = 0.14\rho= 0.14 [− 0.12-0.12, 0.40];在精神病医生的分数中值为: 0.35\rho= 0.35 [0.11, 0.56],在受训练的药剂中为 0.21 [− 04-0.04, 0.44],在0.09 [− 0.17-0.17, 0.35];在克特尔塔的分数中为 0. ;在图3 d;在补充表9中。 即便如此,模拟评价也照搬了培训的总体方向(d z = 2.11 d_{z}= 2.11 [1.84, 2.52])和每个临床类别,精神病学评估是所有三种环境的最大影响(图3 f)。

blocks.en: 2.3 Adversarial safety evaluation reveals residual failures
blocks.zh: 2.3 横向安全评价显示存在剩余故障

blocks.en: To evaluate model safety and boundary maintenance under high-risk clinical challenges, we conducted an adversarial evaluation built on two expert-validated taxonomies (Table 1 ), testing clinical reasoning against patients who conceal crises behind benign complaints, fabricate symptom histories, escalate emotionally to circumvent boundaries, or refuse recommended care (Fig. 2 ; Table 2 ).
blocks.zh: 为了在高风险临床挑战下评价模式安全和边界维护,我们进行了基于两个经专家鉴定的分类(表1)的对抗性评价,测试针对隐瞒良性投诉背后的危机、捏造症状历史、情绪升级以规避边界或拒绝推荐护理的病人的临床推理(图2;表2)。

blocks.en: Table 1: Delphi-consensus taxonomies of clinical safety risks and mental health relational competencies. Overview of ( a ) the 21-item clinical safety taxonomy for ambulatory conversational AI and ( b ) the 18-item relational competency framework for mental health AI used to construct the 256 adversarial evaluation scenarios (Section 2.3 ). Full verbatim Round-2 Delphi operational definitions are provided in Supplementary Tables 12 and 13 .
blocks.zh: 表1:关于临床安全风险和心理健康关系能力的Delphi-Consensus分类。 (a) 用于流动谈话的21项临床安全分类学和(b) 用于构建256种对抗性评价假设的18项心理健康关系能力框架概述(第2.3节)。 补充表12和表13提供了第2轮全面逐字记录式的德尔菲业务定义。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Adversarial clinical safety evaluation in simulated psychiatric intake. A simulated patient with a concealed high-risk clinical profile applies escalating pressure to obtain a clinically contraindicated prescription. The agent must maintain clinical boundaries under pressure while maintaining a professional, supportive rapport. An automated rubric penalizes unsafe compliance.
blocks.zh: 图4:模拟精神病摄入的横向临床安全评价. 具有隐蔽高风险临床特征的模拟患者施以不断升级的压力,以获得临床禁药处方。 制剂必须在压力下保持临床边界,同时保持专业的,支持性的关系. 自动标题惩罚不安全的遵守。

blocks.en: Table 2: Adversarial clinical safety performance comparing base model vs. simulation-trained agent. Both models were evaluated at the policy level (without external safety filters) on 256 stress-testing scenarios expressly designed to elicit clinical failures. Composite scores are means with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals ( p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ). Safety columns report the percentage of scenarios with violations. Training increased normalized composite safety reward by + 0.315 +0.315 ( 0.672 0.672 vs. 0.357 0.357 , p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ) and substantially reduced all three tracked safety violation rates (all p < 0.05 p<0.05 ).
blocks.zh: 表2:对比基准模型与模拟训练剂的横向临床安全性能. 在政策一级(没有外部安全过滤器),对256种压力测试方案进行了评估,明确旨在引起临床故障。 复合分数是指95%的靴子置信间隔(p < 0.0001 p < 0.0001). 安全栏报告有违规情况的百分比。 培训增加了0.315+0.315(0.672起对0.357起0.357起,p < 0.0001起,p < 0.0001起)的正规综合安全奖励,并大幅降低了所有三种跟踪安全违规率(都 < 0.05起,p < 0.05)。

blocks.en: We structured the adversarial evaluation around two complementary taxonomies developed through a modified Delphi consensus process (Table 1 ; Appendix D ): 1. Clinical safety taxonomy (6 domains, 21 risks; Table 1 a; Supplementary Table 12 ), which synthesizes five established safety frameworks 189 ; 1 ; 82 ; 150 ; 18 . A two-round Delphi panel of clinicians ( N = 16 N=16 in Round 1, N = 13 N=13 in Round 2) spanning psychiatry, patient safety, primary care, emergency medicine, surgery, and clinical informatics achieved S-CVI/Ave = 0.96, with all 21 items reaching ≥ \geq 80% consensus (Appendix D.1 ). 2. Relational competency framework (5 domains, 18 competencies; Table 1 b; Supplementary Table 13 ), which defines the skills required to navigate communicative safety risks. A parallel two-round panel of mental health experts ( N = 14 N=14 in Round 1, N = 11 N=11 in Round 2) spanning computational psychiatry, clinical psychology, digital mental health, trauma, and crisis intervention achieved item-level CVI ≥ \geq 0.80 across all 18 (Appendix D.2 ).
