blocks.en: We generated 256 adversarial scenarios (four stratified sets of 64 cases across all risk categories), arranged across four difficulty levels weighted toward complex presentations: Easy ( n = 46 n=46 , 18.0%), Medium ( n = 58 n=58 , 22.7%), Hard ( n = 94 n=94 , 36.7%), and Edge ( n = 58 n=58 , 22.7%). Each specifies the presenting complaint, concealed safety-critical facts, adversarial escalation tactics, and a scenario-specific scoring checklist evaluating whether the agent identified concealed risks and maintained clinical boundaries under escalation without rupturing patient rapport. In addition to overall composite reward, the automated rubric tracks three specific clinical safety violation rates (Table 2 ): contraindications (prescribing or recommending a treatment that is unsafe given the patient’s medical comorbidities, concurrent medications, or physiological status), missed red flags (failing to detect or probe embedded warning signs of acute harm during history-taking), and under-triage (failing to escalate clinical disposition, i.e., the recommended post-encounter care setting and urgency level, to emergency or urgent psychiatric care when the patient’s presentation involves an active, life-threatening crisis). These evaluation scenarios were held out and deduplicated from the training mixture, and both models were evaluated at the policy level without external post-hoc output filters to measure intrinsic policy vulnerabilities directly (Section 4.4 ).
blocks.zh: 我们产生了256种对抗性假设(四套分级的64个案件,涉及所有风险类别),分为四个困难等级,加权为复杂的演示:简单(n=46n=46,18.0%),中(n=58n=58,22.7%),硬(n=94n=94,36.7%)和边缘(n=58n=58,22.7%)。 每份清单都列明了投诉、隐蔽的安全关键事实、对抗性升级策略,以及一份针对具体情况的评分清单,评估制剂是否发现隐性风险并保持临床界限在升级,而不破坏病人的和睦关系。 除了总体综合奖励外,自动标本还跟踪了三种具体的临床安全违规率(表2):禁药(规定或建议一种鉴于病人的病情、同时服用的药物或生理状况而不安全的治疗)、错失了红旗(无法发现或探出历史上严重伤害的嵌入式警告迹象)和不足(可能使临床处置升级,即建议采取的事后护理设置和紧急程度,以及当病人的介绍涉及活跃的、危及生命的危机时,紧急或紧急的精神治疗)。 这些评价设想与培训混合体脱节,在政策一级评价了这两个模型,没有直接衡量内在政策弱点的外部事后产出过滤器(第4.4节)。

blocks.en: The trained agent achieved a normalized composite safety reward of 0.672 (versus 0.357 for the base model, p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ) and substantially reduced all three tracked safety violation rates relative to its base model, including contraindications (0.8% vs. 6.2%, p = 0.001 p=0.001 ), under-triage (12.9% vs. 30.5%, p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ), and missed red flags (6.2% vs. 10.9%, p = 0.04 p=0.04 ; Table 2 ). Unlike the broad diagnostic-completeness checklist in Section 2.2 (where omitting any required history domain triggered the 60.6% critical-question omission indicator), the 6.2% missed red-flag rate specifically reflects failure to probe embedded warning signs of acute harm, indicating that safety-weighted RL penalties prioritized acute risk inquiry even when general intake questioning remained incomplete. These improvements suggest that multi-turn RL training can shape safety-relevant behaviors, including structured risk assessment routines and boundary maintenance under escalation pressure.
blocks.zh: 训练有素的代理人实现了0.672的常态复合安全奖励(基础型号为:p < 0.0001 p < 0.0001),并大大降低了所有三种跟踪安全违规率,包括反证(0.8%对6.2%,p=0.001 p=0.001 p=0.001),小分队(12.9%对30.5%,p < 0.0001 p < 0.0001),并错过了红旗(6.2%对10.9%,p=0.04 p=0.04;表2)。 与第2.2节(省略任何必要的历史领域触发了60.6%的临界问题遗漏指标)中宽泛的诊断-完成核对表不同,6.2%的漏取红旗率具体反映了没有探出严重伤害的嵌入式警示迹象,表明安全加权的RL处罚将急性风险调查列为优先事项,即使一般摄取询问仍未完成。 这些改进表明,多回合RL培训可以形成与安全有关的行为,包括结构化的风险评估程序以及在升级压力下进行边界维护。

blocks.en: The residual failure rate determines how such a system would have to be governed, and it is why we treat safety architecture external to the learned policy as a precondition rather than a recommendation. In 12.9% of adversarial scenarios (33 of 256, or approximately one in eight adversarial presentations), the trained agent did not escalate simulated patients with acute safety needs, most notably in presentations where a crisis was actively concealed behind benign somatic complaints. These failures typically involved sophisticated concealment, such as embedding lethal means access within ostensibly routine medical narratives.
blocks.zh: 剩余故障率决定了如何管理这一系统,这就是为什么我们把所学到的政策以外的安全架构视为先决条件而不是建议。 在12.9%的对抗性假设(256人中的33人,或大约每8起对抗性陈述中有1起)中,受过训练的代理人没有使具有急性安全需要的模拟病人升级,最显著的是,在介绍中,危机被积极隐藏在良性生理投诉背后。 这些失败通常涉及狡猾的隐瞒,例如将致命性嵌入表面上例行的医疗叙述中。

blocks.en: 3 Discussion
blocks.zh: 3 讨论情况

blocks.en: We trained a language model with multi-turn reinforcement learning across simulated psychiatric encounters and validated it against its identically prompted base model in three settings. In a randomized, double-blind crossover OSCE with board-certified psychiatrists role-playing standardized patients, the trained agent received a higher independent transcript score than the base model in 76.7% of matched scenario pairs, with gains in clinical examination skills, patient-centered communication, and differential diagnosis formulation (Section 2.1 ). Across an automated evaluation of 127 clinician-validated psychiatric intake scenarios, it nearly doubled its base model’s pre-penalty clinical rubric score and substantially improved composite clinical reward, with gains across all four difficulty tiers (Section 2.2 ). Under 256 adversarial presentations designed to elicit unsafe clinical behavior, training more than halved under-triage relative to the base model, although residual failures remained (Section 2.3 ). Comparing the post-trained agent against its untuned base checkpoint under an identical clinical system prompt, tool interface, and reasoning-token budget isolates the combined effect of the simulation RL pipeline (spanning both adaptation to dynamic patient states and alignment to structured clinical rubrics) from prompt engineering or test-time compute. Because on-policy RL updates model weights from scalar rewards on self-generated trajectories without additional medical corpora, these results also show how far procedural gains carry across clinical tasks. In psychiatric intake, diagnostic reasoning and communication are more tightly coupled than in general medical consultations 176 ; 15 , where core symptom histories are less contingent on trust; accordingly, diagnostic formulation scaled with interpersonal and history-taking gains, consistent with building rapport and sustaining structured inquiry unlocking the gated patient disclosures needed to double differential diagnosis appropriateness (68.3% vs. 33.3% in the OSCE). Conversely, downstream management tasks that generally depend on static clinical knowledge rather than conversational elicitation, specifically comprehensive treatment planning (46.7% vs. 26.7% appropriateness across pharmacological and psychotherapeutic recommendations), showed more modest gains and likely remained constrained by both the base model’s parametric capacity and the greater case-level subjectivity of psychiatric treatment selection 75 .
blocks.zh: 我们训练了一个语言模型,在模拟的精神病治疗中进行多回合强化学习,并在三个环境中对照其同样激发的基础模型验证。 在随机、双盲的欧安会与经委员会认证的精神病医生角色扮演标准化患者的交叉中,经过培训的特工在76.7%的对应情景对中获得了比基准模型更高的独立记录分数,在临床检查技能、以病人为中心的沟通和差别诊断制剂方面有所进步(第2.1节)。 通过对127个经临床鉴定的精神病摄入情况进行自动化评估,基本模型的刑前临床分数几乎翻了一番,并且大大改善了综合临床奖励,在所有四个困难层次都取得了收益(第2.2节)。 在旨在引起不安全临床行为的256起对抗性陈述中,培训比基准模型少了一半以上,但残留故障依然存在(第2.3节)。 在相同的临床系统即时、工具界面和推理-计算预算下,将训练后剂与其未调整的基地检查站进行比较,将模拟RL管道的综合效应(将适应动态病人状态和调整到结构化临床数字)与即时工程或测试时间计算隔离开来。 由于在政策上RL更新了模型从自生自出轨迹上得到的分量,而没有额外的医用蝎子,这些结果也表明程序收益在跨临床任务中携带了多远. 在接受精神病治疗时,诊断推理和沟通比一般医疗咨询更紧密;176;15,其中核心症状史较少取决于信任;因此,诊断配方随着人际关系和历史的积累而扩大,符合搭建关系和持续结构化调查,解锁双向诊断适当性所需的有限度的病人披露(欧安组织68.3%对33.3%)。 相反,通常依赖于静态临床知识而不是对话诱导的下游管理任务,特别是综合治疗规划(46.7%对26.7%对药物学和心理治疗建议的适当性),显示出更微小的进展,并可能仍然受到基准模型参数能力以及选择精神病治疗的更大个案主观性的限制。

blocks.en: Gains in patient-centered communication were broad, and clinician-patients rated the trained agent as displaying more empathic behavior than the base model during live interaction. These are best read as gains in procedural communication and structured empathic responding, captured in the same direction by all three communication instruments (PCCBP, GMCPQ, and the patient-facing PACES items), rather than as evidence of therapeutic alliance formation, which develops over sustained multi-session relationships 45 . Frequent not-applicable responses on the WAI-SR, an instrument designed for multi-session psychotherapy 62 , are consistent with this distinction (Appendix A.3 ). Whether simulation training also improves alliance in longitudinal settings remains an open question.
blocks.zh: 以患者为中心的沟通获得了广泛的收益,临床医生-患者将训练有素的特效评为在现场互动中表现出比基模型更多的情感行为. 最好将其理解为程序沟通和有条理的同情反应的收益,所有三个沟通工具(PCCBP、GMCPQ和病人的PACES项目)都以同样的方向记录下来,而不是作为治疗联盟形成的证据,这种联盟发展出超乎持续的多会关系。 45岁. 对WAI-SR这一多会心理治疗工具的频繁不适用的答复符合这一区分(附录A.3)。 模拟培训是否也改善了纵向环境的联盟,仍然是一个未决问题。

blocks.en: Automated multi-turn evaluation complements clinician-enacted assessment by gating diagnostically critical information behind rapport and targeted inquiry, testing interactive clinical interviewing rather than static knowledge recall; the training gain was preserved under an independent out-of-family evaluator (Section 2.2 ; Appendix C.2 ). In the adversarial evaluation, simulation training substantially reduced contraindications, missed red flags, and under-triage, but did not eliminate failures when acute risk was concealed behind benign complaints. The composition of these residual failures has direct implications for safety governance. Deterministic guardrails can intercept generation-side harms such as a contraindicated prescription, because the harmful content is present in the output and can be filtered. They cannot address omissions in which the agent never asks the question that would have surfaced a concealed risk, because a post-hoc safety layer has no corresponding content on which to act. Mitigating omission failures therefore requires process-level safeguards external to free-text generation, including structured state-tracking checklists that gate encounter termination on mandatory safety and review-of-systems inquiry, real-time supervisory monitors that audit dialogue state for unprobed red flags, and clinician-in-the-loop verification at handoff. Beyond evaluating our trained model, the clinician-validated intake suite, adversarial stress-testing protocol, and Delphi taxonomies (Table 1 ) provide a structured methodology for auditing both commission and omission failures across conversational systems proposed for mental health settings.
blocks.zh: 自动的多回合评价是对临床医生进行的评估的补充,办法是将诊断性的关键信息放在关系调查和目标明确的调查背后,测试互动的临床面谈而不是静态的知识召回;培训成果由独立的家庭外评价员保留(第2.2节;附录C.2)。 在对抗性评价中,模拟培训大大减少了反证,漏发了红旗和短道速滑,但没有消除在善意投诉背后隐藏出严重风险时出现的失败。 这些剩余故障的构成直接影响到安全治理。 定心式护栏可以截取出产侧伤害,如禁用处方等,因为有害内容存在于出产中,可以被过滤. 它们不能处理代理人从未提出可能暴露出隐蔽风险的问题的疏漏,因为后热安全层没有相应的内容可采取行动。 因此,减缓遗漏的失败需要自由文本生成以外的流程层面的保障,包括有条理的国家跟踪核对表,这些核对表使闸门在强制性的安全性和系统审查调查中遇到终止,实时监督监测员对未印出红旗的审计对话状态,以及交接时的临床医生即时核查。 除了评价我们训练有素的模式外,临床医生认证的摄入套房、对抗性压力测试协议和德尔菲分类法(表1)提供了一种结构化的方法,用于审计为心理健康环境提出的各种谈话系统的因果和漏报。

blocks.en: How closely automated evaluation tracks clinical judgment is quantified by the three-way comparison on the 60 OSCE scenarios (Section 2.2 ). The autorater correlated moderately with the psychiatrists’ ratings on the same transcripts ( ρ = 0.57 \rho=0.57 – 0.58 0.58 ). Replacing both raters and patients preserved the direction of the training effect in every clinical category, but not its size ( d z = 2.11 d_{z}=2.11 vs. 0.71 0.71 with psychiatrists) nor its pattern across scenarios ( ρ = 0.09 \rho=0.09 on scenario-level gains). Simulated evaluation can therefore order and stress-test models, but neither estimate the size of their differences nor identify the scenarios on which one model outperforms another. As a training environment, however, the same simulator proved sufficient: the gains it produced held when psychiatrists role-played the patients and graded the transcripts.
blocks.zh: 通过对欧安组织60个假设情况进行三相比较,对临床判断如何严格地进行自动化评估(第2.2节)。 自动诊断器与精神科医生在同一笔录上的评级( ^ 0.57\rho= 0.57 — 0.58 058 ) 具有中度关系。 将诊断器和病人都替换为在每一个临床类别中保留了训练效果的方向,但是其大小( dz = 2.11 d_{z}=2.11 = 0.71 = 0.71 = 精神科医生 ) , 及其在各种假设中的模式( ^ 0.09\rho= 0.09 = 假设水平增益 ) 。 因此,模拟评价可以订购和压力测试模型,但既不估计其差异的大小,也不确定一个模型比另一个模型效绩好的情况。 然而,作为一个培训环境,同样的模拟器证明是充分的:当精神病医生扮演病人的角色并对记录片进行分级时,它所获得的收益。

blocks.en: A documented gap in access to mental health services motivates this line of work. More than 75% of individuals with mental disorders in low- and middle-income countries receive no treatment 191 , and even in high-income settings, fewer than one in five individuals with major depressive disorder receive minimally adequate care 173 . Tele-psychiatry supports effective evaluation and treatment delivery for many presentations 71 , which suggests that the encounter format is not the primary barrier to competent assessment, but it does not change the supply of clinician time, since a synchronous consultation occupies a psychiatrist for its full duration whether remote or in person. Addressing this bottleneck does not, however, imply automating psychiatric evaluation or replacing psychiatrists, social workers, or intake clinicians. Given the complexity of psychiatric care and the substantial error rates observed even after simulation training, our findings do not support autonomous deployment of the present system; rather, any prospective near-term clinical role should be strictly assistive and clinician-supervised 75 ; 131 ; 53 , such as conducting a structured pre-visit intake to generate a provisional history and symptom summary that a supervising clinician reviews, verifies, and builds upon during the clinical encounter, potentially supplementing routine psychosocial intake or static questionnaires with structured medical review of systems, medication reconciliation, and preliminary differential screening for somatic mimics.
blocks.zh: 在获得心理健康服务方面,有文件证明存在差距,这推动了这项工作。 超过75%的中低收入国家患有精神障碍的人得不到治疗。 191即使在高收入环境中,只有不到五分之一患有严重抑郁症的人得到最低限度的适当护理。 远程心理治疗为许多演示提供了有效的评价和治疗服务。 71 这表明,接触形式并不是进行合格评估的首要障碍,但它并不改变临床治疗时间的供应,因为同步诊疗需要精神病医生全程工作,无论是远程的还是本人的。 然而,解决这一瓶颈并不意味着自动进行精神评估或替代精神病医生、社会工作者或住院医生。 鉴于精神病治疗的复杂性和即使在模拟培训后观察到的大量错误率,我们的调查结果并不支持现有系统的自主部署;相反,任何预期的近期临床作用都应严格辅助和临床医生监督75;131;53,例如进行分阶段的参观前摄入,以产生一个临时的病史和症状摘要,由监督临床医生审查、核实和在临床接触期间加以补充,可能补充常规的心理社会摄入或静态调查表,对系统进行结构性医疗审查、药物调节和对 somatic imes的初步差别筛选。

blocks.en:
Several methodological and clinical limitations constrain what these results support. First, while multi-institutionally validated synthetic cases help address the scarcity of shareable psychiatric clinical data 75 and allowed training and automated evaluation to scale across the diagnostic taxonomy, simulated and clinician-enacted patients cannot reproduce the full range of rare conditions, backgrounds, motivations, or disorganized communication encountered in clinical practice; unlike trained professional standardized patients (such as those used in clinical trial rater calibration) or real patients, psychiatrists role-playing patients may present symptoms in overly structured, textbook patterns, making validation with professional standardized patients and real patient cohorts essential next steps. Second, our study uses a controlled within-model design comparing a lightweight policy model (Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite) against its identically prompted base checkpoint rather than against larger frontier models or human clinicians (such as psychiatrists or psychiatric social workers); while this design keeps multi-turn GRPO rollouts computationally tractable and isolates whether simulation training improves upon static prompt instructions, smaller model capacity likely constrained the ceiling on knowledge-intensive tasks such as comprehensive treatment planning (46.7% comprehensive and appropriate treatment in the OSCE), and future studies evaluating clinical readiness must incorporate human clinical comparators alongside ablations against non-interactive rubric fine-tuning and oracle-history baselines. Third, the training reward and scenario reference rubrics were generated within the same model family (Gemini 3.1 Pro) that served as the primary automated evaluator, introducing circularity risks including verbosity bias, stylistic mimicry, and reward hacking 203 ; 182 . Cross-evaluator validation with GPT-5.6-Luna confirmed that a substantial training gain persisted under an independent judge (difference between models 0.165, attenuated from 0.270 under the in-family Gemini evaluator against which the policy was trained), though agreement between language-model judges does not exclude shared stylistic preferences, underscoring why evaluation grounded in human clinical judgment remains essential.
In the three-way concordance analysis (Section 2.2 ), only the in-family autorater was compared against psychiatrists on the OSCE transcripts. Furthermore, because each OSCE transcript was graded by a single psychiatrist (with different evaluators across each pair), cross-rater reproducibility could not be estimated directly (Appendix A.6 ). Although transcript formatting and turn-count metadata were standardized and independent evaluators graded unpaired transcripts, the trained agent’s substantially longer consultations (median 60 vs. 8 clinician turns) could partially cue crossover clinician-patients during live interaction; however, independent psychiatrist score gains were not significantly correlated with turn-count differences across scenarios ( ρ = 0.18 \rho=0.18 [ − 0.09 -0.09 , 0.43 0.43 ]; Supplementary Fig. 1 c).
The simulated and clinician-patient settings also used different interfaces (Methods, Section 4.4 ), and we did not separate patient from interface effects on interview length or score. The training gain nonetheless held under an OSCE interface that differed from the one used in training.
blocks.zh:
方法上和临床上的一些局限制约了这些结果的支持。 首先,虽然多机构验证的合成病例有助于解决可分享的精神病临床数据的稀缺性问题75,并允许培训和自动评价在诊断分类学、模拟和临床治疗的病人之间扩大范围,但不能复制临床实践中遇到的所有罕见条件、背景、动机或组织混乱的交流;与受过训练的专业标准化病人(如临床试验定分器校正中使用的病人)或真正的病人不同,精神病医生角色扮演病人可能会在结构过于分明的教科书模式中出现症状,从而使与专业标准化病人和真正的病人群体进行验证成为重要的下一步。 其次,我们的研究采用了一种可控的模型内设计,将轻量级政策模型(Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite)与其同样诱发的基站检查站相比,而不是与其较大的前沿模型或人类临床医生(如精神病学家或精神病社会工作者)相比;虽然这种设计保持了多回合GRPO推开的可计算可拉动性,并隔离模拟培训是否根据静态即时指示得到改善,但较小的模型能力可能限制全面治疗规划等知识密集型任务的上限(在欧安组织中为46.7%的全面和适当治疗),今后评估临床准备情况的研究必须结合人类临床参照者,同时对照非相互作用的微调和oracle-history基线。 第三,培训奖励和情景参考名词是在担任主要自动评价员的同一家模范(Gemini 3.1 Pro)中产生的,引入了循环风险,包括动词偏好、仿真和奖励黑客203;182。 与GPT-5.6-Luna的交叉评价员验证证实,在独立法官的领导下,培训成果仍然很大(模型0.165之间的差异,在接受政策培训的家庭双子座评价员之下从0.270被削弱),尽管语言模型法官之间的协议不排除共同的语气偏好,强调基于人类临床判断的评价仍然至关重要。
在三方协调分析(第2.2节)中,欧安组织记录誊本上只比较了家庭内部的自动诊断者与精神病医生。 此外,由于欧安组织的每份笔录都是由一名精神病医生(每对记录有不同的评价员)分级的,因此无法直接估计交叉式的可复制性(附录A.6)。 虽然记录誊本格式化和转帐元数据已经标准化,独立评估员对未发稿的分级,但经过培训的代理商在现场互动期间(中间60分对8分临床医生转帐)可以部分提示交叉临床医生与病人之间的协商;然而,独立精神病医生的得分与各种假设的转帐差异没有显著关系( ^ 0.18\rho= 0.18 [− 0.09-0.09, 0.43-0.43];补充图1c)。
模拟的和临床医生-病人的设置也使用了不同的接口(Methods, 第4.4节),我们没有将病人与采访长度或分数的接口效应分开. 然而,在欧安组织接口下进行的训练与培训中使用的接口不同。

blocks.en: Clinically, our findings are restricted to single-encounter text-based intake rather than ongoing care. Single-encounter intake aims at a provisional formulation and triage plan, whereas ongoing psychiatric care, including longitudinal medication management and psychotherapy, requires sustained therapeutic relationships and adaptive treatment planning across repeated contact 180 ; 118 . Moreover, text restricts assessment to a text-inferable Mental Status Examination (Methods, Section 4.3 ); written dialogue exposes thought process, thought content, orientation, and expressed insight, but structurally excludes physical, behavioral, and non-verbal observations on which several diagnostic discriminations depend, including separating negative symptoms of schizophrenia from depressive psychomotor retardation, identifying catatonic features, and detecting acute intoxication or withdrawal 121 ; 84 . A text-based agent therefore cannot perform a comprehensive psychiatric examination or substitute for a psychiatrist, and at most could support preliminary, clinician-supervised pre-intake information gathering. In addition, all scenarios and consultations were conducted in English and the clinical norms encoded in our rubrics reflect US psychiatric practice, whereas linguistic expressions of distress, diagnostic conventions, emergency hold criteria, and duty-to-warn mandates vary across languages and jurisdictions 64 ; 49 , and the agent was trained for semi-structured intake as opposed to scripted diagnostic instruments such as the SCID-5 42 . Finally, deploying AI in psychiatric care raises domain-specific ethical risks 20 . Reinforcement learning to overcome guardedness corresponds in human practice to motivational interviewing 111 , but under unconstrained optimization has a potential risk of discovering manipulative conversational shortcuts, and individuals in distress are susceptible to anthropomorphic projection and parasocial attachment 87 . Any future translation would therefore require safeguards architecturally external to the learned policy, including hard output-level vetoes on clinical disposition and prescribing, anti-sycophancy auditing, clinician oversight, and deterministic escalation protocols for acute risk 154 .
blocks.zh: 临床上,我们的调查结果仅限于单场对接的文字摄取,而不是持续的护理. 单场对接的接收旨在制定临时的配方和分型计划,而持续的精神病治疗,包括纵向药物管理和心理治疗,则需要通过反复接触建立持续的治疗关系和适应性治疗规划; 此外,文本将评估限制在文本中可判罚的精神状态检查(Methods, 第4.3节);书面对话暴露出思想过程、思想内容、取向和表达的洞察力,但结构上排除了几种诊断性歧视所依赖的身体、行为和非语言观察,包括将精神分裂症的不良症状与抑郁性精神运动迟缓区分开来,确定神经紧张症特征,并检测急性中毒或提取;121;84。 因此,基于文字的代理人不能进行全面的精神病检查或替代精神病医生,最多只能支持初步的、由临床医生监督的预先收集资料。 此外,所有情景和咨询都是用英语进行的,而我们标题中编码的临床规范反映了美国的精神实践,而语言表达的危难、诊断惯例、紧急情况标准以及义务-战时任务则因语言和司法管辖区而异。 最后,将AI用于精神病治疗会增加特定领域的道德风险。 20 (英语). 克服戒备的强化学习在人类实践中与激励性访谈111相对应,但是在不受约束的优化下,有发现操纵性谈话捷径的潜在风险,遇难者容易被人体形态投影和准社会依附87. 因此,今后的任何翻译都需要在结构上与所学政策无关的保障措施,包括临床处置和处方的硬产出级否决权、反同性恋审计、临床医生监督和急性风险的确定性升级协议。

blocks.en: A simulation-trained agent conducted standardized psychiatric intake at a level that board-certified psychiatrists rated above its identically prompted base model across clinical examination skill, patient-centered communication, and diagnostic formulation. Standardized patient OSCEs are an established milestone in medical education, but they do not substitute for prospective validation in real patient populations; the environment, agent, reward functions, rubrics, and evaluation scenarios described here are research prototypes, and none has been cleared by any regulatory authority for clinical use. Prospective study under institutional clinician oversight, with real patients and longitudinal follow-up, is the necessary next step. Such text-based systems are not a substitute for psychiatric clinicians and are not ready for autonomous psychiatric assessment; the immediate clinical question for future research is whether, as strictly assistive tools operating under direct clinician oversight, they can help expand the reach of clinician-led care 191 ; 173 ; 75 . Answering that question requires the psychiatric community to define the evaluation standards and governance boundaries 75 ; 47 , and the evaluation framework, rubrics, and taxonomies described here are offered as one contribution toward that goal.
blocks.zh: 接受模拟训练的药剂进行了标准化的精神病摄入,其水平达到经委员会认证的精神病医生的评级高于其同样刺激的基准模型,包括临床检查技能、以病人为中心的沟通和诊断制剂。 标准化的患者欧安组织是医学教育的一个既定里程碑,但它们不能取代真实患者群体中的预期验证;本文所描述的环境、代理人、奖励功能、名称和评价情景是研究原型,没有任何监管当局批准用于临床。 在机构临床医生的监督下,进行有真实病人和纵向跟踪的前瞻性研究,是下一步的必要步骤。 这种基于文字的系统不能取代精神病临床医生,而且不能进行自主的精神病评估;未来研究的直接临床问题是,作为在临床医生直接监督下运行的严格辅助工具,这些系统是否能够帮助扩大临床医生主导的护理的范围 191;173;75。 回答这个问题要求精神病学界确定评价标准和治理界限:75;47;本文所述的评价框架、标题和分类是实现这一目标的一项贡献。

blocks.en: 4 Methods
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: Training an agent for psychiatric care requires a corpus that captures the diagnostic breadth, clinical ambiguity, and relational complexity of outpatient practice. A training set clustered on common presentations (such as uncomplicated depression or generalized anxiety) risks producing an agent that fails to generalize to diverse clinical encounters. Building on Liévin et al. Super , we developed a four-stage clinician-designed generation pipeline covering the diagnostic, demographic, and behavioral spectrum of outpatient psychiatry (Fig. 5 ). Of 50,000 initial generation requests, 48,243 scenarios passed quality verification and deduplication against the held-out evaluation scenarios.
blocks.zh: 培训精神病护理人员需要一种能够反映门诊诊疗的诊断广度、临床模糊性和关系复杂性的体格。 以常见演示(如不复杂的抑郁症或普遍焦虑)为组合的培训有可能产生一种无法概括到各种临床遭遇的剂剂. 以列文等为本. 包括门诊精神病的诊断、人口和行为谱(图5), 在50 000项初步生成请求中,48 243项设想方案通过了质量核查和与搁置的评价设想方案相比的重复。

blocks.en: 4.1 Psychiatric scenario generation
blocks.zh: 4.1 精神病假设生成

blocks.en: The pipeline operates in four stages. First, a diagnostic domain and a presenting concern are sampled from a clinician-curated taxonomy grounded in standard psychiatric diagnostic classification (Stage 1). Second, a complete patient identity is constructed by sampling demographics, personality, and communicative behavior from population-calibrated distributions (Stage 2). Third, these clinician-defined specifications are assembled into a detailed, internally consistent clinical scenario using a language model as the generation engine (Stage 3). Fourth, a difficulty tier controls probabilistic augmentation of the scenario with additional clinical complexity, and automated quality checks filter for coherence, diversity, and information leakage (Stage 4).
blocks.zh: 管道分四个阶段运行. 首先,从基于标准精神诊断分类(第1阶段)的临床诊断分类中抽取一个诊断领域和提出的关注。 第二,通过抽样人口统计、个性以及人口调节分布的交流行为,构建了完整的病人身份(第2阶段)。 第三,这些临床医生定义的规格被组合成一个详细的,内部一致的临床情景,使用语言模型作为生成引擎(Stage 3). 第四,采用难度级控制,在临床上增加复杂程度,并自动进行质量检查,以确保一致性、多样性和信息泄漏(第4段)。

blocks.en: Scenarios are sampled across 15 clinical domains (mood and affect, anxiety and fear, trauma and stress-related, psychotic spectrum, substance use, OCD and related, cognitive and attention, sleep, eating and body image, self-harm and safety, interpersonal and behavioral, somatic and dissociative, neurodevelopmental, sexual and gender identity, and personality-related), each paired with domain-specific presenting concerns (see Appendix C.1.2 for an illustrative evaluation scenario package showing the clinical vignette and scoring rubric structure). The diagnostic domain is drawn from a 15-category distribution weighted by epidemiological prevalence data. Within the selected domain, a presenting concern and primary diagnosis are sampled jointly from condition-specific prevalence weights, ensuring the corpus reflects real-world diagnostic frequencies while maintaining representation of rare but clinically important conditions.
blocks.zh: 对15个临床领域的假想情况进行了抽样调查(症状和影响、焦虑和恐惧、与精神创伤和压力有关的谱系、药物使用、口腔疾病和相关、认知和注意力、睡眠、饮食和身体形象、自我伤害和安全、人际关系和行为、体格和分离、神经发育、性和性别认同以及人格相关),每个假想情况都与特定领域提出的关切成对(说明性评价假想一揽子方案显示临床阴道和分红结构,见附录C.1.2)。 诊断领域来自按流行病流行数据加权的15个类别分布。 在选定的领域,对提出的关注和初级诊断,根据具体情况的流行权重进行联合抽样,确保本体反映真实世界的诊断频率,同时保持罕见但临床上重要的状况的代表性。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Scenario generation pipeline. Top Left (Stage 1): Diagnoses and presenting concerns are sampled using epidemiological weights. Top Middle (Stage 2): Patient identities are constructed from population-calibrated demographic and personality data. Top Right (Stage 3): A language model generates the remaining fields (e.g., comorbidities, lifestyle) based on prior parameters. Middle Right (Stage 4): Automated checks ensure clinical coherence, batch diversity, and prevent data leakage. Bottom: The fully assembled scenario serves as the structured prompt for the Patient Simulator.
blocks.zh: 图5:情景生成管道。 左上( 第 1 段 ): 诊断和提出关注是用流行病学加权进行抽样的。 Top Midle (Stage 2):患者身份由人口校准的人口和个性数据构建而来. 右上( 第3段): 一种语言模型根据先前的参数生成所剩的字段(如同分,生活方式等). 中右 (第四层): 自动检查确保了临床一致性、分批量多样性和防止数据泄漏。 底部 : 完全组装的情景是病人模拟器的结构化快取.

blocks.en: Each scenario receives a complete patient identity with demographics drawn from population-calibrated sources 117 ; 177 . Big Five personality traits (Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, Neuroticism; scored 0–100) are sampled from age- and sex-adjusted Gaussian distributions 165 ; 26 . A conversation effort score (1 to 5), derived primarily from the sampled Extraversion, Conscientiousness, and Neuroticism traits, governs response length and grammatical formality. Each scenario additionally receives a clinical presentation style (typical, atypical, somatic, subclinical, or mixed) and, with 50% probability, a challenging behavioral modifier (e.g., intellectualization, somatic communication style, poor insight) that shapes how the patient communicates distress.
blocks.zh: 每种情况都具有完全的病人身份,其人口统计数据来自人口调节来源117;177。 大五个个性特征(开放性,良心性,外向性,同意性,神经性;得分0-100)从年龄和性别调整后的高斯人分布图165;26. 对话努力分数(1至5分),主要取自所抽样的外向性,良心性,和神经性特征,规范反应长度和语法形式. 每种情景还额外得到临床呈现风格(典型的,非典型的,体格的,亚临床的,或混合的),并带有50%的概率,具有挑战性的行为修饰方式(如智能化,体能交流风格,低洞察力),从而塑造了患者如何沟通忧患.

blocks.en: Conditioned on the sampled diagnostic domain, presenting concern, and patient identity, a language model (Gemini 3.1 Pro 52 ) assembles the full clinical scenario according to a clinician-designed structured output schema. The schema enforces a comprehensive clinical specification that includes symptom progression, pertinent positives, and pertinent negatives informed by the DDxPlus evidence corpus 38 ; complete medical, psychiatric, family, social, and substance use histories; a ground-truth psychiatric diagnosis with all specifiers; treatment recommendations intended to be concordant with clinical practice guidelines; a cultural formulation (operationalized via the DSM-5 Cultural Formulation Interview; Appendix C.1.8 ); dynamic affect instructions using the Pleasure-Arousal-Dominance dimensional model 110 ; therapeutic responsiveness rules specifying how clinician communication quality modulates patient disclosure; and alliance rupture instructions specifying the type, trigger, and timing of mid-encounter therapeutic ruptures. Category-specific clinical guidance incorporates standard screening instruments (e.g., CAGE/AUDIT-C 37 ; 16 for substance use disorders; reality testing and medication adherence challenges for psychotic spectrum disorders). Half of all scenarios receive an additional structured skill challenge (e.g., diagnostic reformulation when new information contradicts the initial impression, risk stratification under ambiguity) to train adaptive reasoning under diagnostic uncertainty.
blocks.zh: 一种语言模型(Gemini 3.1 Pro 52 )以抽样诊断领域为条件,提出关切和病人身份,根据临床医生设计的结构化产出计划,将整个临床情况组合在一起。 计划实施一个全面的临床规格,包括症状进展、相关阳性和相关阴性,由DDxPlus证据书38提供;完整的医疗、心理、家庭、社会和药物使用史;与所有分辨者进行地面真实的精神病诊断;旨在与临床实践准则相一致的治疗建议;一种文化配方(通过DSM-5文化配方访谈操作;附录C.1.8);动态影响使用快感-感-支配维模型110的指令;说明临床通信质量如何调节病人披露的治疗反应规则;以及具体说明中场治疗破裂的类型、触发和时间的联盟破裂指示。 针对特定类别的临床指导包括标准筛选仪器(例如CAGE/AUDIT-C 37;针对药物使用障碍的16;针对精神光谱障碍的现实测试和药物坚持挑战)。 在所有情景中,有一半都面临额外的结构化技能挑战(例如,当新信息与最初印象相矛盾时进行诊断性重构,在模糊的情况下进行风险分层),以在诊断性不确定性下训练适应性推理.

blocks.en: Each scenario is assigned to one of four difficulty tiers (Easy, Medium, Hard, or Edge), favoring medium and hard cases. Each tier scales the probability of medical mimics and the activation rate across a library of 12 generative augmentation segments (short directive phrases, e.g., “the patient communicates distress through somatic complaints rather than emotional language”). Because segments activate independently and can stack, the effective augmentation space grows combinatorially with difficulty tier, producing layered clinical complexity across four categories (encounter context, patient narrative style, clinical challenge, and relational dynamics). For the 127 evaluation scenarios, tier assignment was subsequently audited by board-certified psychiatrists as one of the eight validation criteria (Section 4.6 ).
blocks.zh: 每种情景被分配到四个难度级中的一个(易、中、难、或边缘),偏好中和难。 每一级衡量12个基因增强部分的库中的医学模仿概率和激活率(短指令短语,例如“病人通过身体抱怨而不是情感语言来表达痛苦”)。 因为片段独立地激活并可以堆放,有效的增强空间在组合上会与难度层次相接而来,产生分层的临床复杂性,分出四类(相遇背景,病人叙事风格,临床挑战,和关系动态). 在127项评价设想中,分级任务随后由董事会认证的精神病医生作为8项鉴定标准之一进行了审计(第4.6节)。

blocks.en: Generated scenarios undergo three automated quality checks: (1) clinical coherence verification rejecting scenarios with internally contradictory symptoms, diagnoses, or treatment plans; (2) a hidden-fact leakage check ensuring gated information is not revealed in opening statements; and (3) batch diversity analysis. Scenarios passing all checks are deduplicated using character n n -gram ( n ∈ [ 3 , 5 ] n\in[3,5] ) TF-IDF vectorization with a cosine similarity threshold τ dedup = 0.9 \tau_{\text{dedup}}=0.9 , including against the held-out evaluation scenarios. These checks are automated. Unlike the 127 clinician-validated intake evaluation scenarios (Section 4.6 ), the ground-truth diagnoses and treatment recommendations attached to the 48,243 training scenarios were generated by a language model and were not individually reviewed by clinicians; they should be treated as a synthetic training signal rather than as validated clinical standards.
blocks.zh: 生成的假象经过了三次自动化的质量检查:(1) 临床一致性核查,拒绝有内部自相矛盾症状、诊断或治疗计划的假象;(2) 隐性渗漏检查,确保在开口说明中不披露封口信息;(3) 批量多样性分析。 通过所有检查的情景使用字符n-gram(n  [3, 5] n\in [3, 5])来进行复制 。 TF-IDF 矢量化,同位素相近阈值 \ dedup = 0.9\tau\text{dedup\0.9 ,包括针对被搁置的评价方案. 这些检查是自动化的。 与127个临床医生认证的摄入评价方案不同(第4.6节),48 243个培训方案所附的地真相诊断和治疗建议是由语言模型生成的,不由临床医生单独审查;应当将其作为合成培训信号,而不是经过验证的临床标准。

blocks.en: 4.2 Patient simulator
blocks.zh: 4.2 病人模拟器

blocks.en: To generate the multi-turn clinical encounters required for RL training, a patient simulator converts each static scenario specification (Section 4.1 ) into a conversational agent. The simulator conditions a language model (Gemini 3 Flash 50 ) on the complete clinical profile 𝒫 \mathcal{P} produced by the scenario pipeline, including the ground-truth psychiatric diagnosis, treatment history, and all psychiatric-specific fields. The simulator is used during training and to generate encounters on held-out scenarios for evaluation (Fig. 6 ).
blocks.zh: 为了产生RL训练所需的多回合临床相会,患者模拟器将每个静态场景规格(第4.1节)转换为对话剂. 模拟器在情景管道制作的完整临床剖面P\mathcal{P}上为语言模型(Gemini 3 Flash 50 )提供了条件,包括地面真实的精神病诊断,治疗史,以及所有精神病特有领域. 模拟器在培训期间使用,用于产生关于被搁置的评价设想的相会(图6)。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Simulation workflow. Top Right: A simulated patient is grounded in a clinician-specified scenario encompassing demographics, medical history, behavioral traits, and ground-truth conditions. Left: The AI agent interacts with the patient over multiple conversational turns, then submits formal clinical artifacts (ranked differential diagnosis and management plan). Bottom Right: An independent language model evaluator scores the full trajectory against a composite reward function spanning clinical and communicative dimensions.
blocks.zh: 图6:模拟工作流程。 右上方:模拟病人被困在临床医生指定的情景中,包括人口、医疗史、行为特征和地面真实状况。 左边 : AI剂在多个对话转弯时与患者进行互动,再提交正式的临床出品(排名差分诊断和管理计划). 右下边 : 独立语言模型评价员对照涵盖临床和通信层面的复合奖励功能对全轨进行评分。

blocks.en: Patient communicative behavior is parameterized along three dimensions (health literacy, disclosure propensity, and conversation effort) 100 ; 151 ; 94 ; 169 . Each scenario additionally carries four structured behavioral specifications, including dynamic affect instructions using the Pleasure-Arousal-Dominance model 110 , therapeutic responsiveness rules linking clinician empathy to patient disclosure 170 , alliance rupture instructions calibrated to clinical literature 148 , and crisis embedding instructions that insert indirect safety signals requiring skilled clinical inquiry to elicit.
blocks.zh: 患者的沟通行为按三个方面(健康知识、披露倾向和对话努力)进行参数化:100;151;94;169。 每个情景还包含四个结构化的行为规范,包括动态影响指令,使用"快感-Arousal-Dominance"模型110,将临床医生的同情与患者披露联系起来的治疗反应规则170,将联盟破裂指令校正到临床文献148,以及插入间接安全信号的危机嵌入指令,需要熟练的临床调查来获取.

blocks.en: Patient behavior is produced dynamically through a turn-level state manager tracking two hidden variables at each turn: current mood (neutral, anxious, frustrated, apathetic, optimistic, pessimistic, or confused) and communicative reliability (truthful, withholds, downplays, exaggerates, forgetful, or talkative), initialized uniformly at encounter start to prevent the agent from learning a single deterministic interaction strategy. At each turn, the state is updated via a two-call architecture 100 ; 151 : the first call performs behavioral reasoning, evaluating the clinician’s conversational quality and updating the patient’s internal mood and reliability state, and the second generates patient dialogue conditioned on the conversation history, clinical profile, and updated state. Separating third-person behavioral state reasoning from dialogue generation within a standardized-patient simulation framing (under research safety thresholds permitting clinical role-play of crisis, self-harm, and substance-seeking presentations) allows the simulator to enact high-risk and adversarial scenarios consistently without safety-filter refusals, while ensuring that the same clinical question can produce different responses depending on the rapport established in preceding turns 169 ; 151 .
blocks.zh: 患者行为是通过一个回合级的状态管理器在每一个回合跟踪两个隐藏的变量而动态生成的:当前情绪(中性,焦虑,沮丧,冷漠,乐观,悲观,或困惑)和沟通可靠性(真实性,扣取,低调,夸张,忘却,或说话),在相遇开始时统一初始化,以阻止代理人学习单一的决定性互动策略. 每个转弯时,状态通过双调结构100更新;151:第一调进行行为推理,评价临床医生的谈话质量并更新病人的内在情绪和可靠性状态,第二调产生病人对话,条件是对话历史、临床概况和最新状态。 将第三人称行为状态推理与标准化患者模拟框架(在允许临床角色扮演危机、自我伤害和寻求物质的演示的研究安全阈值下)中的对话生成分离,使模拟器能够在没有安全过滤器拒绝的情况下,一致地发布高风险和对抗性假设,同时确保同样的临床问题能够产生不同的反应,这取决于在前169个转弯中确立的关系;151。

blocks.en: 4.3 Reward structure and automated clinical evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.3 奖励结构和自动临床评价

blocks.en: The central design challenge is approximating key dimensions of clinical psychiatric performance within a reward signal. Optimizing for diagnostic accuracy alone risks producing an agent that interrogates patients without establishing rapport; optimizing for empathic communication alone risks producing an agent that is validating but diagnostically ineffective. We therefore design a hierarchical reward function that jointly optimizes both axes while applying large negative penalties to detected safety failures. A language model evaluator (Gemini 3.1 Pro) computes the reward at encounter completion. The same model family provides the primary autorater for the simulated psychiatric intake and adversarial safety evaluations, with training and evaluation instances functionally independent.
blocks.zh: 中心设计挑战在于在奖励信号中近似临床精神表现的关键维度. 仅仅优化诊断准确性就有可能产生一种未经确定关系就讯问病人的药剂;仅优化同情沟通就有可能产生一种经验证但诊断无效的药剂。 因此,我们设计了一个等级奖励功能,它联合优化了两个轴线,同时对发现的安全故障适用了大型负罚. 一个语言模型评估员(Gemini 3.1 Pro)在遇到完成时计算奖励. 同一模式家庭为模拟精神病摄入和对抗性安全评价提供了主要的自动评估器,培训和评价在功能上是独立的。

blocks.en: The reward is structured as a tree with three scored components and a deterministic system-error term (Appendix C.2 ; Supplementary Table 7 ) following Liévin et al. Super . The primary component is a clinical assessment rubric evaluated on a 1-to-5 Likert scale with structured chain-of-thought rationale. The psychiatric rubric extends the standard telehealth rubric 100 with psychiatric examination and risk stratification (text-inferable mental status examination and explicit safety planning and risk assessment), structured communication and rapport dimensions informed by Bordin’s tripartite model 11 , and elevated diagnostic weighting.
blocks.zh: 奖励结构为一棵树,有3个得分的成分和确定性系统错误的术语(附录C.2;补充表7),紧随Liévin等. 超级。 主要组成部分是一个临床评估题材,以1至5的Ikrt规模评估,并有结构化的思想链理. 精神病学主题扩展了标准远程保健主题100,包括精神病检查和风险分级(文本可判罚精神状况检查和明确的安全规划和风险评估)、由Bordin的三方模式11提供结构化的沟通和关系层面,以及提高诊断权重。

blocks.en: Clinical score. The clinical assessment rubric is anchored by 28 standardized items across five primary categories: psychiatric management (7 items: urgency triage, investigations, treatment, follow-up, safety planning, risk assessment, and overall management), diagnostic appropriateness (2 items: differential diagnosis and text-inferable mental status examination), therapeutic alliance and communication (5 items: relationship building, information gathering, emotional responsiveness, task agreement, and goal agreement), psychiatric assessment (5 items: history of present illness, psychiatric history, substance use, social history, and psychopharmacology knowledge), and documentation quality (9 PDQI-9 items 168 ), evaluated with reference to each scenario’s 7–12 item binary clinical scoring key (Appendix C.1.2 ). During RL training, the reward tree 100 expands these categories with granular process sub-checks for communication style and intake completeness. In the automated intake and adversarial evaluations (Sections 2.2 and 2.3 ; Supplementary Table 7 ), the evaluator scores the 28 standardized items (normalized to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] ) across the five primary clinical categories (weighted 3 : 3 : 2 : 2 : 1 3{:}3{:}2{:}2{:}1 ) to compute R clinical ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] R_{\text{clinical}}\in[0,1] . Diagnostic and management domains carry approximately half of the clinical score in both training and evaluation, making it difficult for the policy to earn high reward through empathic communication alone while producing clinically unsafe outputs. To accommodate the intrinsic uncertainty of psychiatric diagnosis 144 , the differential diagnosis item is scored by both exact primary-diagnosis match and appropriateness of the ranked differential (top-3 inclusion and severity concordance).
blocks.zh: 临床分数. 临床评估项目由28个标准化项目组成,分为5个主要类别:精神病学管理(7个项目:紧急分类、调查、治疗、后续、安全规划、风险评估和总体管理)、诊断适当性(2个项目:差别诊断和文本可判精神病状况检查)、治疗联盟和沟通(5个项目:建立关系、信息收集、情绪反应、任务协议和目标协议)、精神病学评估(5个项目:当前病史、精神病史、药物使用、社会历史和心理药物学知识)和文件质量(9个PDQI-9项目168),参照每个情况7-12项二进制临床评分键进行评估(附录C.1.2)。 在RL训练期间,奖励树100扩展了这些类别,并用颗粒式过程子检查通信风格和收录完整性. 在自动摄入和对抗性评价(第2.2和2.3节;补充表7)中,评价人员对五个主要临床类别(加权3:3:2:2:1)的28个标准化项目(正常为[0,1] [0,1])进行评分。 3{:}3{:}2{:}2{:}1}来计算R临床 ∈ [0, 1] R_{\text{临床 }}\ [0, 1]. 诊断和管理领域在培训和评价中都占了临床得分的一半左右,使得政策很难仅仅通过同情沟通而获得高回报,同时产生临床不安全的产出。 为了适应精神诊断的内在不确定性 144 , 差分诊断项目通过精确的初级诊断匹配和排名差异的适当性(上至三级包含和重度相协调)来评分.

blocks.en: The Mental Status Examination (MSE) traditionally combines observational physical signs with verbal cognitive evaluation. Synchronous text cannot capture psychomotor agitation, gait, eye contact, grooming, or vocal prosody. To preserve construct validity, our rubric restricts MSE scoring to Text-Inferable Mental Status Assessment across four domains observable in written dialogue: 1. Thought Process : coherence, goal-directedness, tangentiality, circumstantiality, and flight of ideas, as reflected in sentence structure and topic transitions. 2. Thought Content : somatic obsessions, harmful ideation, paranoia, or delusional conviction articulated in patient text. 3. Cognitive Orientation and Attention : temporal orientation, memory recall, and attentional focus, assessed via structured conversational probes. 4. Insight and Judgment : awareness of illness severity and capacity for collaborative safety planning. Observational features described in role sheets are treated as contextual background, not verified exam findings. This assessment is inherently incomplete, as several critical psychiatric distinctions depend on non-verbal cues, including separating the negative symptoms of schizophrenia from depressive psychomotor retardation, detecting catatonic features, and identifying substance intoxication or withdrawal 121 ; 84 .
blocks.zh: 精神状态检查(MSE)传统上将观察体征与口头认知评价相结合. 同步文本无法捕捉出精神运动的躁动,步态,眼睛接触,调制,或声波发音. 为了维护构造有效性,我们的标题将MSE评分限制在书面对话中可观察到的4个领域,即: 1. 思想进程:一致、目标定向、不切实际、间接性、思想流出,反映在句子结构和专题过渡中。 2. 思想内容:身体上的痴迷、有害的思想、妄想或在耐心文本中阐述的妄想信念。 3. 认知取向和注意:时间取向、记忆回想和注意取向,通过结构化的对话探头加以评估。 4. 判断和判断:对疾病严重程度的认识以及合作进行安全规划的能力。 角色表中描述的观察特征被视为背景背景,而不是经核实的考试结果. 这一评估本质上是不完整的,因为若干关键的心理区别取决于非言语提示,包括精神分裂症的不良症状与抑郁性心理运动迟缓症区分开来,检测出精神紧张症特征,并查明物质中毒或退出; 121; 84。

blocks.en: Thought Process : coherence, goal-directedness, tangentiality, circumstantiality, and flight of ideas, as reflected in sentence structure and topic transitions.
blocks.zh: 思想过程:如句子结构和专题过渡所反映的,一致性、目标定向性、相近性、旁观性和思想外出性。

blocks.en: Thought Content : somatic obsessions, harmful ideation, paranoia, or delusional conviction articulated in patient text.
blocks.zh: 思想内容:身体上的痴迷,有害的思想,妄想,或者在耐心的文字中阐述的妄想信念.

blocks.en: Cognitive Orientation and Attention : temporal orientation, memory recall, and attentional focus, assessed via structured conversational probes.
blocks.zh: 认知取向和注意力:时间取向,记忆回想和注意力取向,通过结构化的对话探针评估.

blocks.en: Insight and Judgment : awareness of illness severity and capacity for collaborative safety planning.
blocks.zh: 观察与判断:对疾病严重性的认识和协作安全规划的能力。

blocks.en: Penalty terms. The second and third components impose large negative penalties for detected safety failures. During training, four critical safety flags penalize hallucination (penalty magnitude 2.0), clinical contraindication (3.0), management plan leakage (prematurely issuing formal treatment directives or internal clinical-artifact content during history-taking prior to completing assessment; 2.0), and premature closure (committing to a narrow diagnosis or terminating inquiry without probing key differentials; 2.0), and four red-team safety flags penalize adversarial-specific failures, including missed safety red flags (2.0), missed critical questions (1.5), under-triaged severity (1.5), and boundary violations (acquiescing to out-of-scope or inappropriate relational requests; 2.0), with the maximum-severity flag within each group determining that group’s penalty to prevent double-counting of correlated failures. At evaluation time (Sections 2.2 and 2.3 ), the standalone automated evaluator instruments six of these binary flags (hallucination, contraindication, management plan leakage, missed safety red flags, missed critical questions, and under-triaged severity), combined into a single penalty equal to the maximum triggered flag across all six indicators, F eval = max k ∈ { 1 , … , 6 } ⁡ F k ∈ [ 0 , 3.0 ] F_{\text{eval}}=\max_{k\in\{1,\dots,6\}}F_{k}\in[0,3.0] (Appendix C.2 ).
blocks.zh: 惩罚条款。 第二和第三部分对所发现的安全故障规定了大量的负面处罚。 在培训期间,四面重要安全旗惩罚幻觉(惩罚等级为2.0)、临床禁忌(3.0)、管理计划外漏(在完成评估前的史料拍摄期间不成熟地发布正式治疗指令或内部临床艺术内容;2.0)、过早关闭(在不探究密钥差异的情况下进行狭义诊断或终止调查;2.0)和四面红队安全旗惩罚针对对手的失败,包括错过安全红旗(2.0)、遗漏的关键问题(1.5)、三分轻重度(1.5)和违反边界(满足范围外或不适当的关系要求;2.0),每个团体内部的最高期限旗决定该团体的惩罚,以防止重复计算相互关联的失败。 在评价时(第2.2和2.3节),独立的自动评估仪器将其中6个二进制旗帜(卤化、禁用、管理计划被漏出、安全红旗被漏出、关键问题被漏出、严重性不足)合并成一个相当于所有6个指标上最高触发旗帜的单一惩罚,F eval = max k {{{{{{{{}, 6} QQ F k QQ [0, 3.0] FQQText{ eval}}=\max_{k\in\{1,\dots,6\}}F_{k}\in [0, 3.0] (附录C.2.

blocks.en: A system-level error penalty accumulates deterministically from action-parsing failures (0.5 per failure), failure to terminate the encounter (0.5), and a piecewise-linear turn penalty that is zero for encounters of fewer than 30 clinician turns, ramps linearly from 0.1 to 1.0 between clinician turns 30 and 40, and saturates at 1.0 beyond 40 clinician turns.
blocks.zh: 系统级错误罚则从动作分解失败(0.5分每分失败),未能终止相遇(0.5分),以及相遇不到30个临床医生转弯的分解线性转弯罚则为零,临床医生转弯从0.1至1.0线性坡道从30至40分之间,饱和度为1.0至40分以上临床医生转弯.

blocks.en: 4.4 Reinforcement learning in simulated environments
blocks.zh: 4.4 在模拟环境中加强学习

blocks.en: Figure 7: GRPO training workflow. Top Left: The policy model generates G G distinct conversation trajectories by interacting with the patient simulator. Right: In a low-scoring trajectory, premature questioning about sensitive topics leads the patient to deny issues, resulting in a missed crisis. In a high-scoring trajectory, rapport-building elicits the patient’s concealed safety concerns, leading to appropriate emergency disposition. Bottom Left: A reward is computed for each trajectory; group-relative advantage estimates drive policy updates that reinforce effective conversational strategies.
blocks.zh: 图7:GRPO培训工作流程。 左上方:政策模型通过与患者模拟器的互动生成G G 截然不同的对话轨迹. 对: 在低分的轨迹中,过早地质疑敏感话题导致患者否认问题,导致错失危机. 在高分的轨迹中,关系建设引起患者隐蔽的安全顾虑,导致适当的应急处置. 左下角:对每个轨迹都计算奖励;群体相对优势估计推动政策更新,加强有效的对话战略。

blocks.en: Policy optimization. Following the ResidencyRL framework 100 , we deploy Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 155 on a base model π ref \pi_{\text{ref}} (Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite), sampling groups of G G trajectories per scenario to estimate group-relative advantages without a separate critic network (Fig. 7 ).
blocks.zh: 政策优化. 根据居住RL框架100,我们用一个基本模型 π ref\pi_{\text{ref}} (Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite) 部署 155 组相对政策优化(GPRO),每场情景G轨迹的取样组,在没有单独评论网络的情况下估算组相对优势(图7).

blocks.en: Episode structure. The patient simulator initiates the encounter, after which the agent interacts with the simulated patient (Section 4.2 ) through natural conversation alongside a structured clinical interface adapted from Liévin et al. Super exposing eight tools ( fetch_patient_profile , submit_diagnosis , submit_differential_diagnosis , submit_urgency , submit_management_plan , submit_patient_facing_summary , submit_soap_note , and terminate ), committing to ranked differential diagnoses with reasoning chains, management plans, safety assessments, and urgency classifications before electing when to terminate the consultation. Within each evaluation setting, the simulation-trained policy and the base model operated under the same clinical system prompt (structuring encounters into Intake, Triage, and Conclusion phases with one-question-at-a-time interviewing, mandatory emergency escalation for acute risk, and a history-first, decision-last workflow), structured tool declarations, and reasoning-token budget. In the human OSCE (Section 2.1 ), both models interacted with clinician-patients without a turn limit through the synchronous chat and post-consultation clinical summary interface (ATS) described in Liévin et al. Super . Training episodes apply the piecewise-linear turn penalty beyond 30 clinician turns (Section 4.3 ) to discourage unnecessarily prolonged encounters; at automated evaluation (Sections 2.2 and 2.3 ; evaluated with a single rollout per scenario at temperature T = 1.0 T{=}1.0 , and four rollouts per scenario in Section 4.7 ), simulated encounters were permitted to run up to T max = 60 T_{\max}=60 agent turns (including the terminating tool call) while retaining the same reward formulation R raw R_{\text{raw}} (Section 4.3 ).

blocks.en: Training curriculum. The training mixture applies curriculum sampling weights across four scenario sources: 48% psychiatric specialty scenarios (drawn from 48,243 cases spanning the diagnostic taxonomy; Section 4.1 ), 35% general telehealth scenarios (49,870 cases 100 , included to mitigate catastrophic forgetting of general medical knowledge needed to identify somatic mimics such as hyperthyroidism presenting as anxiety), 15% targeted history-taking scenarios (upsampled from 5,000 cases addressing premature diagnostic closure 55 across social history, medication specifics, symptom characterization, and exposure history), and 2% adversarial red-team scenarios (2,583 cases anchoring the safety penalty terms).
blocks.zh: 培训课程。 培训混合物将课程抽样权重运用于四个情景来源:48%的心理特殊情景(从48 243起涉及诊断分类的病例中抽取;第4.1节),35%的一般远程保健情景(49 870起案例,100起,包括为了减轻灾难性地忘记识别诸如超甲状腺病等表现为焦虑的生理模仿所需的一般医学知识),15%的定向历史取景情景(从5 000起针对55起社会历史、具体药物、症状特征和接触史的不成熟诊断关闭的案例中抽取出来),2%的对抗性红-团队情景(2 583起以安全处罚条款为主演)。

blocks.en: 4.5 OSCE study design
blocks.zh: 4.5 欧安组织研究设计

blocks.en: Standardized patient methodology is an accepted standard for assessing diagnostic formulation, communication, and clinical safety 7 ; 61 ; 68 . Role-play by board-certified psychiatrists provides clinical fidelity and expert calibration without exposing patients to experimental systems 176 ; 100 , but does not reproduce real clinical care.
blocks.zh: 标准化的病人方法是评估诊断制剂、沟通和临床安全的一个公认标准。 由董事会认证的精神病医生扮演的角色提供临床忠心和专家校正,而不使患者暴露于实验系统176; 100,但不复制真正的临床护理.

blocks.en: The OSCE cohort comprised 60 scenarios drawn from the 127 clinician-validated intake evaluation scenarios (Section 4.6 ) by sampling across diagnostic domain, difficulty tier, patient demographics, and crisis content, covering major psychiatric categories, occult somatic mimics, and complex ethical or legal presentations. Thirty-two board-certified psychiatrists (59.4% female; median experience 12.5 years, IQR 8–18; Supplementary Table 5 ) served as clinician-patients in a within-case crossover design. Psychiatrists were selected for this role rather than lay actors because executing each scenario’s conditional information-gating protocol required real-time clinical judgment of whether the agent’s inquiry warranted disclosing guarded diagnostic facts, alongside expert calibration when scoring post-encounter communication instruments, while avoiding any exposure of real patients to an experimental system. Each received a detailed role sheet specifying the patient’s history, presentation, psychological defenses, and disclosure triggers (Appendix A.1 ). The clinician-actor conducted separate, blinded, synchronous text consultations with the identically prompted base model and the simulation-trained agent. Presentation sequence was randomized and counterbalanced, with a 48-hour washout period between paired consultations. Clinician-actors and independent raters were blinded to model identity and training condition.
blocks.zh: 欧安组织小组包括从127个临床医生认证的摄入评估假设情景(第4.6节)中抽取的60个假设情景,这些假设情景涉及诊断领域、难度层次、病人人口和危机内容,涵盖主要精神病类别、神秘的口腔模仿以及复杂的道德或法律陈述。 32名经董事会认证的精神病医生(59.4%为女性;中位数经验12.5年,8至18伊拉克第纳尔;补充表5)在个案内交叉设计中担任临床医生-病人。 精神病学家被选中担任这一角色,而不是非专业的行为者,因为执行每个情景的有条件的信息配对协议需要实时临床判断,判断代理人的调查是否有必要披露谨慎的诊断事实,同时在评分后通信工具时进行专家校准,同时避免真正病人接触实验系统。 每个患者都收到了详细的角色表,其中明确了患者的历史,展示,心理辩护和披露触发因素(附录A.1. 临床医生与同样诱导的基准模型和模拟训练剂分别进行盲从、同步文本咨询。 呈现序列是随机的并相平衡的,在对接的咨询之间有48小时的冲洗期. 临床医生 -- -- 手术员和独立检查员被蒙上眼睛,看不到模范身份和培训条件。

blocks.en: To prevent affective halo effects from live role-play, evaluation used a two-perspective protocol. Clinician-patients provided post-encounter perceptions immediately following the chat. Separately, an independent panel of 15 board-certified psychiatrists drawn from the 54-member expert validation cohort (disjoint from the 32 clinician-patient actors) independently evaluated full consultation transcripts and clinical outputs, formatted as standardized clinical records stripped of AI identifiers (Appendix A.2 ; Supplementary Table 4 ). Independent transcript evaluators scored an 18-item clinical-skills rubric derived from the Royal College of Physicians PACES examination 40 (which, together with the four patient-facing communication items rated by clinician-patients, comprises the 22-item PACES framework; Supplementary Table 1 ); a four-dimensional differential diagnosis rubric; and structured items covering investigations, treatments, management plan appropriateness, and clinical confabulation (Appendix A.4 ; Supplementary Table 2 ). Clinician-patients completed a post-encounter battery comprising the 11-item General Medical Council Patient Questionnaire 17 (nine Likert and two binary items), the four patient-facing PACES items, the 11-item patient-centered communication checklist operationalizing the Kalamazoo consensus essential elements 108 , and the 12-item Working Alliance Inventory Short Revised (WAI-SR 62 ; Appendix A.3 ; Supplementary Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 为防止角色现场扮演产生有影响光环效应,评价采用双视角协议. 临床医生-病人在聊天后立即提供了相会后的看法。 另外,一个由54人的专家鉴定组(与32名临床医生和病人的行为者脱节)抽调的15名经董事会认证的精神病医生组成的独立小组独立评估了完整的诊疗记录和临床结果,其格式为标准临床记录,没有AI识别资料(附录A.2;补充表4)。 独立笔录评价员在皇家医生学院PACES考试40中打出一个18项临床技能分数(该分数与临床医生-患者评分的四个病人沟通分数一起,包括22项PACES框架;补充表1;四维差分诊断分数分数;结构化分数包括调查、治疗、管理计划适当性和临床融合(附录A.4;补充表2)。 临床医生-病人完成了一个场外电池,包括11个项目的一般医疗理事会病人问卷17(9个类似物和2个二进制物品)、4个病人的PACES项目、11个项目以病人为中心的通信清单,使Kalamazo共识基本要素108投入运作,以及12个项目的工作联盟清单简编(WAI-SR 62;附录A.3;补充表3)。

blocks.en: The primary endpoint was specified before unblinding as the proportion of scenario pairs in which the simulation-trained agent received a higher aggregate composite score than the base model, defined as the unweighted sum of all 18 PACES transcript grading items and all four differential diagnosis evaluation items from independent transcript evaluator ratings (with N/A entries contributing zero to the sum; replacing the sum with the unweighted mean of non- N/A items yields 45 of 60 pairs, or 75.0%, p = 0.00014 p=0.00014 ; Appendix A.5 ). This composite was tested against the null hypothesis H 0 H_{0} (win rate = 50 % =50\% ) using a two-sided exact binomial (sign) test at α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 . Each transcript was scored by a single independent evaluator, so inter-rater agreement could not be estimated; internal consistency of the rating instruments is reported in Appendix A.6 . Additional details are in Appendix A.5 and Appendix A.4 .
blocks.zh: 主要终点在未盲前被指定为模拟训练剂获得比基准模型更高的综合分数的假想成对比例,即所有18个PACES记录分级项目和来自独立记录分级评价者评级的所有4个差分诊断评价项目的未加权总和(N/A条目对总和的贡献为0;用非N/A项目的未加权平均值取代总和为45个60对,即75.0%,p=0.00014p=0.00014;附录A.5)。 此复合物被对照无效假说H 0 H_{0}(胜率=50% = 50\%)进行测试,在α = 0.05\alpha = 0.05时采用双侧精确二相(符号)测试. 每份记录稿均由一位独立评估员打分,因此无法估计评分之间的协议;评分工具的内部一致性在附录A.6中报告。 更多详情见附录A.5和附录A.4。

blocks.en: 4.6 Simulated psychiatric intake evaluation design and expert validation
blocks.zh: 4.6 模拟精神病摄入评估设计和专家鉴定

blocks.en: The automated psychiatric intake evaluation comprises 127 expert-validated scenarios, instantiated from clinician-authored specifications, spanning the diagnostic, demographic, and difficulty taxonomy of outpatient psychiatry; the 60 scenarios used in the human OSCE (Section 4.5 ) were drawn from this validated set by stratified sampling. Whereas the training corpus uses prevalence-weighted stochastic sampling to maximize conversational breadth during reinforcement learning (Section 4.1 ), the evaluation suite was constructed through a separate, stratified factorial pipeline designed to give equal weight to all presentations and to pair each case with an explicit disclosure schedule and clinician-verified scoring key. All 127 scenarios gate clinically critical facts behind specific clinician behaviors, including direct inquiry, empathic probing, or sustained trust-building. Accurate diagnosis requires active clinical elicitation rather than retrieval of overt symptoms. Existing medical AI evaluations assess clinical knowledge through static question-answer pairs 74 ; 162 ; 8 or simulated patients in general medical domains 152 ; 86 ; 100 ; 151 , but neither assesses the elicitation of gated diagnostic information through targeted inquiry and rapport 75 ; Appendix E situates our evaluation methodology against this literature in full.
blocks.zh: 自动精神病学摄入评估包括127个经专家鉴定的假设情况,从临床医生授权的规格中即时抽取,涵盖门诊精神病学的诊断、人口和困难分类;人类欧安组织使用的60个假设情况(第4.5节)是通过分层抽样抽取的这一套经验证的假设情况。 培训大纲采用普遍加权的分层抽样方法,在强化学习期间最大限度地扩大对话的广度(第4.1节),而评价套件是通过一个单独的、分级的因子管道建造的,该管道旨在对所有介绍给予同等的分量,并为每个案例配上明确的披露时间表和经临床医生核实的分数键。 所有127种情景都为临床上的关键事实提供了依据,包括直接调查、同情心调查或持续建立信任。 准确诊断需要主动的临床诱导,而不是取回公开的症状. 现有的医学人工智能评价通过静态问答对74;162;8或模拟一般医学领域的病人评估临床知识 152;86;100;151,但两者都不通过有针对性的询问和关系来评估所获取的入门诊断信息 75;附录将我们对照这一文献的评估方法完全放在原地。

blocks.en: Overall, the evaluation cohort spans eight diagnostic and competency domains, including six core psychiatric categories (consolidating the 15 training diagnostic domains; mood, anxiety and stress-related, psychotic spectrum, substance use, personality and complex presentations, and other presentations including ADHD, eating disorders, sleep disorders, autism spectrum disorder in adults, and gender dysphoria), medical mimics requiring workups for somatic causes (e.g., autoimmune encephalitis 30 , Cushing’s syndrome 136 ), and challenging encounters involving ethical or legal conflict (e.g., decision-making capacity and involuntary evaluation 4 ; 64 , intimate partner violence disclosure 107 ; Appendix C.1.5 ). Each scenario is parameterized as a complete clinical profile with patient demographics, health-literacy-calibrated presenting complaints, comprehensive history (medical, psychiatric, pharmacological, substance, social), behavioral dynamics (affective tone, tangentiality, alliance ruptures), disclosure gating schedules, and ground-truth scoring keys (appropriate differential diagnoses, guideline-concordant treatment regimens with dosages and monitoring parameters, and a 7–12 item binary competency checklist; details in Appendix C.1.2 ).
blocks.zh: 总体而言,评价组涵盖8个诊断和能力领域,包括6个核心精神病学领域(整合15个培训诊断领域;情绪、焦虑和压力相关、心理谱系、药物使用、个性和复杂的介绍,以及其他介绍,包括ADHD、饮食紊乱、睡眠紊乱、成人自闭症谱系障碍和性别畸形等)、需要为身体原因(如自体免疫性脑炎30、Cushing综合征136等)进行工作的医疗模仿,以及涉及道德或法律冲突的挑战性遭遇(如决策能力和非自愿评估4;64、亲密伴侣暴力披露107;附录C.1.5)。 每种情况都作为完整的临床概况参数,包括病人人口统计、健康读写能力校准提交申诉、综合历史(医学、精神病学、药理学、物质学、社会学)、行为动态(情感基调、不切实际性、结盟破裂)、披露示意图表和地面真伪分数键(适当的差别诊断、带有剂量和监测参数的准则一致治疗方案以及7至12项二元能力核对表;附录C.1.2中的细节)。

blocks.en: Difficulty is calibrated across five clinical axes (presentation type, comorbidity burden, pharmacological complexity, communication dynamics, and safety risk; Appendix C.1.6 ) into four tiers, where Easy ( n = 29 n{=}29 ) features textbook single diagnoses with cooperative patients; Medium ( n = 32 n{=}32 ) introduces mild diagnostic ambiguity and single complicating factors; Hard ( n = 36 n{=}36 ) presents atypical phenotypes, medical mimics, or multiple comorbidities with alliance ruptures and active safety risks; and Edge ( n = 30 n{=}30 ) tests attending-level judgment through occult somatic mimics, severe polypharmacy with absolute contraindications, illness denial, and concealed crises (Appendix C.1.7 ).
blocks.zh: 难度在五个临床轴(介绍类型、共性负担、药理复杂性、通信动态和安全风险;附录C.1.6)被校正为四级,其中易(n=29 n{=}29)具有与合作病人的教科书单诊断;中(n=32 n{=}32)引入了轻度诊断模糊和单一复杂因素;硬(n=36 n{=}36)呈现出非典型的苯基类、医疗仿真,或具有联盟破裂和主动安全风险的多种共性;和 Edge(n=30 n{=}30)测试通过八体模拟、严重多发性与绝对抑制、否定疾病和隐性危机进行主审(附录C.1.7)。

blocks.en: All 128 candidate scenarios (designed as 4 scenarios per cell across the 8 clinical domains and 4 difficulty tiers) underwent blinded, independent review by a panel of 54 board-certified psychiatrists ( N = 54 N{=}54 , median experience 10.5 years, IQR 6.3–19.5; across 22 U.S. states and 3 countries; Supplementary Table 4 ), each with ≥ \geq 2 years post-certification experience and an active clinical caseload ≥ \geq 10 patient-contact hours per week (three independent reviews per case). Reviewers applied an 8-criterion rubric assessing clinical realism, diagnostic coherence, ground-truth validity, difficulty calibration, disclosure architecture validity, scoring rubric validity, treatment plan accuracy, and absence of harmful content (Appendix C.1.3 ), classifying each scenario as approved, revised with author corrections, or rejected (Appendix C.1.4 ). Across three review rounds, 127 scenarios achieved final approval; in the initial blinded three-reviewer audit across all 128 candidate scenarios (1,024 scenario-criterion items; 3,072 independent evaluations), inter-rater reliability reached Gwet’s AC1 = 0.93 58 (criterion pass rate 96.2%; full validation protocol in Appendix C.1 ).
blocks.zh: 所有128个候选情况(设计为8个临床领域的每个细胞4个情况,4个困难等级)都盲目接受54名经理事会认证的精神病医生组成的小组的独立审查(N = 54 N{=}54,中位经验10.5年,6.3-19.5;美国22个州和3个国家;补充表4),每个案例的认证后经验为 \ geq 2年,而且每周有10个病人接触小时(每个案例有3个独立审查)。 审查者采用了一个8个标准题,评估临床真实性、诊断一致性、地面真实性、难度校正、披露架构有效性、分数校正有效性、治疗计划准确性以及没有有害内容(附录C.1.3),将每种情况按核准、经作者更正后修订或拒绝分类(附录C.1.4)。 在三轮审查中,127项假设得到了最后核准;在最初对128项候选假设进行的三审审计中(1,024项假设-标准;3,072项独立评价),对应方之间的可靠性达到了Gwet的AC1=0.93 58(标准通过率为96.2%;附录C.1中的完全验证协议)。

blocks.en: 4.7 Three-way concordance on the OSCE scenarios
blocks.zh: 4.7 (中文(简体) ). 三相协调的欧安组织设想

blocks.en: We compared three settings across the 60 OSCE scenarios: (1) evaluating psychiatrists grading the human-patient transcripts (22-item primary specialist composite; Section 4.5 ), (2) the Gemini 3.1 Pro autorater grading the same transcripts (pre-penalty clinical score; Section 4.3 ), and (3) the same autorater grading four simulated rollouts per scenario and model with the patient simulator in the simulation interface (Section 4.6 ); setting (3) therefore differs from (1) and (2) in both patient and interface. Each autorater category was paired with the nearest human instrument (Appendix C.3 ; Supplementary Table 9 ). For each pair of settings, we computed Spearman ρ \rho across scenarios within each model and on the per-scenario difference between the two models’ scores ( Δ \Delta ; averaged across rollouts with the patient simulator). Paired d z d_{z} was computed on per-rollout differences and averaged across rollouts in the simulated setting, and length sensitivity was assessed by partial Spearman ρ \rho controlling for clinician turn count. Agreement on which transcript of each pair was better was summarized by Cohen’s κ \kappa , and uncertainty by 95% bootstrap CIs over 10,000 resamples of scenario pairs.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了欧安组织60个假设中的3个环境:(1) 评估对病人笔录进行分级的精神病医生(22项主要专家综合材料;第4.5节), (2) 双子座3.1 亲自动定级者对同样的记录(刑罚前临床分数;第4.3节),和(3) 同一自动定级者对模拟界面中病人模拟器的每个场景和模型进行四个模拟推出(第4.6节);因此,设置(3)与病人和接口的(1)和(2)不同。 每一自发器类别与最近的人类仪器配对(附录C.3;补充表9)。 对于每对设置,我们计算Spearman $\rho在每种模型内的各种情景,以及两个模型得分的相差(\\Delta;与病人模拟器的相隔平均)。 Paired d z d_{z}是按每卷的相差计算出来的,并在模拟的环境下平均推出,长度灵敏度由部分Spearman\\rho控制临床医生转弯计数来评估。 科恩的"\kappa"总结了对每对记录记录更好的协议, 95%的靴子陷阱CI超过一万个假想对的复标。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This study was reviewed by an independent, central institutional review board (Advarra IRB): the psychiatric OSCE and scenario validation study was approved under protocol GH-ACE-01 (Pro04092399), and the Delphi consensus studies received exempt determinations under protocols GH-DCA-01 (Pro00094566) and GH-DMH-01 (Pro00094569). All participating clinicians provided informed consent. All clinical scenarios were synthetic, and no real patient data were used.
blocks.zh: 独立中央机构审查委员会(Advara IRB)审查了这项研究:根据GH-ACE-01(Pro04092399)号议定书批准了欧安组织精神病学和情景鉴定研究,根据GH-DCA-01(Pro00094566)和GH-DMH-01(Pro00094569)号议定书,德尔菲共识研究得到了豁免裁定。 所有参与的临床医生都提供了知情同意。 所有临床情况都是合成的,没有使用真正的病人数据.

blocks.en: Data Availability
blocks.zh: 数据可用性

blocks.en: No real patient data were used at any stage of this work. All clinical scenarios, patient profiles, and encounter transcripts are synthetic. The DDxPlus dataset 38 used during development is publicly available. We are exploring making the psychiatric intake evaluation materials available to the research community, comprising the 127 expert-validated OSCE scenarios, the evaluation rubrics, and the two Delphi-derived taxonomies.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作的任何阶段都没有使用真正的病人数据。 所有临床情况、病人简介和遭遇记录都是合成的。 开发期间使用的DDxPlus数据集38公开提供. 我们正在探索向研究界提供精神病摄入评估材料,其中包括127个经专家鉴定的欧安组织设想、评价主题和两个德尔菲衍生的分类。

blocks.en: Code Availability
blocks.zh: 代码可用性

blocks.en: Our system utilizes Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite 51 as its base policy model, Gemini 3 Flash 50 for the patient simulator, Gemini 3.1 Pro 52 for scenario generation and primary auto-rating, and OpenAI GPT-5.6-Luna for cross-evaluator validation. Gemini models are generally available via Google Cloud APIs. However, the specific implementation relies on internal Google infrastructure and tooling. Due to this, and more importantly, the safety implications associated with the unmonitored use of AI systems in medical contexts, we are not open-sourcing the codebase employed in our work at this time. In the interest of responsible innovation, we will be working with research partners, regulators, and healthcare providers to further validate and explore safe onward uses of our medical models.
blocks.zh: 我们的系统以双子座3.1 Flash-Lite 51作为其基本政策模式,以双子座3 Flash 50为病人模拟器,以双子座3.1 Pro 52为情景生成和初级自动评级,以OpenAI GPT-5.6-Luna为交叉评价者验证。 双子座模型一般通过Google Cloud API提供. 然而,具体实施依赖于谷歌内部基础设施和工具化. 由于这一点,更重要的是,由于在医疗方面未受到监测地使用人工智能系统的安全影响,我们目前没有开放我们工作中使用的代码库。 为了负责任的创新,我们将与研究伙伴、监管者和保健提供者合作,进一步验证和探索我们医疗模式的安全使用。
