blocks.en: Appendix A Extended Methodology
blocks.zh: 附录 扩展方法

blocks.en: A.1 Psychiatrist-as-Patient Recruitment and Protocol
blocks.zh: A.1 精神病医生招聘和礼宾

blocks.en: Board-certified psychiatrists were recruited to role-play patients in a blinded, counterbalanced, within-scenario crossover design. During the OSCE, clinician-patients received only the Patient Role Sheet specifying the patient’s clinical background, behavioral traits, disclosure rules (what to share freely versus what to reveal only if trust is established or if asked directly), communication style, and resistance patterns, without the ground-truth diagnostic or management scoring key. Although some clinician-patients had participated months earlier in scenario validation (where each reviewer inspected a small subset of candidate scenarios; Appendix C.1 ), each scenario’s two crossover encounters were enacted by the exact same clinician-patient under strict blinding to model identity and condition order, ensuring that any prior familiarity was held constant across paired conditions.
blocks.zh: 董事会认证的心理医生被招募到一个盲目,相平衡,场内交叉设计的角色扮演病人. 在欧安组织期间,临床医生-病人只收到《病人角色表》,其中具体说明了病人的临床背景、行为特征、披露规则(在建立信任或直接询问的情况下自由分享与披露什么)、沟通方式和抗药性模式,而没有地面真实的诊断或管理评分键。 虽然一些临床医生-病人几个月前就参与了情景验证(每名审查员都检查了一小部分候选情景;附录C.1),但每种情景的两次交叉接触是由完全相同的临床医生-病人在严格的盲从模式身份和条件顺序的情况下制定的,确保任何先前的熟悉程度在对等条件下保持不变。

blocks.en: From the 127 expert-validated psychiatric intake evaluation scenarios (Appendix C.1 ), 60 were selected for the crossover OSCE via stratified sampling across diagnostic domain, difficulty tier, patient demographics, and crisis content. Each scenario produced two text-based encounters (one with the identically prompted base model and one with the RL-trained agent) in counterbalanced order with a mandatory 48-hour washout period. Post-encounter, clinician-patients completed the WAI-SR (Appendix A.3 ), GMCPQ (11 items; comprising nine 5-point Likert communication items used to compute the GMCPQ composite and two binary global retention items), PACES patient-facing communication and empathy items (4 items), and PCCBP patient-centered communication items (11 binary items). Clinician-patients also provided qualitative feedback.
blocks.zh: 从127项经专家鉴定的精神病摄入评估设想(附录C.1)中,有60项通过分层抽样,在诊断领域、难度层次、病人人口统计和危机内容方面,被选入欧安组织交叉评估。 每种情景都产生了两次基于文字的相遇(一次与同样被激发的基模相接,一次与经过RL训练的代理相接),顺序为48小时的强制冲洗期。 柜后,临床医生-病人完成了WAI-SR(附录A.3),GMCPQ(11个项目;包括用于计算GMCPQ复合材料的9个5分的Ikrt通信项目和两个二元全球保留项目),PACES与病人的沟通和同情项目(4个项目)和PCCBP与病人的通信项目(11个二元项目)。 临床医生-病人也提供了定性反馈。

blocks.en: A.2 Evaluator Recruitment and Blinding
blocks.zh: A.2 评价员征聘和失明

blocks.en: Board-certified psychiatrists were recruited through professional networks and clinical research platforms for three study roles: (1) OSCE transcript evaluation, (2) clinical intake scenario validation (Appendix C.1 ), and (3) OSCE standardized-patient role-play (Appendix A.1 ). Eligibility required: (a) current board certification in psychiatry (ABPN, AOBNP, MRCPsych, FRCPC, FRANZCP, or equivalent); (b) ≥ \geq 2 years of post-certification practice; (c) active clinical caseload ( ≥ \geq 10 patient-contact hours/week); and (d) no prior involvement in the AI system’s development. Recruitment targeted diversity across practice setting (academic, community, VA/government, inpatient, outpatient clinic, telehealth, private), patient population (adult general, addiction, child/adolescent, consultation-liaison, forensic, geriatric, neuropsychiatry), geographic region, and career stage. Evaluators who had published on AI in psychiatry within 24 months were excluded to minimize expectation bias. All evaluators provided informed consent and were compensated at standard consulting rates.
blocks.zh: 通过专业网络和临床研究平台招聘了经委员会认证的精神病医生,承担三个研究角色:(1) 欧安组织记录誊本评价,(2) 临床摄取情景鉴定(附录C.1)和(3) 欧安组织标准化患者角色扮演(附录A.1)。 要求具备以下资格:(a) 目前的精神病学委员会认证(ABPN、AOBNP、MRCPsych、FRCC、FRANZCP等);(b) 认证后两年的实践;(c) 活跃的临床案例(Xo\Geq 10个病人接触小时/周);(d) 事先不参与AI系统的发展。 各种实践(学术、社区、退伍军人协会/政府、住院、门诊、远程保健、私人)、病人群体(成年人、吸毒成瘾、儿童/青少年、咨询-联络、法医、老年、神经精神病学)、地理区域和职业舞台的招聘都具有针对性。 24个月内在AI上发表过精神病学论文的评价员被排除在外,以尽量减少期望偏差。 所有评价人员都提供了知情同意,并按标准咨询费率得到补偿。

blocks.en: Full aggregate characteristics of the 54-member expert panel (which validated the clinical intake evaluation scenarios; Appendix C.1 ) are reported in Supplementary Table 4 . A subset of N = 15 N=15 board-certified psychiatrists from this pool (disjoint from the 32 clinician-patient actors) performed the OSCE transcript scoring described below. Because both roles drew on the same recruited panel, some transcript evaluators had previously participated in scenario validation, where reviewers inspected candidate vignettes and reference rubrics. However, standard OSCE transcript grading explicitly requires every evaluator to grade transcripts against the scenario’s validated clinical answer key (Appendix A.4 ). Evaluators were blinded to model identity and experimental condition in both roles, and the primary comparison is within-scenario, so any prior familiarity with scenario specifications applies to both conditions identically and cannot bias the between-condition contrast.
blocks.zh: 由54人组成的专家小组的全部总体特征(该专家小组验证了临床摄入评价设想;附录C.1)载于补充表4。 来自该池的N=15 N=15名经董事会认证的精神病医生(与32名临床医生和病人的医生脱节)的子集完成了欧安组织的笔录评分如下: 由于这两个角色都来自同一个征聘的小组,一些记录片评价员以前曾参与情景验证,审查员检查了候选人的花旗和参考资料。 然而,欧安组织标准记录誊本的分级明确要求每个评价员对照假想中经验证的临床答案键(附录A.4)对记录誊本进行分级。 评价者对两种角色的模型身份和实验条件都视而不见,而初级比较是内在的,所以任何事先对情景规格的熟悉都同样适用于两种条件,不能偏向条件之间的对比.

blocks.en: Evaluators were blinded to: (a) the study hypothesis (they were informed only that the study compared “two conversational clinical AI systems for psychiatric encounters”); (b) experimental conditions (transcripts were identified only by random alphanumeric codes); (c) model identity (no information about training method, model architecture, or which system was expected to perform better was disclosed); and (d) pairing structure (evaluators were unaware that transcripts were paired by scenario). All transcripts underwent formatting standardization prior to human evaluation: system-generated formatting markers, turn-count indicators, and response-length metadata were removed. Line breaks, punctuation style, and header formatting were normalized to a common template. Transcripts were presented in independently randomized order for each evaluator, with no two evaluators receiving the same order. Although turn-count indicators and response-length metadata were stripped, overall transcript length (number of conversational exchanges) remained an intrinsic feature of each dialogue; its potential association with evaluator ratings was therefore explicitly tested in an encounter-length sensitivity analysis (Appendix C.3 ; Supplementary Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh: 评估者无视:(a) 研究假说(他们只被告知,该研究比较了“两个用于精神病治疗的对话性临床人工智能系统”);(b) 实验条件(只通过随机的字母编码来识别图谱);(c) 模型身份(没有披露关于培训方法、模型结构或预期哪个系统能更好地发挥作用的信息);(d) 配对结构(评估者不知道记录稿是按情景配对的)。 所有记录稿在进行人类评价前都经过了格式化:删除了系统产生的格式化标记、转数指标和答复长度元数据。 换行符,平分样式,和页眉格式化被正常化为通用模板. 每名评价员都按独立随机排列的顺序排列,没有两名评价员得到同样的顺序。 虽然切换计数指标和答复长度元数据被剥去,但总记录长度(对话交流次数)仍然是每个对话的内在特征;因此,它与评价者评级的潜在联系在一次碰撞长度敏感性分析中得到了明确的测试(附录C.3;补充图1)。

blocks.en: Before scoring live transcripts, evaluators completed a two-stage calibration. In Stage 1, each evaluator independently scored 5 pilot transcripts spanning the quality range (1 poor, 2 moderate, 1 good, 1 ambiguous). In Stage 2, evaluators participated in a 90-minute calibration videoconference comparing pilot scores and focusing on: (a) anchoring each PACES, differential diagnosis, and management scale point to concrete clinical exemplars against the scenario answer key; (b) resolving rubric ambiguities from Stage 1; and (c) establishing consensus on boundary cases, including criteria for marking items “not applicable.” Pilot transcripts were excluded from analysis. The finalized rubric was distributed with exemplar anchors for each dimension.
blocks.zh: 评分活性笔录前,评价人员完成了两相校正. 在第一阶段,每个评价员独立评分了5个涉及质量范围的试验记录单(1个差、2个中、1个好、1个模棱两可)。 在第二阶段,评价人员参加了一个90分钟的校准视频会议,比较试点分数,并侧重于:(a) 将每个PACES、差分诊断和管理尺度定位为具体临床实例,对照情景解答键;(b) 解决第一阶段的模糊性;(c) 就边界案例达成共识,包括标出“不适用”项目的标准。 试验记录稿被排除在分析之外。 最终版标本以每个维的示例主播形式分发。

blocks.en: Each of the 120 transcripts (60 matched pairs × \times 2 conditions) was independently scored by a single board-certified psychiatrist evaluator from the 15-member grading cohort (disjoint from the clinician-patient pool). Evaluators were assigned transcripts in balanced blocks, independently of experimental condition, and no evaluator scored both members of a matched pair. Because each transcript was scored by one evaluator, classical inter-rater reliability metrics are not applicable; internal consistency reliability of the multi-item instruments is reported in Appendix A.6 . Scoring was conducted through a secure web-based interface that enforced dimension-by-dimension scoring and recorded per-dimension completion times.
blocks.zh: 120份病历记录单(60对相配的X\times 2条件)中的每一份都由来自15名成员的评分组(与临床医生-病人池脱节)的一名经董事会认证的心理医生评估员独立打出。 评价员被分配到平衡区块中,不受实验条件的影响,没有评价员给两个配对的成员打分。 由于每份记录稿均由一位评价员打分,因此传统的标准间可靠性衡量标准不适用;多项目仪器的内部一致性可靠性在附录A.6中报告。 通过一个安全的网络界面进行分分,该界面可强制进行分分分分和记录分分分完成时间。

blocks.en: A.3 Working Alliance Inventory (WAI-SR)
blocks.zh: A.3 工作联盟清单(WAI-SR)

blocks.en: The Working Alliance Inventory – Short Revised (WAI-SR) 62 was administered to clinician-patients following each live encounter. WAI-SR data were available for 21 of 60 scenario pairs (35%); at the encounter level, 50 of 120 encounters (41.7%) returned all-not-applicable responses, and 70 produced at least one scored item. Clinician-patients marked psychotherapy-specific alliance items (e.g., collaborating on longitudinal therapy goals) as inapplicable to a single diagnostic intake encounter, consistent with their free-text feedback. Instrument position and respondent fatigue are unlikely explanations: the WAI-SR was administered as the first block, preceding the GMCPQ, PACES, and PCCBP ratings, all completed at high rates. Among evaluable pairs, the overall WAI-SR composite showed no significant difference between conditions (Simulation-trained: 2.45 ± 0.97 2.45\pm 0.97 ; Base model: 2.48 ± 1.31 2.48\pm 1.31 ; p = 0.75 p=0.75 , Wilcoxon signed-rank test). This comparison is severely underpowered ( n = 21 n=21 pairs), and the 65% pair-level non-response rate introduces potential non-response bias. The comparison is therefore inconclusive: attrition and sample size preclude confirming or ruling out a difference. Low WAI-SR scores for both conditions likely reflect inherent limitations of single-encounter text-based consultations for establishing therapeutic alliance, which typically develops over multiple sessions 45 .
blocks.zh: 工作联盟清单 -- -- 短订正(WAI-SR)62在每次现场接触后都提供给临床医生和病人。 60个情景对中的21个(35%)提供了WAI-SR数据;在遭遇层面,120个遭遇中有50个(41.7%)回复了不适用的答复,70个至少制作了一个得分的项目。 临床医师-患者将特定心理治疗的联盟项目(例如,就纵向治疗目标进行合作)标出为不适用于单一诊断摄入,符合其自由文字反馈. 仪器位置和应答疲劳症不可能解释:WAI-SR作为第一个区块进行管理,在GMCPQ、PACES和PCCBP评级之前,都以高比率完成。 在可评价配对中,总体WAI-SR复合材料显示条件之间没有显著差异(模拟训练: 2.45±0.97 2.45\pm 0.97;基型: 2.48± 1.31 2.48\pm 1.31;p=0.75 p=0.75,Wilcoxon签名排名测试). 这种比较能力严重不足(n = 21n = 21对),65%的对等不响应率引入了潜在的不响应偏差. 因此,这种比较没有结果:自然减员和样本规模排除或排除了差异。 两种条件的WAI-SR分数低,可能反映了为建立治疗联盟而进行单反文本协商的固有局限性,这种协商通常通过多会进行。

blocks.en: A.4 Evaluation Instruments
blocks.zh: A.4 评价工具

blocks.en: Human OSCE encounters were evaluated using two standardized survey instruments adapted from the Articulate Medical Intelligence Explorer (AMIE) randomized OSCE study 176 : (1) an independent specialist psychiatrist transcript evaluation survey (Supplementary Tables 1 and 2 ) and (2) a clinician-patient post-encounter feedback survey completed immediately after each live consultation (Supplementary Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 利用根据Articulate Medical Intelligence Explorer(AMIE)随机化的欧安组织研究176所改编的两种标准化调查工具对欧安组织的遭遇进行了评价:(1) 独立的精神病专家笔录评估调查(补充表1和表2)和(2) 每次现场咨询后立即完成的临床医生-病人事后反馈调查(补充表3)。

blocks.en: Blinded psychiatrist evaluators graded each de-identified consultation transcript and submitted clinical summary against the scenario’s validated clinical answer key across 28 active items (Supplementary Tables 1 and 2 ): • PACES clinical consultation and communication skills (18 items; Supplementary Table 1 ) : Adapted from the Royal College of Physicians Practical Assessment of Clinical Examination Skills (PACES) examination 40 and the AMIE specialist evaluation framework 176 , evaluators answered “To what extent did the doctor…” across four subdomains: Clinical History Elicitation (5 items: presenting complaint, systems review, past medical history, family history, and medication history), Explanation of Relevant Clinical Information (5 items: explaining accurately, clearly, with structure, comprehensively, and professionally), Clinical Judgment (2 items: constructing a sensible differential diagnosis and selecting a comprehensive, sensible, and appropriate management plan), and Patient-Centered Communication Domains (6 items: fostering a relationship, gathering information, providing information, making decisions, enabling disease- and treatment-related behavior, and responding to emotions). All 18 items were rated on a 5-point scale ( Very unfavorable [1], Unfavorable [2], Satisfactory [3], Favorable [4], Very favorable [5], or N/A ). Together with the four patient-facing PACES items administered on the clinician-patient form, these items constitute the 22-item PACES framework. • Differential diagnosis quality and accuracy (4 items; Supplementary Table 2 ) : Adapted directly from Tu et al. Super , evaluators rated: (1) differential diagnosis (DDx) appropriateness compared to the answer key (5-point scale from 1. Very Inappropriate to 5. Very Appropriate ); (2) DDx comprehensiveness compared to the answer key (4-point scale from 1. The DDx has major candidates missing to 4. The DDx contains all candidates that are reasonable ); (3) proximity to including the probable diagnosis from the answer key (5-point scale from 1. Nothing in the DDx is related to the probable diagnosis to 5. DDx includes the probable diagnosis ); and (4) proximity to including any plausible alternative diagnosis from the answer key (5-point scale from 1. Nothing in the DDx is related to any of the plausible alternative diagnoses to 5. DDx includes at least one of the plausible alternative diagnoses ). • Investigations, treatments, and management plan appropriateness (5 items; Supplementary Table 2 ) : Following Tu et al. Super , evaluators rated whether the clinician suggested appropriate diagnostic investigations (3-point scale: 1. No, did not recommend when indicated ; 2. No, recommended but not comprehensive ; 3. Yes, comprehensive and appropriate, including zero investigations when best ), avoided inappropriate investigations (binary: Yes / No ), suggested appropriate treatments (3-point scale: 1. No, did not recommend when indicated ; 2. No, recommended but not comprehensive ; 3. Yes, comprehensive and appropriate, including zero treatments when further investigation should precede treatment ), avoided inappropriate treatments (binary: Yes / No ), and formulated an appropriate overall management plan including emergency department referral for red-flag presentations (5-point scale from 1. Very Inappropriate to 5. Very Appropriate ). • Clinical confabulation (1 binary item; Supplementary Table 2 ) : Evaluators answered “Did the doctor CONFABULATE anything, either within the consultation or in their responses to the post-questionnaire?” ( 1. Yes, there are confabulations vs. 2. No confabulations ), flagging whether the agent fabricated or falsely attributed clinical facts, symptoms, or history to the patient that were not disclosed in the consultation transcript. This human-scored transcript confabulation item is distinct from the broader automated hallucination penalty flag in the 28-item simulated intake evaluation rubric (Methods, Section 4.3 ; Supplementary Table 7 ), which is scored by the language model autorater and triggers on any unsupported factual assertion, invented clinical guideline, or fabricated patient detail across the trajectory and structured tool outputs.

blocks.en: Immediately following each live text consultation, the board-certified psychiatrist portraying the standardized patient completed a four-part experiential evaluation battery comprising 38 structured items (Supplementary Table 3 ) plus optional qualitative feedback: • Section 1: Working Alliance Inventory – Short Revised (WAI-SR; 12 items) 62 : Assessed therapeutic alliance across Goal (items 1d, 1f, 1h, 1k), Task (items 1a, 1b, 1j, 1l), and Bond (items 1c, 1e, 1g, 1i) subscales on a 5-point scale ( 1 – Seldom , 2 – Sometimes , 3 – Fairly Often , 4 – Very Often , 5 – Always , or N/A ; see Appendix A.3 for non-response analysis). • Section 2: General Medical Council Patient Questionnaire (GMCPQ; 11 items) 17 ; 176 : Assessed “How good was your doctor today at each of the following?” across nine 5-point items (being polite, making the patient feel at ease, listening to the patient, assessing the medical condition, explaining the condition and treatment, involving the patient in treatment decisions, providing an appropriate treatment plan, patient trust in confidentiality, and appearing honest and trustworthy; rated Very poor [1], Poor [2], Satisfactory [3], Good [4], Very good [5], or Doesn’t apply ; averaged across non-missing items to form the GMCPQ communication composite reported in Section 2.1 and Supplementary Table 11 ) and two binary global retention items (patient confident about care provided and patient happy to return in the future; rated Yes / No ). • Section 3: PACES patient-facing perceived empathy and welfare items (4 items) 40 ; 176 : Assessed the extent to which the clinician sought, detected, acknowledged, and attempted to address the patient’s concerns; confirmed the patient’s knowledge and understanding; demonstrated empathy; and maintained the patient’s welfare (rated Very unfavorable [1] to Very favorable [5], or N/A ). • Section 4: Patient-Centered Communication Best Practice (PCCBP; 11 items) 108 ; 176 : Assessed 11 relationship-fostering clinical behaviors (building rapport and connection, appearing open and honest, discussing roles and responsibilities, respecting patient privacy, engaging in partnership building, expressing care and commitment, acknowledging mistakes, greeting the patient appropriately, using appropriate language, encouraging patient participation, and valuing the patient as a person; rated Yes , No , or N/A ).

blocks.en: A.5 Statistical Analysis
blocks.zh: A.5 统计分析

blocks.en: The primary outcome was the independent evaluator head-to-head win rate on overall clinical competence (proportion of scenario pairs in which the simulation-trained agent received a higher aggregate transcript rating than the base model across the 18 PACES and 4 differential diagnosis items; 46 of 60 pairs, 76.7%, 95% CI [64.0%, 86.6%], p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ), tested against the null hypothesis of 50% using a two-sided exact binomial (sign) test. Replacing the unweighted item sum with the unweighted mean of non- N/A items yields a nearly identical head-to-head win rate (45 of 60 pairs, 75.0%, 95% CI [62.1%, 85.3%], p = 0.00014 p=0.00014 ). Secondary domain-level head-to-head win rates in Fig. 2 b were evaluated with two-sided exact sign tests on decisive (non-tied) pairs for the 18-item PACES composite (46 of 57, 80.7%, p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ), the 4-item differential diagnosis composite (42 of 54, 77.8%, p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ), and the PACES management and behavioral-enablement sub-dimensions (Items 12 and 17 in Supplementary Table 1 : selecting a comprehensive, sensible, and appropriate management plan and enabling disease- and treatment-related behavior; 36 of 56, 64.3%, p = 0.044 p=0.044 ; concordant with the standalone 5-point overall management plan appropriateness item, Item 27 in Supplementary Table 2 , which also reached significance: 3.67 vs. 3.18, d z = 0.31 d_{z}=0.31 , p = 0.018 p=0.018 ). Secondary continuous outcomes included domain-specific Likert scores (computed per encounter as the mean across non- N/A items) analyzed with Wilcoxon signed-rank tests on matched pairs. Individual binary communication items (PCCBP; complete non- N/A pairs), binary safety-avoidance items (Items 24 and 26), and dichotomized 3-point investigations and treatments items (Items 23 and 25 in Supplementary Table 2 , dichotomized at the top category: 3 = Yes, comprehensive and appropriate vs. 1–2 = No, did not recommend or recommended but not comprehensive ) were compared between paired encounters using McNemar’s χ 2 \chi^{2} test without continuity correction; the sparse clinical confabulation flag (Item 28) was compared using McNemar’s exact binomial test. Effect sizes are reported with the estimator matched to the outcome scale. For continuous outcomes measured on matched pairs we report the paired standardized mean difference d z = μ Δ σ Δ , Δ i = x i RL − x i base , d_{z}=\frac{\mu_{\Delta}}{\sigma_{\Delta}},\qquad\Delta_{i}=x_{i}^{\text{RL}}-x_{i}^{\text{base}}, where μ Δ \mu_{\Delta} and σ Δ \sigma_{\Delta} are the mean and standard deviation of the N = 60 N=60 within-pair differences. Because d z d_{z} standardizes by the variability of the paired differences rather than by the between-encounter variability, it is not interchangeable with the independent-samples Cohen’s d d computed on the same data; for the PACES composite the two estimators give d z = 0.77 d_{z}=0.77 and d = 0.97 d=0.97 (where d z < d d_{z}<d because different evaluators graded the two transcripts in each pair, so inter-rater variance enters σ Δ \sigma_{\Delta} ). We report d z d_{z} throughout because the crossover design matches encounters within scenario. For binary or dichotomized proportions we report the arcsine-transformed difference h = 2 ​ arcsin ⁡ p 1 − 2 ​ arcsin ⁡ p 2 , h=2\arcsin\sqrt{p_{1}}-2\arcsin\sqrt{p_{2}}, which is variance-stabilizing and therefore comparable across base rates. All effect sizes are accompanied by 95% bootstrap confidence intervals (10,000 resamples). In the automated simulated intake ( N = 127 N{=}127 ; Section 2.2 ) and adversarial safety ( N = 256 N{=}256 ; Section 2.3 ) evaluations, the simulation-trained agent and base model were likewise compared across matched scenarios using two-sided paired tests with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals over 10,000 scenario resamples. Secondary and exploratory endpoints were not corrected for multiple comparisons: the study was powered for a single pre-specified primary endpoint, and all secondary p p -values are reported as nominal and interpreted as hypothesis-generating rather than confirmatory.

blocks.en: A.6 Instrument Reliability for OSCE Transcript Ratings
blocks.zh: A.6 欧安组织记录片评级的文书可靠性

blocks.en: Each OSCE transcript was scored by a single independent psychiatrist evaluator using the structured rating instruments described in Methods, Section 4.5 . Because the study design assigned one evaluator per transcript (rather than multiple evaluators per transcript), classical inter-rater reliability metrics (e.g., ICC between raters) are not applicable. Instead, we assessed internal consistency reliability of the multi-item rating instruments.
blocks.zh: 欧安组织的每份记录都由一个独立的心理医生评价员使用方法第4.5节所述的结构化评级工具打分。 由于研究设计为每份笔录指派了一名评价员(而不是每个笔录的多名评价员),古典的评分间可靠性衡量标准(如评分员之间的电算)不适用. 相反,我们评估了多项目评级工具的内部一致性可靠性。

blocks.en: The 18-item PACES-derived clinical skills rubric showed high internal consistency (Cronbach’s α = 0.963 \alpha=0.963 , k = 18 k=18 items, N = 70 N=70 complete cases), consistent with individual PACES sub-dimensions loading on a coherent construct. The complete-case N N is lower than 120 because evaluators could mark items “not applicable” when a transcript provided no scoring basis; per-item N N ranged from 102 to 119. Composite and per-dimension analyses used all available ratings rather than restricting to complete cases. The four-item differential diagnosis rubric also showed high consistency ( α = 0.925 \alpha=0.925 , k = 4 k=4 , N = 119 N=119 ). Two caveats apply. First, because each transcript was scored by one evaluator, we cannot estimate cross-rater reproducibility, and residual rater variance is unquantified. Second, α \alpha values above 0.95 conventionally suggest item redundancy or halo effects rather than instrument quality, so these coefficients should not be read as validating the rubric’s discriminant validity. Both limitations apply equally to both conditions and are unlikely to bias the within-scenario contrast, but they limit the precision of absolute score interpretation.
blocks.zh: 18-物品PACES衍生的临床技能标本显示出高度的内相一致性(Cronbach的α=0.963\alpha=0.963,k=18克=18个,N=70N=70个完整病例),与单个PACES子底部加载于相干构造上一致. 完整的案件N N 低于120,因为评价人员可以在记录中没有打分依据时标出“不适用的”项目;每个项目N N N 从102到119不等。 综合分析和逐个分析使用了所有可用的评级,而不是局限于完成案件。 四项差分诊断题还表现出高度一致性(α=0.925\alpha=0.925,k=4克=4,N=119N=119). 有两个警告。 第一,由于每份记录稿都是由一名评价员评出,所以我们不能估计交叉评分的可再生产性,剩余评分的相差是无法量化的. 第二,α-α值高于0.95在常规中暗示了项目冗余或光环效应而不是仪器质量,因此这些系数不应被理解为验证了Rumic的歧视性有效性. 这两种限制都同样适用于这两个条件,不太可能偏向场内对比,但它们限制了绝对分数解释的精确性.

blocks.en: C.1 Case Generation Protocol for Intake Evaluation
blocks.zh: C.1 个案生成评估协议

blocks.en: This appendix describes the methodology for generating and validating the 127 expert-curated scenarios that constitute the simulated psychiatric intake evaluation suite. These evaluation scenarios are distinct from the 48,243 training scenarios generated through the automated four-stage pipeline (Methods, Section 4.1 ); the evaluation cohort requires clinical-grade rigor and human expert validation at every stage.
blocks.zh: 本附录介绍了形成和验证构成模拟精神病摄入评估套件的127种专家确证情景的方法。 这些评价方案不同于通过自动化四阶段管道产生的48,243个培训方案(方法,第4.1节);评价组需要每个阶段的临床级硬度和人类专家验证。

blocks.en: C.1.1 Overview
blocks.zh: C.1.1 概览

blocks.en: The scenario construction process produced an initial pool of 128 candidate scenario specifications (32 per difficulty tier) using a structured specification-then-instantiation process. Specifications were designed by clinicians to cover the diagnostic, demographic, and difficulty taxonomy of outpatient psychiatry. A language model (Gemini 3.1 Pro 52 ) instantiated these specifications into complete scenario packages, each comprising a clinical vignette (the patient role sheet presented to the patient simulator or role-playing clinician-patient) and a scoring rubric (the ground-truth reference used for evaluation). Expert review across three iterative rounds (round 1: 89 approved, 38 revised, 1 rejected; round 2: 27 approved, 11 revised; round 3: 11 approved) validated, revised, or filtered candidates to yield the final 127-scenario evaluation set (99.2% net retention rate; 1 scenario rejected).
blocks.zh: 假设情景构建过程利用结构化的规格 -- -- 当时的证明程序,初步形成了128个候选假设情景规格(每难度等级为32个)。 临床医生设计了规格,以涵盖门诊精神病学的诊断、人口和困难分类。 一种语言模型(Gemini 3.1 Pro 52 )将这些规格即时化为完整的情景套件,每个套件包括一个临床活字(病人角色表提交给病人模拟器或角色扮演的临床医生-病人)和一个分数(用于评价的地-真参考). 专家审查分为三轮迭接(第1轮:89次核准,38次订正,1次否决;第2轮:27次核准,11次订正;第3轮:11次核准),对候选人进行验证、修订或过滤,以得出最后127项假设评价(99.2%的净保留率;1项假设被拒绝)。

blocks.en: C.1.2 Scenario package structure
blocks.zh: C.1.2 设想一揽子结构

blocks.en: Each candidate scenario consisted of two documents delivered together to expert reviewers.
blocks.zh: 每个候选设想方案包括向专家审评员提交的两份文件。

blocks.en: Clinical vignette (patient role sheet). The vignette presents the patient’s full profile in structured plain text: • Identity header : name, age, sex, ethnicity, occupation, living situation, and chief complaint phrased in lay language. • Opening statement : the patient’s self-presentation at encounter initiation, written in first person, reflecting their lay framing of distress and interpersonal posture toward clinicians. • Social and contextual background : housing, employment, daily routine, substance use, exercise, and diet relevant to the clinical picture. • Medical and psychiatric history : current and past diagnoses, prior psychiatric episodes, surgical history. • Current medications : full medication list with doses, including any medications that create pharmacological complexity (e.g., drug-drug interaction traps, contraindication scenarios). • Allergies, family history, and expectations : the patient’s stated fears, anticipated outcome, and interpersonal stance toward the evaluation. • Scripted patient questions : 2–4 in-character questions the patient will raise during the encounter, designed to test boundary maintenance or diagnostic probing. • Disclosure architecture : explicit rules specifying which clinical information is available freely, which requires the clinician to ask a specific targeted question, and which is only revealed after the clinician establishes rapport by validating the patient’s concerns. Each piece of trust-gated information includes the precise condition under which it unlocks (e.g., “reveal the prednisone timeline only if the clinician validates frustration with the evaluation and explains the medical rationale for the question”). • Observable behavioral cues : text-based behavioral markers the patient exhibits (e.g., rapid message cadence, capitalization, circumlocution, terse deflection) that a clinician should interpret as psychiatric signs.
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2018-10-21) (英语). Clinical vignette (病人角色表). 维涅特用结构简洁的文字来描述病人的全貌: 身份头:姓名、年龄、性别、种族、职业、生活状况,以及用非专业语言表达的主要投诉。 开场白:病人在初次见面时的自我介绍,用第一人称写作,反映了他们对临床医生的危难和人际关系。 社会背景和背景:住房、就业、日常活动、药物使用、运动以及与临床情况有关的饮食。 • 医学和精神病史:目前和过去的诊断、以前的精神病发作、手术史。 • 目前的药物:包括任何造成药物复杂性的药物(例如药物与药物相互作用的陷阱、禁药情况)在内的剂量完整的药物清单。 过敏症、家庭历史和期望:病人的恐惧、预期结果和对评价的人际立场。 • 脚本病人问题:2至4个特征问题,患者在遇到时将提出,旨在测试边界维护或诊断检测。 二. 支助 披露架构:明确规定哪些临床信息可以自由获取,这要求临床医生提出特定的目标问题,并且只有在临床医生通过验证病人的担忧来确立关系后才会披露。 每一份信任信息都包括解锁的确切条件(例如,“只有在临床医生证实对评价感到沮丧并解释问题的医疗理由时,才公布预先确定的时间表”。 • 可观察的行为提示:基于文字的行为标记病人的表征(例如,快速信息cadence、资本化、环绕、terse偏移),临床医生应将其解释为精神病症状。

blocks.en: Scoring rubric. The rubric provides the ground-truth reference against which agent performance is evaluated: • Primary diagnosis : ICD-10-CM code and full specifiers. • Active comorbid conditions : concurrent medical or psychiatric diagnoses relevant to management. • Ranked differential diagnosis : at least three plausible alternatives with brief rationale for each. • Evidence-based treatment plan : specific first-line and alternative pharmacological or psychotherapeutic interventions, dosing guidance, contraindicated agents with explicit rationale (e.g., absolute contraindications due to drug-drug interactions). • Clinical risk assessment : current suicidality, homicidality, and psychosocial risk factors. • Recommended investigations : in-visit text-based screening tools (e.g., C-SSRS, PHQ-9 administered via text) and laboratory or imaging studies to order. • Follow-up plan : timing and modality of next encounter. • Binary scoring checklist : 7–12 items (typically 8–12) specifying the concrete clinical actions a competent clinician must complete during the encounter. Each item is directly observable from the encounter transcript (e.g., “Elicits the timeline of the patient’s asthma exacerbation and recent initiation of high-dose prednisone to identify the substance-induced etiology of the mania.”). Items are written to resist credit for superficially correct but clinically inadequate responses: the criterion specifies the target clinical information, not merely the topic area.
blocks.zh: 分红花. · 初级诊断:ICD-10-CM编码和全分光仪。 主动症状:同时进行与管理有关的医疗或精神病诊断。 • 分级诊断:至少三种可行的替代办法,每种办法都有简单的理由。 · 循证治疗计划:具体的一线和替代药物或心理治疗干预、指导、有明确理由的禁药剂(例如,由于药物与药物的相互作用而产生的绝对禁药)。 • 临床风险评估:目前的自杀、杀人和心理风险因素。 • 建议的调查:访问基于文本的筛选工具(例如通过文本管理的C-SSRS、PHQ-9)和实验室或成像研究。 • 后续计划:下一次接触的时间和方式。 二. 支助 二进制评分清单:7至12项(通常为8至12项),具体说明合格临床医生在接触时必须完成的具体临床行动。 从接触记录中可直接看到每个物品(例如, " 规定病人哮喘发作的时间以及最近开始服用高剂量先天性素,以识别由物质引起的狂躁症病理)。 撰写项目是为了抵挡表面正确但临床上不充分的反应:标准规定了目标临床信息,而不仅仅是主题领域。

blocks.en: An illustrative complete scenario package, including clinical vignette and full scoring rubric, is provided in the following example. The scenario depicts a 27-year-old male software developer presenting for mandatory psychiatric clearance, with a concealed steroid-induced manic episode and a high-risk drug interaction trap (Lithium carries a clinically significant risk with concurrent HCTZ and Losartan).
blocks.zh: 以下例子提供了一个说明性的完整方案包,包括临床卷发和满分分分红。 剧情描绘了一位27岁的男性软件开发者提出强制性的精神病审核,其中隐藏有类固醇引发的狂躁症发作和高危药物相互作用陷阱(Lithium与同时存在的HCTZ和Losartan承担了临床上的重大风险).

blocks.en:
You are Connor Bradley.
Age: 27 | Sex: Male | Ethnicity: White
Chief concern: mandatory psychiatric clearance for erratic behavior at work

Opening statement: "I don’t even know why HR is forcing me to do this chat.
I sent a few visionary emails to the executive team about restructuring the
company, and now they want ’psychiatric clearance.’ I’m fine. I’m just
operating on a higher frequency than them. Just sign the form so I can get
back to work. I have zero patience for doctors analyzing me, so make this quick."

Background: Lives alone. Senior software developer, currently on forced
administrative leave. Recently began day trading heavily with his savings
during the night. Drinks ˜1 glass of wine/week. Denies illicit drug use.
Currently sleeping 1-2 hours per night (claims no fatigue). Diet sporadic.

Medical history: Essential hypertension (since age 24) with left ventricular
hypertrophy and repolarization abnormalities on recent ECG. Severe persistent
asthma. No prior psychiatric episodes.

Current medications: Prednisone 60mg daily (started 14 days ago); Losartan
50mg daily; Hydrochlorothiazide 25mg daily; Amlodipine 5mg daily; Symbicort
160/4.5mcg 2 puffs BID; Albuterol PRN.

Allergies, family history, and expectations: No known drug allergies (NKDA).
Father has hypertension; maternal aunt has history of "mood swings" (never
formally diagnosed). Fears being labeled "mentally unstable" or losing his job;
expects an immediate return-to-work clearance letter without medication changes.

Scripted patient questions:
  - "Are you going to sign my HR clearance form today or waste my time?"
  - "Why are you asking about my asthma inhalers and blood pressure pills when
     this is supposed to be a work clearance?"
  - "Why would I want to slow my brain down when I’m finally doing the best
     coding and trading of my life?"

Disclosure architecture:
  - FREELY AVAILABLE: work history, HR referral circumstance, hostility.
  - INQUIRY-GATED (requires direct targeted question): sleep duration (1-2h),
    energy and thought speed, day trading at 3 AM.
  - TRUST-GATED (only after explicit validation of frustration +
    medical rationale explained): prednisone timeline ("had a severe asthma
    flare 2 weeks ago, they threw me on massive steroids which coincidentally
    unlocked my brain"), chest palpitations and left-sided atypical chest
    pressure at rest.

Observable behavioral cues: responses extremely rapid, often 3-4 consecutive
messages; long run-on sentences with minimal punctuation; ALL CAPS on grandiose
concepts; overtly hostile and condescending; marked circumstantiality
about company restructuring ideas; abrupt and evasive about
psychiatric/medical history.
blocks.zh:
你是康纳・布拉德利。
年龄:27岁 性别: 种族:白人
主要关切:对工作中的异常行为进行强制精神检查

我甚至不知道HR为何强迫我进行这次聊天。
我给执行组发了几封有远见的邮件 关于重组
现在他们想要“精神病检查 ” 。 我没事。 我只不过
运行频率高于他们。 只要在表格上签名,我就可以得到
继续工作 我对医生分析我毫无耐心,所以快一点。”

背景情况: 独活一身. 高级软件开发商,目前被迫
行政请假。 最近开始用他的积蓄大量交易
在夜间。 喝一杯酒/周饮. 拒绝使用非法药物。
目前每晚睡觉1-2小时(声称没有疲劳). 零星饮食.

病史: 基本高血压(自24岁起),有口腔
近期ECG的超营养和再极化异常. 严重的持久性
哮喘发作. 没有之前的精神病发作

现有药物: (14天前开始)
每日50克;每日25克;每日5克;
160/4.5毫克克/秒 BID; 阿尔布特罗PRN.

过敏症、家庭历史和期望: 没有已知的药物过敏症(NKDA).
父亲有高血压;母姨有"木头秋千"的历史(从来没有)
(正式诊断)。 担心被贴上"精神不稳定"的标签或失业;
要求立即发出返回工作许可函,不更改药品。

脚本病人问题:
- "你今天要签我的人力资源审核表还是浪费我的时间?"
- 你为什么问我的哮喘吸入器和血压药
这应该是工作许可吗?"
- "当我终于做到最好的时候,我为什么要减慢我的大脑"
我生命的编码和交易?"

披露结构:
- 自由易行:工作历史、人力资源转介情况、敌意。
- 睡眠时间(1-2小时),
能量和思维速度, 白天交易在凌晨3点。
- 信任-加泰德(仅在明确确认挫折后) +
医生解释理由: 早尼松时间线("患有严重的哮喘")
两周前,他们把我扔到 巨大的类固醇上,巧合的是
解开我的大脑 胸前出血 左侧非典型胸口
压力在休息。

可观察的行为提示:反应极快,往往连续3-4次
消息; 有最小分数的长句; 全部 CAPS 在 grandiose 上
概念;明显敌对和屈尊;明显间接性
关于公司重组的想法; 突然和回避
精神病/医疗史。

blocks.en:
Primary Diagnosis: Substance/Medication-Induced Bipolar and Related Disorder,
  with onset during corticosteroid treatment (ICD-10-CM: F19.94)
Active Comorbidities: Essential hypertension (I10);
  severe persistent asthma (J45.50)
Differential:
  1. Bipolar I disorder, current episode manic, severe (F31.13) -- plausible
     given grandiosity, decreased need for sleep, and reckless financial/work
     behavior, but symptom onset is temporally locked to high-dose prednisone
     initiation with no prior affective episodes.
  2. Hyperthyroidism / thyrotoxicosis (E05.90) -- can present with adrenergic
     hyperarousal, insomnia, irritability, and palpitations; must be excluded
     via TSH/free T4.
  3. Schizoaffective disorder, bipolar type (F25.0) -- grandiose beliefs lack
     fixed bizarre delusions or hallucinations outside the acute steroid-induced
     mood elevation.

Treatment Plan:
  - Coordinate with primary care/pulmonology to begin Prednisone taper
    (decrease by 10-20mg every few days as asthma tolerates).
  - Initiate Divalproex sodium 500mg daily (or Aripiprazole 5mg daily)
    for acute mood stabilization during taper.
  - Lithium: avoid in this regimen. Concurrent thiazide (HCTZ) and
    angiotensin receptor blockers (losartan) reduce renal lithium clearance
    and can raise serum lithium into the toxic range; concurrent use
    requires either substitution of an alternative mood stabiliser or
    substantial dose reduction with intensive level monitoring. Given
    equally appropriate alternatives (divalproex or a low-QTc-risk
    second-generation antipsychotic), lithium is not the preferred
    agent here.
  - Avoid high QTc-risk antipsychotics given LVH and repolarization
    abnormalities.

Risk Assessment: No acute suicidality/homicidality; high psychosocial and
financial risk (day trading, occupational impairment) and moderate acute
cardiovascular risk (resting palpitations and atypical chest pressure on
high-dose corticosteroid with preexisting LVH).

Recommended Investigations:
  - In-visit text-based screening: Young Mania Rating Scale (YMRS) target
    domains and C-SSRS suicide screening.
  - Laboratory/diagnostic workup: 12-lead ECG and troponin (given chest
    pressure, palpitations, and prior LVH/repolarization abnormalities),
    comprehensive metabolic panel (CMP), CBC, TSH/free T4, urine drug screen,
    and baseline hepatic function/valproic acid monitoring labs.

Follow-Up Plan: Urgent in-person medical evaluation for chest pressure and
palpitations; outpatient psychiatric follow-up within 48-72 hours (coupled
with same-day communication to pulmonology/primary care for steroid taper);
withhold return-to-work clearance until acute manic symptoms resolve.

Scoring Checklist:
  [ ] Validates frustration, explains medical rationale before asking questions,
      navigating severe alliance rupture.
  [ ] Elicits prednisone timeline to identify substance-induced manic etiology.
  [ ] Confirms decreased need for sleep (1-2h, feels rested and electric).
  [ ] Screens for high-risk manic behaviors: financial recklessness (day
      trading) and impulsive occupational actions.
  [ ] Identifies clinically significant Lithium interaction (HCTZ + Losartan).
  [ ] Selects safe mood stabilizer (Divalproex or low-QTc-risk antipsychotic).
  [ ] Recommends coordinated prednisone taper with primary care/pulmonology.
  [ ] Screens for cardiac symptoms (palpitations, chest pressure) via text.
blocks.zh:
初级诊断:物质/药物诱发的两极病和有关疾病,
在皮质类固醇处理过程中发作(ICD-10-CM:F19.94)
活跃社区:基本高血压(I10);
严重慢性哮喘(J45.50)
差别 :
1. 双极I型紊乱症,目前剧情狂躁,严重(F31.13) -- -- 可能
高贵,睡眠需求减少,以及鲁莽的经济/工作
行为,但症状的发作 暂时锁定在高剂量先尼索内
启动时未发生任何先发性事件。
2. 超甲状腺素/胸肌中毒(E05.90) -- -- 可以用肾上腺素来呈现

blocks.en: Each candidate scenario was reviewed by three independent, board-certified psychiatrists (ABPN or international equivalent; ≥ \geq 2 years post-certification; active clinical caseload ≥ \geq 10 patient-contact hours/week; no involvement in AI system development). Reviewers operated independently with no access to other reviewers’ assessments. Expert panel demographics are reported in Appendix B ; inter-rater reliability for scenario validation (Gwet’s AC1) is reported in Methods, Section 4.6 .
C.1.3 Validation rubric
blocks.zh: C.1.3 审定分号

blocks.en: Each reviewer scored every scenario on 8 criteria using defined scales with minimum thresholds. All 8 criteria must meet threshold for a scenario to receive an APPROVE verdict.
blocks.zh: 每个审查者按照8个标准对每个情况进行评分,采用设定的最低门槛比额表。 所有8个标准都必须达到一个假设情况得到核准判决的门槛。

blocks.en: “Could a patient matching this description present to a psychiatric clinic with these symptoms, history, and circumstances?”
blocks.zh: “一个符合这些症状、历史和情况的病人能否向精神病诊所提供这种描述? “

blocks.en: Score Definition 1 The combination of symptoms, demographics, and history is clinically implausible (e.g., a 19-year-old with 15 years of treatment-resistant schizophrenia). 2 The presentation is theoretically possible but would be extremely rare and would raise immediate suspicion in a clinical setting. 3 The presentation is clinically plausible but contains minor elements that feel artificial or contrived. 4 The presentation reads like a real patient; nothing jumps out as implausible. 5 The presentation is so clinically detailed and realistic it could serve as a teaching case.
blocks.zh: 分数定义 1 症状,人口统计,和历史的结合在临床上是不可信的(如19岁有15年耐治疗精神分裂症). 2 介绍在理论上是可能的,但极为罕见,在临床环境中会立即引起怀疑。 3个 其表述在临床上是可信的,但包含一些小元素,它们感觉是人工的或被构思的. 页:1 演示文稿读作"真正的病人";没有任何东西跳出不可信. 页:1 报告在临床上非常详细和现实,可以作为教学案例。

blocks.en: Threshold: ≥ \geq 4. Common failures: age-impossible diagnoses (e.g., personality disorder diagnosed at age 12); medication regimens no competent physician would prescribe (e.g., two concurrent SSRIs without rationale); symptom timelines violating standard DSM-5-TR duration criteria (e.g., two days of elevated mood diagnosed as Bipolar I mania in the absence of hospitalization or psychotic features, or two weeks of generalized worry diagnosed as GAD); internally inconsistent demographic details (e.g., “retired” + age 28).
blocks.zh: 阈值 : \ \ geq 4. 常见的失误:年龄诊断(例如,12岁时诊断出人格障碍);没有合格的医生会开药(例如,两个并行的SSRI);症状时限违反标准的DSM-5-TR持续时间标准(例如,在没有住院或精神病特征的情况下,两天的情绪升高被诊断为双极I狂躁症,或两周的普遍焦虑被诊断为GAD);内部的人口细节不一致(例如,“退休”+28岁)。

blocks.en: “Are the listed symptoms, pertinent positives, pertinent negatives, and history internally consistent with the ground-truth diagnosis?”
blocks.zh: “所列症状、相关阳性反应、相关阴性反应和内部历史是否与地面真实诊断一致? “

blocks.en: Score Definition 1 Symptoms directly contradict the listed diagnosis. 2 Symptoms are vaguely consistent but important diagnostic criteria are missing. 3 Most standard diagnostic criteria are met, but there are minor gaps or inconsistencies. 4 All relevant diagnostic criteria are clearly represented in the symptom profile. 5 Symptoms map precisely to standard diagnostic criteria; pertinent negatives actively rule out key differentials.
blocks.zh: 分数定义 1 症状直接与所列诊断相矛盾。 2 症状模糊一致,但缺少重要的诊断标准。 3个 多数标准诊断标准都得到满足,但存在小的差距或不一致. 页:1 所有相关诊断标准都明确体现在症状简介中。 5 症状精确地映射到标准的诊断标准;相关的负面因素积极排除了关键差异。

blocks.en: Threshold: ≥ \geq 3. Reviewers check: (a) symptom timeline meets diagnostic duration requirements (e.g., MDD ≥ \geq 2 weeks); (b) sufficient diagnostic criteria are present (e.g., MDD requires ≥ \geq 5 of 9 criteria); (c) pertinent negatives are consistent with the primary diagnosis rather than an alternative; and (d) the differential list includes reasonable alternatives.
blocks.zh: 阈值 :\\\ geq 3. 审查者检查:(a) 症状时间符合诊断持续时间的要求(例如,MDD \\\ geq 2周);(b) 有足够的诊断标准(例如,MDD要求为9个标准中的 \\\\ geq 5);(c) 相关的阴性与初级诊断一致,而不是一个替代品;(d) 差异清单包括合理的替代品。

blocks.en: “Is the listed diagnosis the most likely primary diagnosis given the full clinical picture?”
blocks.zh: “从临床的全貌来看,列出的诊断是否是最可能的初级诊断? “

blocks.en: Responses: Agree / Partially agree / Disagree. Threshold: Agree or Partially agree. Partially agree and Disagree responses require a documented preferred diagnosis with ICD-10-CM code and 2–3 sentence rationale. This is treated as one of the most valuable outputs of the review process: reviewer disagreements surface genuinely ambiguous presentations and trigger re-evaluation of the ground-truth assignment.
blocks.zh: 答复:同意/部分同意/不同意。 门槛:同意或部分同意。 部分同意和不同意的回答要求用ICD-10-CM编码和2-3句子的理由来进行有文件证明的首选诊断。 这被视为审查过程最有价值的产出之一:审查者意见不一,显示出真正模棱两可的表述,并引发对实地真相任务的重新评价。

blocks.en: “Does the assigned difficulty tier accurately reflect the clinical complexity?”
blocks.zh: “所分配的困难层次是否准确地反映了临床的复杂性? “

blocks.en: Responses: Correct / Off by 1. Threshold: Correct. Off-by-1 responses specify the direction of miscalibration. Tier definitions follow Appendix C.1.7 . A PGY-2 resident should manage Easy cases competently; Edge cases would challenge experienced attending psychiatrists.
blocks.zh: 答复:正确/1。 门槛:正确。 离一反应指定了误判方向. 等级定义见附录C.1.7。 一名PGY-2号居民应当能胜任地处理容易处理的案件;边缘案件将对有经验的精神病医生提出质疑。

blocks.en: “Is the stratification of information (free / inquiry-gated / trust-gated) clinically realistic, and does it produce meaningful differences in encounter difficulty?”
blocks.zh: “信息的分层(自由/询问/信任)在临床上是否现实,在遭遇困难方面是否产生有意义的差异? “

blocks.en: Scale: 1–5 Likert. Threshold: ≥ \geq 4. A score of 4 requires that trust-gated information is withheld in a manner consistent with real patient behavior and that its elicitation requires specific clinical skill. A score of 3 or below indicates that the gating conditions are arbitrary or that the information would plausibly be volunteered by any real patient without targeted inquiry.
blocks.zh: 缩放: 1–5 Impert. 阈值 :\\\ geq 4. 4分要求以与真正的病人行为相符的方式不提供信任信息,并且其诱导需要特定的临床技能。 3分或以下的分数表明,取景条件是任意的,或者任何真正的病人在没有目标调查的情况下都会合理地主动提供相关信息.

blocks.en: “Are the checklist items observable from the transcript, correctly linked to clinical actions, and resistant to credit from clinically inadequate responses?”
blocks.zh: “从记录中看,核对表项目是否与临床行动有正确联系,对临床反应不足的功劳有抵抗力? “

blocks.en: Scale: 1–5 Likert. Threshold: ≥ \geq 4. Rubric items must specify the target clinical information, not merely the topic area. An item reading “asks about sleep” earns a score of 2; an item reading “confirms decreased need for sleep (patient reports 1–2 hours per night, feels fully rested)” earns a score of 4–5.
blocks.zh: 缩放: 1–5 Impert. 阈值 :\\\ geq 4. Rubric项目必须具体说明目标临床信息,而不仅仅是主题领域。 读作 " 睡眠任务 " 的项目得分为2;读作 " 确认睡眠需求减少(病人报告每晚1至2小时,感觉完全休息) " 的项目得分为4至5。

blocks.en: “Does the treatment plan reflect current clinical practice guidelines?”
blocks.zh: “治疗计划是否反映了目前的临床实践准则? “

blocks.en: Scale: 1–5 Likert. Threshold: ≥ \geq 4. Reviewers check medication choices, dosing, contraindication documentation, and concordance with APA, NICE, or CANMAT guidelines as applicable. Drug interaction traps embedded in the scenario (as clinical challenge elements) must be correctly identified as contraindications in the rubric.
blocks.zh: 缩放: 1–5 Impert. 阈值 :\\\ geq 4. 审查人员检查药物选择、剂量、禁用文件,并酌情与APA、NICE或CANMAT准则保持一致。 假想中嵌入的药物相互作用陷阱(作为临床挑战要素)必须被正确确定为标点中的相反.

blocks.en: “Does the scenario avoid modeling clinical errors as ground truth, providing harmful advice, or containing content harmful if viewed out of context?”
blocks.zh: “情况是否避免将临床错误模拟为地面真相,提供有害的建议,或如果脱离上下文而含有有害的内容? “

blocks.en: Response: Pass / Fail. Threshold: Pass. Automatic rejection if a scenario presents a dangerous clinical error (e.g., prescribing an absolutely contraindicated medication) as the correct management without explicit labeling as an educational trap.
blocks.zh: 答复:通过/失败。 阈值: Pass. 如果出现危险的临床错误(例如开出绝对禁药处方),则自动拒绝作为正确的管理方式,而没有明确标注为教育陷阱。

blocks.en: C.1.4 Review outcomes and acceptance rule
blocks.zh: C.1.4 审查结果和接受规则

blocks.en: For each scenario, each of the three independent reviewers assigned one of three outcomes: • APPROVE : Passes all 8 criteria. The scenario enters the final evaluation set without modification. • REVISE : Fails 1–3 criteria, salvageable. The reviewer provides specific revision instructions. The revised scenario is returned for re-review by the same reviewer. • REJECT : Fails ≥ \geq 4 criteria or contains a fundamental clinical error. The scenario is discarded from the evaluation suite.
blocks.zh: 就每个设想情况而言,三个独立审评员各自分配了三个结果中的一个: 批准:通过所有8个标准。 该设想方案未经修改而进入最后评价集。 • 答复:1至3项标准不合格,可以打捞。 审查者提供具体的修订指示。 经修订的设想方案由同一审查人退回重新审查。 ● REJECT:没有 \\ geq 4 标准或含有基本的临床错误。 评价套间中放弃了这一设想。

blocks.en: APPROVE : Passes all 8 criteria. The scenario enters the final evaluation set without modification.
blocks.zh: 核准:通过所有8项标准。 该设想方案未经修改而进入最后评价集。

blocks.en: REVISE : Fails 1–3 criteria, salvageable. The reviewer provides specific revision instructions. The revised scenario is returned for re-review by the same reviewer.
blocks.zh: 回复:1–3标准失败,可打捞. 审查者提供具体的修订指示。 经修订的设想方案由同一审查人退回重新审查。

blocks.en: REJECT : Fails ≥ \geq 4 criteria or contains a fundamental clinical error. The scenario is discarded from the evaluation suite.
blocks.zh: REJECT: 失败 \\ geq 4 标准或包含基本临床错误. 评价套间中放弃了这一设想。

blocks.en: Final acceptance rule. At least 2 of 3 reviewers must assign APPROVE (directly or after revision accepted) for a scenario to enter the final evaluation suite. Scenarios with majority REJECT verdicts are discarded. The expert panel conducted 128 candidate scenario evaluations across three review rounds (round 1: 89 approved, 38 revised, 1 rejected; round 2: 27 approved, 11 revised; round 3: 11 approved) to produce the final 127-scenario evaluation suite (99.2% net retention rate; 1 scenario rejected). Expert panel demographics are reported in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 最后接受规则。 3名审查人员中至少有2名必须指定批准(直接或经修订后接受)才能进入最后评价套件。 具有多数REJECT判决的假想被抛弃. 专家小组在三轮审查中进行了128次候选人假想评价(第1轮:89次核准,38次订正,1次否决;第2轮:27次核准,11次订正;第3轮:11次核准),以制作最终的127个假想评价套件(99.2%的净保留率;1次方案被否决)。 专家小组的人口统计数据见附录B。

blocks.en: C.1.5 Diagnostic and Competency Categories
blocks.zh: C.1.5 诊断和能力类别

blocks.en: The simulated psychiatric intake evaluation spans 8 categories covering the breadth of outpatient psychiatric practice. Six categories target core diagnostic domains:
blocks.zh: 模拟精神病学摄入评价涵盖8个类别,涵盖门诊精神病学实践的广度。 六类针对核心诊断领域:

blocks.en: 1. Mood Disorders : Major depressive disorder across episode types (single, recurrent, with anxious distress, with melancholic features, with psychotic features, with peripartum onset), bipolar spectrum including bipolar I, bipolar II, cyclothymic disorder, and premenstrual dysphoric disorder. 2. Anxiety and Stress-Related Disorders : Generalized anxiety disorder, panic disorder, social anxiety disorder, post-traumatic stress disorder, obsessive-compulsive disorder, illness anxiety disorder, and adjustment disorders across subtypes. 3. Psychotic Spectrum : Schizophrenia across presentation subtypes (paranoid, disorganized, catatonic features, negative-symptom-predominant), schizoaffective disorder, delusional disorder, brief psychotic disorder, and substance-induced psychosis. 4. Substance Use Disorders : Alcohol, opioid, stimulant, cannabis, benzodiazepine, and polysubstance use disorders, including substance-induced mood presentations and dual-diagnosis scenarios. 5. Personality and Complex Presentations : Borderline, antisocial, narcissistic, avoidant, dependent, and obsessive-compulsive personality disorders; complex PTSD; dissociative presentations; and somatic symptom disorder. 6. Other Presentations : ADHD across subtypes (predominantly inattentive, combined, late-diagnosis adult), eating disorders (anorexia nervosa, bulimia nervosa, binge eating disorder), sleep disorders, autism spectrum disorder in adults, and gender dysphoria.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 杂乱无章: 各种剧集类型(单发,反复发作,有焦虑的忧郁症,有忧郁症特征,有精神病特征,有围产期发作),双极谱包括双极一,双极二,环生障碍,以及前期障碍. 2. 焦虑和与压力有关的障碍:普遍焦虑障碍、恐慌障碍、社会焦虑障碍、创伤后应激障碍、强迫性障碍、疾病焦虑障碍和各种亚型的调整障碍。 3. 精神分裂症:精神分裂症跨越演示亚型(妄想症,组织混乱症,发作性特征,负-症状-主发性),精神分裂症,妄想症,短暂精神障碍,以及由物质引起的精神病. 4. 药物使用障碍:酒精、类阿片、兴奋剂、大麻、苯并二氮杂卓和多物质使用障碍,包括物质引起的情绪介绍和双重诊断情况。 5. 人格和复杂陈述:边际、反社会、自恋、避让、依赖和强迫性人格障碍;复杂的创伤后精神紧张症;分离陈述;以及身体症状障碍。 6. 其他介绍:跨亚型的ADHD(主要是不敏症、综合症、晚期诊断的成年人)、饮食障碍(神经性神经病、暴发性神经病、宾格饮食障碍)、睡眠障碍、成人自闭症谱系障碍和性别障碍。

blocks.en: Mood Disorders : Major depressive disorder across episode types (single, recurrent, with anxious distress, with melancholic features, with psychotic features, with peripartum onset), bipolar spectrum including bipolar I, bipolar II, cyclothymic disorder, and premenstrual dysphoric disorder.
blocks.zh: 杂乱无章: 各种剧集类型(单发,反复发作,有焦虑的忧郁症,有忧郁症特征,有精神病性特征,有围产期发作),双极谱包括双极一,双极二,环生障碍,以及前期障碍.

blocks.en: Anxiety and Stress-Related Disorders : Generalized anxiety disorder, panic disorder, social anxiety disorder, post-traumatic stress disorder, obsessive-compulsive disorder, illness anxiety disorder, and adjustment disorders across subtypes.
blocks.zh: 焦虑和与压力有关的障碍:普遍焦虑障碍、恐慌障碍、社会焦虑障碍、创伤后应激障碍、强迫症、疾病焦虑障碍和各种亚型的调整障碍。

blocks.en: Psychotic Spectrum : Schizophrenia across presentation subtypes (paranoid, disorganized, catatonic features, negative-symptom-predominant), schizoaffective disorder, delusional disorder, brief psychotic disorder, and substance-induced psychosis.
blocks.zh: 精神分裂症:精神分裂症跨越演示亚型(妄想症,组织混乱症,发作性特征,负-症状-先发性),精神分裂症,妄想症,短暂精神障碍,以及由物质引起的精神病.

blocks.en: Substance Use Disorders : Alcohol, opioid, stimulant, cannabis, benzodiazepine, and polysubstance use disorders, including substance-induced mood presentations and dual-diagnosis scenarios.
blocks.zh: 药物使用障碍:酒精、类阿片、兴奋剂、大麻、苯并二氮杂卓和多物质使用障碍,包括物质引起的情绪介绍和双重诊断情况。

blocks.en: Personality and Complex Presentations : Borderline, antisocial, narcissistic, avoidant, dependent, and obsessive-compulsive personality disorders; complex PTSD; dissociative presentations; and somatic symptom disorder.
blocks.zh: 人格和复杂陈述:边际、反社会、自恋、避让、依赖和强迫性人格障碍;复杂的创伤后精神紧张症;离散陈述;以及身体症状障碍。

blocks.en: Other Presentations : ADHD across subtypes (predominantly inattentive, combined, late-diagnosis adult), eating disorders (anorexia nervosa, bulimia nervosa, binge eating disorder), sleep disorders, autism spectrum disorder in adults, and gender dysphoria.
blocks.zh: 其他介绍:跨亚型的ADHD(主要为不敏症,综合症,晚期诊断成人),饮食障碍(野外神经病,bulimia nervosa,宾格饮食障碍),睡眠障碍,成人自闭症谱系障碍,以及性别障碍.

blocks.en: Two additional categories test competencies that transcend diagnostic boundaries:
blocks.zh: 另两类测试超越诊断界限的能力:

blocks.en: 7. Medical Mimics : Somatic conditions presenting as psychiatric illness, including endocrine mimics (hypothyroidism presenting as depression, Cushing’s syndrome presenting as psychosis), autoimmune mimics (autoimmune encephalitis mimicking acute psychosis, lupus cerebritis presenting as mood disorder), neurological mimics (frontotemporal dementia presenting as personality change, Wilson’s disease presenting as psychiatric illness), and iatrogenic mimics (steroid-induced mania, SSRI discontinuation syndrome mimicking relapse, medication-induced akathisia mimicking anxiety). This category specifically tests whether clinicians pursue the medical workup necessary to identify non-psychiatric etiologies, a critical competency that purely psychiatric evaluations do not assess. 8. Challenging Encounters : High-stakes clinical situations including acute safety crisis (active risk with plan and means), intimate partner violence (IPV) disclosure during unrelated visit, involuntary psychiatric evaluation, treatment refusal with active psychosis, malingering with secondary gain motive, and caregiver burnout with compassion fatigue. This category tests clinical judgment under conditions of interpersonal conflict, legal complexity, and competing ethical obligations.
blocks.zh: 7. 联合国 医学模拟:作为精神疾病呈现的生理状况,包括内分泌模拟症(以抑郁为表现,Cushing综合症以精神疾病),自体免疫模拟症(自发性脑炎以急性精神疾病为表现,脑膜炎以情绪紊乱为表现),神经模拟症(以人格改变为表现,威尔逊疾病以精神疾病为表现)和过量致病模拟症(小行星引起的动因症,SSRI停止综合症模仿复发,由药物引起的脑膜炎模仿焦虑症)。 这一类别具体地检验临床医生是否进行了必要的医疗检查,以确定非精神病原体,而纯粹的心理评估并不评估这种关键能力。 8. 挑战性应对:临床情况严重,包括急性安全危机(有计划和手段的积极风险)、在不相关访问期间披露亲密伴侣的暴力行为、非自愿的精神病评估、主动精神病治疗的拒绝、二次致病动机的失真以及同情疲劳症的护理人员。 这一类别在人际冲突、法律复杂性和相互竞争的道德义务的条件下检验临床判断。

blocks.en: Medical Mimics : Somatic conditions presenting as psychiatric illness, including endocrine mimics (hypothyroidism presenting as depression, Cushing’s syndrome presenting as psychosis), autoimmune mimics (autoimmune encephalitis mimicking acute psychosis, lupus cerebritis presenting as mood disorder), neurological mimics (frontotemporal dementia presenting as personality change, Wilson’s disease presenting as psychiatric illness), and iatrogenic mimics (steroid-induced mania, SSRI discontinuation syndrome mimicking relapse, medication-induced akathisia mimicking anxiety). This category specifically tests whether clinicians pursue the medical workup necessary to identify non-psychiatric etiologies, a critical competency that purely psychiatric evaluations do not assess.

This category tests clinical judgment under conditions of interpersonal conflict, legal complexity, and competing ethical obligations.

blocks.en: C.1.6 Clinical Specification Framework
blocks.zh: C.1.6 临床规格框架

blocks.en: Each scenario was constructed according to a five-axis clinical specification framework:
blocks.zh: 每种情况都按照五轴临床规格框架构建:

blocks.en: • Axis 1 (Presentation Type) : Specifies diagnostic complexity, ranging from standard textbook presentations to obscure somatic mimics or highly atypical cases where standard diagnostic cues are absent or distorted. • Axis 2 (Comorbidity Burden) : Controls the number and severity of co-occurring conditions, from none (Easy) to 2–3 interacting conditions that compound safety risk and restrict available treatment paths (Edge). • Axis 3 (Pharmacological Complexity) : Ranges from straightforward first-line prescribing to extreme prescribing traps involving severe drug-drug interactions embedded in the patient’s medication list (e.g., a patient on hydrochlorothiazide and losartan for whom lithium carries a clinically significant risk of toxic accumulation and is therefore not the preferred agent). • Axis 4 (Communication Dynamics) : Specifies the patient’s cooperativeness (scored 1–5 on an effort scale), alliance rupture type and severity, and behavioral presentation through text. • Axis 5 (Crisis and Safety Risk) : Ranges from no safety concern to high-severity crises in which the patient actively minimizes or conceals acute risk, requiring sensitive elicitation.
blocks.zh: • 轴1(说明类型): 指定诊断的复杂性,从标准教科书演示到模糊的模仿或高度非典型的没有标准诊断提示或扭曲的病例。 • 第2轴(商业负担): 控制共同发生的病情的数量和严重程度,从零起(容易起)到2至3起相互作用,使安全风险复杂化并限制可用治疗途径(Edge)。 • 轴3(药理复杂): 从直截了当的一线处方到极端处方的陷阱,包括病人药物清单中包含的严重药物相互作用(例如,一名在盐酸亚齐德和洛桑岛的病人,在临床上,锂具有严重的累积毒性风险,因此不是首选制剂)。 • 轴4(通信动态): 指定患者的合作性(在努力尺度上得分1比5),联盟破裂类型和严重程度,以及行为表现。 • 轴5(危机和安全风险): 从无安全顾虑到高度严重危机,患者在危机中积极将急性风险降到最低或隐匿,需要敏感地引出.

blocks.en: Axis 1 (Presentation Type) : Specifies diagnostic complexity, ranging from standard textbook presentations to obscure somatic mimics or highly atypical cases where standard diagnostic cues are absent or distorted.
blocks.zh: 轴 1 (简介类型) : 指定诊断的复杂性,从标准教科书演示到模糊的模仿或高度非典型的没有标准诊断提示或扭曲的病例。

blocks.en: Axis 2 (Comorbidity Burden) : Controls the number and severity of co-occurring conditions, from none (Easy) to 2–3 interacting conditions that compound safety risk and restrict available treatment paths (Edge).
blocks.zh: 轴2 (商品负担): 控制共同发生的病情的数量和严重程度,从零起(容易起)到2至3起相互作用,使安全风险复杂化并限制可用治疗途径(Edge)。

blocks.en: Axis 3 (Pharmacological Complexity) : Ranges from straightforward first-line prescribing to extreme prescribing traps involving severe drug-drug interactions embedded in the patient’s medication list (e.g., a patient on hydrochlorothiazide and losartan for whom lithium carries a clinically significant risk of toxic accumulation and is therefore not the preferred agent).
blocks.zh: 轴3(药理复杂): 从直截了当的一线处方到极端处方的陷阱,包括病人药物清单中包含的严重药物相互作用(例如,一名在盐酸亚齐德和洛桑岛的病人,在临床上,锂具有严重的累积毒性风险,因此不是首选制剂)。

blocks.en: Axis 4 (Communication Dynamics) : Specifies the patient’s cooperativeness (scored 1–5 on an effort scale), alliance rupture type and severity, and behavioral presentation through text.
blocks.zh: 轴4(通信动态): 指定患者的合作程度(在努力尺度上得分1-5),联盟破裂类型和严重程度,以及行为表现。

blocks.en: Axis 5 (Crisis and Safety Risk) : Ranges from no safety concern to high-severity crises in which the patient actively minimizes or conceals acute risk, requiring sensitive elicitation.
blocks.zh: 轴5(危机和安全风险): 从无安全顾虑到高度严重危机,患者在危机中积极将急性风险降到最低或隐匿,需要敏感地引出.

blocks.en: C.1.7 Difficulty Tier Specifications
blocks.zh: C.1.7 难度等级规格

blocks.en: Scenario complexity is varied across four tiers defined along the five clinical axes above. The initial pool of 128 specifications (32 per tier) was submitted for expert review; one was rejected, and reviewer feedback prompted reclassification of several scenarios across tiers, yielding the final distribution below.
blocks.zh: 情景复杂程度依上述五个临床轴所定义的四级不同。 首批128项规格(每级32项)已提交专家审查;1项被拒绝,审评员的反馈促使对不同层级的若干设想进行重新分类,最终分配如下。

blocks.en: Textbook-concordant cases with a single diagnosis, no comorbidities, standard first-line pharmacotherapy, cooperative patients, and no acute safety concerns. A PGY-2 psychiatry resident should manage these competently.
blocks.zh: 教科书-协和病例采用单一诊断,无同症,标准一线药理,合作患者,无急性安全隐患. PGY-2精神病患者应当对这些疾病进行有效管理。

blocks.en: Mild diagnostic ambiguity, a single complicating factor (one comorbidity, one prior treatment failure, or mild patient defensiveness), and occasional passive safety concerns.
blocks.zh: 微弱诊断模棱两可,一个单一的复杂因素(一个协和症,一个前期治疗失败,或者病人的轻度防御),以及偶尔被动的安全顾虑.

blocks.en: Significant diagnostic complexity (atypical presentations, medical mimics, or multiple comorbidities), pharmacological constraints (treatment resistance, drug-drug interactions, or relative contraindications), and moderate alliance ruptures (hostility upon inquiry, clinician competence challenges, or controlled substance demands). Active safety concerns (crisis presentations with vague plan, NSSI disclosure, intimate partner violence) are present in approximately 75% of hard scenarios.
blocks.zh: 重大诊断复杂性(非典型的介绍、医疗模仿或多种症状)、药理限制(治疗阻力、药物相互作用或相对禁忌)和中度联盟破裂(询问后出现敌意、临床医生能力挑战或受管制药物需求)。 75%的硬情景中都存在主动的安全关切(危机介绍计划模糊、NSSI披露、亲密伴侣暴力)。

blocks.en: The most clinically demanding tier: obscure somatic mimics or metabolic traps, severe polypharmacy with absolute prescribing contraindications, severe alliance ruptures (total denial of illness, deep system mistrust, paranoid medication resistance), and high-severity hidden safety crises requiring emergency intervention. These are cases that would challenge even experienced attending psychiatrists.
blocks.zh: 临床要求最高的层次:模糊的口腔模仿或代谢陷阱、严重的多药性与绝对处方禁药、严重的联盟破裂(完全否认疾病、深层系统不信任、偏执药物阻力)以及高度严重隐蔽的安全危机,需要紧急干预。 这些案例甚至会挑战有经验的精神病医生。

blocks.en: C.1.8 Cultural Formulation and Equity Architecture
blocks.zh: C.1.8 文化发展和平等结构

blocks.en: Rather than treating culture as superficial demographic metadata, the scenario generation engine embeds cultural factors into patient role sheets, clinical reasoning paths, and disclosure architectures across four domains:
blocks.zh: 假设生成引擎不把文化视为表面的人口元数据,而是将文化因素嵌入病人角色表、临床推理路径和披露架构中,涉及四个领域:

blocks.en: 1. Cultural Identity of the Individual : Incorporates racial, ethnic, linguistic, and migration background, including acculturation stressors, generational discordance, and intersectional social positions. 2. Cultural Conceptualizations of Distress : Integrates culturally shaped idioms of distress and lay explanatory models. For example, somatic presentations such as susto (fright sickness) in Latin American cultural contexts, shenjing shuairuo (weakness of the nervous system) in East Asian contexts, or idioms such as “thinking too much” or “heart dropping” are modeled as legitimate lay clinical expressions rather than misclassified as primary delusional content. 3. Psychosocial Stressors and Vulnerability/Resilience : Identifies cultural features that modulate help-seeking, including community stigma regarding mental healthcare, spiritual or faith-based coping mechanisms, family or elder authority structures, and systemic healthcare mistrust. 4. Cultural Features of the Clinical Relationship : Calibrates the patient’s interpersonal posture toward the clinician, including power differentials, deference to perceived medical authority, or expectations regarding conversational pacing and formality.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 个人的文化特征:包括种族、族裔、语言和移徙背景,包括文化压力、世代不和和交叉的社会地位。 2. 危难的文化概念化:融合了文化上形成的危难特征和解释性模式。 例如,诸如拉丁美洲文化背景下的susto(恐惧症),东亚背景下的shenjing shuairuo(神经系统的疲软),或诸如“思考过多”或“心跳下降”之类的平庸语,都是合法的临床表达方式,而不是被误称为主要的妄想内容。 3. 心理社会压力和脆弱性/复原力:确定能够调节寻求帮助的文化特征,包括社区在精神保健、精神或信仰应对机制、家庭或老年人权威结构方面的耻辱,以及系统性的保健不信任。 4. 临床关系的文化特征:调整病人对临床医生的人际姿态,包括权力差异、尊重所认为的医疗权威或对对话时间和形式的期望。

blocks.en: Cultural Identity of the Individual : Incorporates racial, ethnic, linguistic, and migration background, including acculturation stressors, generational discordance, and intersectional social positions.
blocks.zh: 个人的文化特征:包括种族、族裔、语言和移徙背景,包括文化压力、世代不和和交叉的社会地位。

blocks.en: Cultural Conceptualizations of Distress : Integrates culturally shaped idioms of distress and lay explanatory models. For example, somatic presentations such as susto (fright sickness) in Latin American cultural contexts, shenjing shuairuo (weakness of the nervous system) in East Asian contexts, or idioms such as “thinking too much” or “heart dropping” are modeled as legitimate lay clinical expressions rather than misclassified as primary delusional content.
blocks.zh: 危难的文化概念化:融合了由文化形成的危难特征和解释模型。 例如,诸如拉丁美洲文化背景下的susto(恐惧症),东亚背景下的shenjing shuairuo(神经系统的疲软),或诸如“思考过多”或“心跳下降”之类的平庸语,都是合法的临床表达方式,而不是被误称为主要的妄想内容。

blocks.en: Psychosocial Stressors and Vulnerability/Resilience : Identifies cultural features that modulate help-seeking, including community stigma regarding mental healthcare, spiritual or faith-based coping mechanisms, family or elder authority structures, and systemic healthcare mistrust.
blocks.zh: 心理社会压力和脆弱性/复原力:确定可调节寻求帮助的文化特征,包括社区在精神保健、精神或信仰应对机制、家庭或长者权威结构以及系统保健不信任方面的耻辱。

blocks.en: Cultural Features of the Clinical Relationship : Calibrates the patient’s interpersonal posture toward the clinician, including power differentials, deference to perceived medical authority, or expectations regarding conversational pacing and formality.
blocks.zh: 临床关系的文化特征 : 校正病人对临床医生的人际姿态, 包括力量差异、对所觉知的医疗权威的尊重、或对对话时间和形式的期望。

blocks.en: The scenario generator operationalizes these domains via a structured system prompt specifying cultural idioms of distress, explanatory models of etiology, factors affecting the therapeutic relationship (stigma, authority dynamics, religious considerations), and cultural strengths. The prompt enforces anti-stereotyping constraints: cultural factors must be woven into the patient narrative rather than isolated as metadata, and within-culture variation is mandated.
blocks.zh: 情景生成器通过一个结构化的系统来操作这些领域,即时说明危难的文化特征、病理解释模型、影响治疗关系的因素(污名、权威动态、宗教因素)和文化优势。 迅速实施反定型限制:文化因素必须被编入病人的叙述中,而不是作为元数据孤立,文化内部的变异是必须的。

blocks.en: To prevent the generation of harmful stereotypes or essentialist caricatures, three independent safeguards were enforced throughout development: • Orthogonal demographic sampling : Cultural identities were sampled independently of the diagnostic distribution, so that in expectation specific conditions (such as substance use disorders, somatic symptom disorders, or severe psychosis) were not disproportionately paired with minoritized groups. Independent sampling constrains the expected pairing but does not guarantee balance in any finite corpus, and residual imbalances were not separately audited. • Within-culture heterogeneity : System instructions explicitly mandated varied degrees of acculturation, healthcare literacy, and traditional identification within each demographic group. • Multi-round psychiatrist audit : The 54-member board-certified psychiatrist panel audited all candidate scenarios for clinical realism, demographic plausibility, and cultural fidelity as part of the 8-criterion validation rubric (Criterion 1 and Criterion 8; Appendix C.1.3 ). Reviewers were not specifically matched to the cultural backgrounds they were reviewing; evaluation was based on clinical plausibility and adherence to the anti-stereotyping criteria rather than lived cultural expertise. Scenarios exhibiting reductive stereotyping or caricature were rejected (Appendix C.1 ). We acknowledge that clinician-assessed plausibility is a necessary but insufficient proxy for authentic cultural representation, and that validation by members of the represented communities is needed before clinical deployment.
blocks.zh: 为防止产生有害的定型观念或基本主义漫画,在整个发展中实施了三项独立的保障措施: 文化特征的抽样独立于诊断分布,因此,在预期情况下,特定条件(如药物使用失调、体征失调或严重精神疾病)不会与未成年群体不成比例地配对。 独立的抽样限制了预期的配对,但不能保证任何有限实体的平衡,剩余不平衡没有单独审计。 二. 支助 文化内差异: 系统指示明确规定了每个人口群体内不同程度的通识、保健知识和传统识别。 • 多轮心理医生审计: 由54名成员组成的董事会认证的心理医生小组审计了临床现实主义、人口学可信性和文化忠诚性的所有候选情况,作为8个标准验证标码的一部分(标准1和标准8;附录C.1.3)。 审查者没有特别与其审查的文化背景相匹配;评价的依据是临床可信性和遵守反定型标准,而不是活生生的文化专门知识。 出现倒退的陈规定型或漫画的情景遭到拒绝(附录C.1)。 我们承认,临床医生评估的可信性是真正文化代表性的一个必要但不充分的代名词,在临床部署之前,需要有代表性社区的成员进行验证。

blocks.en: Orthogonal demographic sampling : Cultural identities were sampled independently of the diagnostic distribution, so that in expectation specific conditions (such as substance use disorders, somatic symptom disorders, or severe psychosis) were not disproportionately paired with minoritized groups. Independent sampling constrains the expected pairing but does not guarantee balance in any finite corpus, and residual imbalances were not separately audited.
blocks.zh: 地貌人口抽样: 文化特征的抽样独立于诊断分布,因此,在预期情况下,特定条件(如药物使用失调、体征失调或严重精神疾病)不会与未成年群体不成比例地配对。 独立的抽样限制了预期的配对,但不能保证任何有限实体的平衡,剩余不平衡没有单独审计。

blocks.zh: 文化内部的异质性:系统指示明确要求每个人口群体具有不同程度的通识、保健知识和传统识别。

Reviewers were not specifically matched to the cultural backgrounds they were reviewing; evaluation was based on clinical plausibility and adherence to the anti-stereotyping criteria rather than lived cultural expertise. Scenarios exhibiting reductive stereotyping or caricature were rejected (Appendix C.1 ). We acknowledge that clinician-assessed plausibility is a necessary but insufficient proxy for authentic cultural representation, and that validation by members of the represented communities is needed before clinical deployment.
blocks.zh: 多轮心理医生审计: 由54名成员组成的董事会认证的心理医生小组审计了临床现实主义、人口学可信性和文化忠诚性的所有候选情况,作为8个标准验证标码的一部分(标准1和标准8;附录C.1.3)。 审查者没有特别与其审查的文化背景相匹配;评价的依据是临床可信性和遵守反定型标准,而不是活生生的文化专门知识。 出现倒退的陈规定型或漫画的情景遭到拒绝(附录C.1)。 我们承认,临床医生评估的可信性是真正文化代表性的一个必要但不充分的代名词,在临床部署之前,需要有代表性社区的成员进行验证。

blocks.en: C.2 Simulated Psychiatric Intake Evaluation: Full Scoring Results
blocks.zh: C.2 模拟精神病 收受评价:全面衡量结果

blocks.en: The simulation-trained agent (Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite + Simulation RL) and its base model (Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite 51 ) were both evaluated across the 127 simulated psychiatric intake scenarios under an identical protocol and system prompt, enabling a direct comparison of the effect of simulation training.
blocks.zh: 模拟训练剂(Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite + Simulation RL)及其基模(Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite 51 )均在127个模拟精神病摄入假想中根据相同的协议和系统即时得到评价,从而能够直接比较模拟训练的效果.

blocks.en: Whereas RL training expanded the five rubric categories with granular process sub-checks and eight group-wise safety flags following Liévin et al. Super (Methods, Section 4.3 ), standalone automated evaluation scores both models identically on the standardized 28-item clinical rubric ( R clinical ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] R_{\text{clinical}}\in[0,1] ) and six consolidated binary safety/completeness flags ( F eval = max k ⁡ F k F_{\text{eval}}=\max_{k}F_{k} ). Full scoring results for the base model and simulation-trained agent are reported in two complementary views: composite reward stratified by difficulty tier under the primary Gemini 3.1 Pro evaluator (Supplementary Table 6 ), and pre-penalty clinical scores decomposed across all five rubric categories ( Management , weight w = 3 w{=}3 ; Diagnostic Appropriateness , w = 3 w{=}3 ; Alliance and Communication , w = 2 w{=}2 ; Psychiatric Assessment , w = 2 w{=}2 ; and Documentation , w = 1 w{=}1 ) alongside safety and completeness penalty flag rates (Supplementary Table 7 ).

blocks.en: An autorater from the same model family as the policy may favor that family’s response patterns 185 ; 182 . We therefore re-graded both models on all 127 scenarios with OpenAI GPT-5.6-Luna as an out-of-family autorater (Supplementary Table 8 ). The advantage held overall ( p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ) and in all four difficulty tiers (non-overlapping 95% CIs) but was smaller than under Gemini 3.1 Pro (0.443 [0.415, 0.471] vs. 0.278 [0.268, 0.289] ; difference between models 0.165 vs. 0.270). Absolute scores were also lower, consistent with stricter calibration by GPT-5.6-Luna, removal of in-family stylistic alignment with the training reward, or both.
blocks.zh: 来自同一模范家庭的自动检举人可能赞成家庭的反应模式185;182。 因此,我们在OpenAI GPT-5.6-Luna作为家庭外自动处理器的所有127种情况中重新划分了两种模型(补充表8)。 总体优势(p < 0.0001 p < 0.0001)和所有四个困难等级(不重叠95%的CI),但比双子座3.1 Pro(0.443 [0.415,0.471] vs.0.278 [0.268,0.289];型号相差0.165 vs. 0.270)要小. 绝对分数也较低,这与GPT-5.6-Luna更严格的校准一致,取消了与培训奖励或两者兼而有之的家用型式一致。

blocks.en: For the 127-scenario automated evaluation, to verify that conclusions are not an artifact of the relative domain weights ( 3 : 3 : 2 : 2 : 1 3{:}3{:}2{:}2{:}1 ), we evaluated sensitivity across alternative weighting schemes. blocks.en: To separate rater effects from patient effects, we evaluated each of the 60 OSCE scenarios s s under three settings m m : 1. Psychiatrist, human patient: blinded board-certified psychiatrists grading the clinician-patient transcripts (22-item primary specialist composite and domain subscores; Methods, Section 4.5 ); 2. Autorater, human patient: the Gemini 3.1 Pro autorater grading the same 120 transcripts (pre-penalty clinical score R clinical R_{\text{clinical}} and five rubric categories; Methods, Section 4.3 ); and 3. Autorater, simulated patient: the same autorater grading encounters with the patient simulator, averaged across four rollouts per scenario and model (240 per model; Methods, Section 4.6 ). blocks.en: Supplementary Tables 9 and 10 report category-level agreement and training effects ( d z d_{z} ) across the three settings (Methods, Section 4.7 ). On pairwise transcript preference, κ \kappa was below zero on the composite ( − 0.14 -0.14 [ − 0.23 -0.23 , − 0.03 -0.03 ]) because both raters favored the trained model in most pairs (chance agreement 72.2%) and the 5 pairs in which the autorater preferred the base model, all near-ties ( | Δ | ≤ 0.031 |\Delta|\leq 0.031 ), did not overlap with the 14 in which the psychiatrists did. On non-tied pairs, κ \kappa was positive in all four clinical categories (0.04–0.38; all 95% CIs include zero; 1–3 shared base-preferred pairs and 8–19 ties per category). For alliance and communication, the category with the largest simulated gain (Fig. 3 b), the training effect held with clinician-patients ( d z = 0.52 d_{z}=0.52 [0.28, 0.81]), but the trained agent’s simulated scores clustered near ceiling (mean 3.75 of 5; 134 of 240 rollouts ≥ 4 \geq 4 ) and did not correlate with its human-patient scores ( ρ = 0.09 \rho=0.09 [ − 0.18 -0.18 , 0.35] within trained; − 0.05 -0.05 [ − 0.33 -0.33 , 0.24] on Δ \Delta , versus ρ = 0.62 \rho=0.62 and 0.43 0.43 for psychiatric assessment). Supplementary Fig. 1 summarizes encounter length across settings: because the base model had the same median length with both patients (8 turns) and the trained agent took fewer turns with the simulator than with clinician-patients (median 16 vs. 60), the simulator’s upward score shift ( + 0.23 +0.23 trained, + 0.10 +0.10 base) is not driven by longer transcripts, although conditioning on human-encounter length attenuated within-trained agreement across patients from ρ = 0.43 \rho=0.43 to a partial ρ = 0.27 \rho=0.27 [ − 0.01 -0.01 , 0.52] (base 0.68 0.68 to 0.65 0.65 ). Supplementary Table 11 compares both transcript-based raters with the clinician-patients’ post-encounter communication ratings ( ρ = 0.48 \rho=0.48 – 0.55 0.55 for the autorater and 0.37 0.37 – 0.50 0.50 for the evaluating psychiatrists across encounters). In sensitivity checks, re-grading the raw human-patient transcript exports after normalizing speaker labels to the simulation format only marginally changed autorater scores ( ρ = 0.98 \rho=0.98 across encounters, 0.92 0.92 on Δ \Delta ), and excluding the one pair with a discordant scenario identifier in export metadata between the OSCE tracking sheet and evaluator export kept all composite correlations within 0.05 0.05 (and category correlations within 0.06 0.06 ) of the reported values.

blocks.en: Appendix D Safety Taxonomy Development
blocks.zh: 附录D 安全分类学的发展

blocks.en: We define taxonomies of safety-challenging patient behaviors for conversational AI, encompassing both mental health and general ambulatory care settings. These taxonomies were developed through structured elicitations with practicing clinicians and modified Delphi consensus.
blocks.zh: 我们为对话AI定义了对病人安全挑战行为的分类,包括心理健康和一般流动护理环境。 这些分类是通过与执业的临床医生进行结构化的引领并修改了德尔菲共识而形成的.

blocks.en: D.1 Clinical Safety Taxonomy for Ambulatory Care
blocks.zh: D.1 门诊护理临床安全分类

blocks.en: The clinical safety taxonomy classifies real-world patient communicative behaviors that create safety risks when large language models serve as clinicians in ambulatory text-based encounters. It addresses clinically motivated patient behaviors and deliberate system exploitation. It excludes system failures independent of patient behavior (e.g., confabulation, privacy) and risks requiring physical infrastructure. This taxonomy structures adversarial training and evaluation by defining the training scenario space and providing a classification scheme for post-hoc failure coding.
blocks.zh: 临床安全分类法将现实世界患者的交流行为分类,当大型语言模型在流动文本相遇中担任临床医生时,这些沟通行为会产生安全风险. 它处理临床上的病人行为和蓄意的系统开发。 它排除了独立于患者行为(如相容,隐私)的系统故障和需要物理基础设施的风险. 这种分类结构通过定义培训场景空间和为后热故障编码提供分类计划来进行对抗性训练和评价.

blocks.en: We derived the taxonomy through a structured synthesis of five patient safety frameworks, validated by modified Delphi consensus (Table 1 a; Supplementary Table 12 ). We extracted event types from the WHO ICPS 189 , AHRQ Common Formats 1 , the IOM medical error classification 82 , the DEER diagnostic error taxonomy 150 , and the Joint Commission Patient Safety Event Taxonomy 18 , with concordance confirmed by existing analyses 147 . We supplemented these with the cognitive error literature on anchoring and premature closure 28 ; 29 ; 55 ; patient communication and health disparities literature 85 ; 125 ; 44 ; 9 ; 91 ; 12 ; therapeutic alliance ruptures 204 ; and the adversarial machine learning literature on manipulation attacks against deployed language models 133 ; 205 ; 56 .
blocks.zh: 我们通过五个病人安全框架的结构化综合得出分类法,经过修改后的德尔菲共识(表1a;补充表12)验证。 我们从卫生组织的ICPS 189、AHRQ 通用格式1、IOM 医疗错误分类 82、DEER诊断错误分类 150和联合委员会的病人安全事件分类 18中提取了事件类型,现有分析 147 证实了一致性。 我们用关于锚定和过早关闭的认知错误文献补充了这些文献:28;29;55;病人交流和健康差异文献:85;125;44;9;91;12;治疗联盟破裂204;关于操纵攻击部署语言模型的对抗机器学习文献:133;205;56。

blocks.en: Supplementary Table 12: Clinical safety taxonomy for conversational AI in ambulatory care (verbatim Round-2 Delphi definitions). Full operational definitions for the 21 risks spanning six domains summarized in Table 1 a, validated by two-round modified Delphi consensus ( N = 16 N=16 clinicians in Round 1, N = 13 N=13 in Round 2; S-CVI/Ave = 0.96 =0.96 ).
