blocks.en: We filtered candidate risks for relevance to text-based clinical encounters and submitted them to a modified Delphi panel of N N = 16 clinicians (median experience 11.5 years, IQR 8.5–14.5; five primary institutional groups; panelists were subsequently invited as co-authors for their substantive contributions to taxonomy design and were not involved in model training, standardized-patient role-play, or blinded OSCE transcript grading). The panel represented primary care, emergency medicine, surgery, psychiatry, informatics, and patient safety, ensuring each risk domain was evaluated by clinicians with direct experience. AI experts assessed system exploitation technical feasibility. In Round 1, panelists rated relevance, operational clarity, and distinctiveness (1–5 Likert). Round 1 achieved adequate content validity (S-CVI/Ave = 0.89 on relevance). Applying pre-specified decision rules for these criteria triggered six mergers, four clarity revisions, and the addition of two new items: stigma-driven non-disclosure and goals-of-care misalignment.
blocks.zh: 我们过滤了与基于文本的临床接触相关的候选风险,并将这些风险提交给了经修改的Delphi小组,该小组由N=16名临床医生组成(中期经验11.5年,IQR 8.5-14.5;五个初级机构小组;随后邀请小组成员作为共同作者,因为他们对分类学设计作出了实质性贡献,没有参与示范培训、标准化-住院角色扮演或盲目欧安组织记录分级)。 小组代表初级保健、急诊、外科、精神病学、信息学和病人安全,确保每个风险领域都得到有直接经验的临床医生的评估。 大赦国际专家评估了系统开发技术可行性。 在第一回合中,小组成员评定相关性、操作清晰度和独特性(1至5 Ikrt)。 第1轮取得了足够的内容有效性(S-CVI/Ave=0.89 关于相关性)。 对这些标准适用预先确定的决定规则,引发了6起合并、4起明确性修订和增加两个新项目:羞辱驱动的不披露和护理目标不当。

blocks.en: We revised operational definitions to remove assumed patient intent, specify annotator ground truth, and ensure medical accuracy. The original scope and referral boundaries domain was absorbed into Domain 3. The final taxonomy spans six domains and 21 risks (Table 1 a; Supplementary Table 12 ). Domains 1–4 address clinical safety risks from patient communicative behavior, ranging from unintentional information gaps to deliberate fabrication. Domain 5 covers adversarial system exploitation, included because deployed clinical AI users already attempt prompt injection to obtain inappropriate prescriptions and bypass guardrails 56 . Domain 6 addresses autonomy and safety-netting.
blocks.zh: 我们修改了操作定义,删除了假定的病人意图,明确了注释员的地面真相,确保了医疗准确性. 原范围和查询边界域被吸收为域3. 最后分类涵盖六个领域和21个风险(表1a;补充表12)。 领域1–4处理患者沟通行为造成的临床安全风险,从无意的信息空白到故意捏造. 5号领域包括对抗性系统开发,因为部署的临床AI用户已经试图迅速注射以获得不适当的处方和绕行护栏 56. 领域6涉及自主和安全网。

blocks.en: In Round 2, panelists re-rated all 21 risks after reviewing Round 1 statistics and a summary of revisions. Round 2 achieved S-CVI/Ave = 0.96 ( N N = 13; 81% retention). All items achieved ≥ \geq 80% consensus on relevance (I-CVI range: 0.85–1.00), triggering no decision rules. Operational definitions were further refined based on Round 2 feedback to improve precision, clarify examples, reduce leading language, and explicitly reference observable behavior rather than inferred patient intent.
blocks.zh: 在第2轮,小组成员在审查了第1轮统计数据和订正摘要之后,重新评价了所有21个风险。 第2轮实现S-CVI/Ave=0.96(N N=13;81%保留). 所有项目都就相关性达成了80%的共识(I-CVI范围:0.85-1.00),没有触发任何决定规则。 根据第2轮反馈进一步完善了业务定义,以提高精确度,澄清实例,减少领先语言,并明确提及可观察到的行为而不是推断出病人的意图。

blocks.en: D.2 Mental Health Relational Competency Framework
blocks.zh: D.2 心理健康关系能力框架

blocks.en: Unlike psychiatric diagnosis, the relational competencies required for conversational psychiatric AI lack formal operational definitions. We addressed this gap through a modified Delphi process that produced a validated competency framework for scenario design and evaluation.
blocks.zh: 与精神病诊断不同,对话性精神病AI所需要的关系能力缺乏正式的业务定义. 我们通过经过修改的德尔菲程序解决了这一差距,该程序产生了一个经过验证的情景设计和评价能力框架。

blocks.en: Supplementary Table 13: Relational competency framework for mental health AI (verbatim Round-2 Delphi definitions). Full presenting-dynamic definitions for the 18 competencies across five domains summarized in Table 1 b, developed through two-round modified Delphi consensus ( N = 14 N=14 experts across 8 institutions in Round 1, N = 11 N=11 in Round 2; all I-CVI ≥ 0.80 \geq 0.80 ).
blocks.zh: 补充表13:心理健康能力框架 AI(verbatim Round-2 Delphi定义)。 表1b概述的五个领域的18个能力的全面动态定义,通过经过两轮修改的德尔菲共识(第1轮N=14个N=14个专家,第2轮N=11个N=11个;所有I-CVI 0.80\geq 0.80)制定。

blocks.en: Expert consensus process
blocks.zh: 专家共识进程

blocks.en: We developed 20 initial candidate competencies across four domains by reviewing the therapeutic harm literature 102 ; 130 ; 145 , AI incidents, and clinical frameworks 139 ; 190 ; 3 . Each competency was defined as the ability to navigate a specific relational dynamic in mental health conversations.
blocks.zh: 我们通过审查治疗伤害文献102、130、145、AI事件和临床框架139、190、3,在四个领域建立了20个初步候选能力。 每种能力被定义为在心理健康对话中导航特定关系动态的能力。

blocks.en: A 14-member expert panel (mean experience 14.3 years, eight primary institutions; subsequently invited as co-authors for their taxonomy contributions) evaluated these competencies in a two-round modified Delphi survey. In Round 1, experts rated each competency on relevance, clarity, and distinctiveness. Twelve competencies reached consensus. Based on expert feedback, we removed two items, merged two, revised eight, and added five new competencies (introducing a fifth scope management domain). This yielded a 22-competency framework for Round 2, completed by 11 experts. Eighteen competencies reached consensus (all achieving item-level content validity index [I-CVI] ≥ 0.80 \geq 0.80 ), and four were removed. Table 1 b and Supplementary Table 13 present the final 18-competency framework. Within clinician-supervised pre-visit intake workflows (Section 4.4 ), Competency 5a ( Scope boundary maintenance ) operationalizes the distinction between declining patient demands for autonomous prescribing, clearance documentation, or ongoing psychotherapy in dialogue while routing provisional diagnostic and management formulations exclusively to the clinician-facing review channel.
blocks.zh: 一个由14人组成的专家小组(平均经历14.3年,8个初级机构;后来应邀作为其分类贡献的共同作者)在经过两轮修改的德尔菲调查中评价了这些能力。 在第1轮,专家们在相关性、清晰度和独特性方面对每项能力进行评分。 12项能力达成共识。 根据专家的反馈,我们删除了两个项目,合并了两个,修订了八个,并增加了五个新的权限(引入了第五个范围管理领域). 这产生了由11名专家完成的第二轮22个能力框架。 18个权限达成共识(全部实现项目级内容有效性指数[一-CVI] ^ 0.80\geq 0.80),并删除了4个权限. 表1b和补充表13列出了最后的18个能力框架。 在临床医生监督的接待前工作流程(第4.4节)内,能力5a (范围边界维护)将病人对自主开处方、批准文件或对话中持续心理治疗的要求下降与将临时诊断和管理配方完全用于临床医生-诊疗审查渠道之间的区别付诸实施。

blocks.en: Appendix E Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录E 相关工作

blocks.en: Medical artificial intelligence has progressed from rule-based systems to deep learning classifiers, foundation models, and interactive agentic systems. Here, we apply multi-turn reinforcement learning to psychiatric intake by training a clinical AI agent within a simulated environment to jointly optimize diagnostic reasoning and patient-centered communication.
blocks.zh: 医学人工智能已经从基于规则的系统发展到深层学习分类器,基础模型,以及交互式的代理系统. 在此,我们通过在模拟环境中培训临床AI剂,将多回合强化学习应用到精神病的摄取中,共同优化诊断推理和以病人为中心的交流.

blocks.en: Early clinical AI systems used handcrafted rule bases and probabilistic inference for diagnostic decision-making, such as MYCIN 158 , whereas deep learning later enabled high-accuracy, single-task diagnostic classifiers for specialized modalities 36 ; 174 ; 143 . Multimodal foundation models subsequently demonstrated broad clinical reasoning 162 ; 163 ; 113 , achieving strong performance on medical question-answering benchmarks including MedQA-USMLE 74 , MedMCQA 126 , and MMLU clinical subdomains 66 . Advanced prompting and multi-agent collaborative frameworks such as MedAgents 172 enable generalist models to match specialized systems 120 , while retrieval-augmentation and external tools extend real-time knowledge access 200 ; 105 and single-turn RL models improve diagnostic accuracy on verifiable cases 89 . Because these advances remain confined to static single-turn settings, early conversational clinical models 97 ; 60 ; 181 sought to establish interactive dialogue, though without rigorous multi-turn clinical evaluation.
blocks.zh: 早期临床 AI系统在诊断决策中使用了手制规则基础和概率推论,如MYCIN 158,而深层学习后来使专业方式36的高精度单任务诊断分类器得以进行;174;143. 多式联运基础模型后来展示了广泛的临床推理162;163;113,在医疗问答基准上取得了良好的表现,包括MedQA-USMLE 74,MedMCQA 126和MMLU临床分域. 66. MedAgents 172等高级激励和多代理协作框架使通论模型能够匹配专门系统120,而检索-增强和外部工具则扩展实时知识获取能力200;105和单回合RL模型提高了可核查病例的诊断准确性 89 (英语). 由于这些进步仍然局限于静态的单回合设置,早期的谈话临床模型97;60;181试图建立交互式的对话,虽然没有严格的多回合临床评价.

blocks.en: AMIE 176 represented a milestone, showing that self-play supervised fine-tuning and blinded OSCE-style evaluations produce a system matching primary care physicians on history-taking, communication, and diagnostic accuracy. Subsequent advances expanded this paradigm to complex differential diagnosis 109 , multimodal specialist care 124 , consumer symptom elicitation 13 , and prospective clinical deployment 15 . However, these systems focused on general medical consultations rather than optimizing across the sequential decision chains under diagnostic uncertainty and rapport-dependent disclosure that characterize psychiatric encounters.
blocks.zh: AMIE 176是一个里程碑,显示自我游戏监督的微调和蒙蔽了欧安组织式的评价产生了一个系统,与初级保健医生在历史记录、交流和诊断准确性方面的匹配。 随后的进展将这一模式扩大到复杂的差异诊断109、多模式专家护理124、消费者症状13和未来的临床部署15。 然而,这些制度侧重于一般医疗咨询,而不是在诊断不确定性和依赖关系披露的情况下,优化连续决策链,这是精神病患者遭遇的特点。

blocks.en: Medical decision analysis frames sequential decision-making under uncertainty through Partially Observable Markov Decision Processes (POMDPs) 63 ; 186 . Historically, healthcare reinforcement learning focused on retrospective offline RL to optimize low-dimensional treatments from EHR records, including sepsis and hemodynamic control 83 ; 142 ; 132 (reviewed in Yu et al. Super ; Coronato et al. Super ), whereas language model preference alignment originated with single-step reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) 21 ; 153 ; 123 ; 6 and direct preference optimization (DPO) 141 .
blocks.zh: 医疗决策分析通过部分可观察的马尔可夫决定程序(POMDPs)63 确定在不确定的情况下依次作出决定的框架;186 . 从历史上看,保健强化学习的重点是追溯下线RL,以优化EHR记录中的低维治疗,包括败血症和出血动力控制83;142;132 (由于等审查. Super; Coronato等. Super.),而语言模型偏好对接则起源于从人类反馈(RLHF)21中进行单步强化学习;153;123;6和直接偏好优化(DPO)141.

blocks.en: Zhang et al. Super distinguish single-step alignment from multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning , which optimizes policies over temporally extended POMDP trajectories alongside process-supervised step-level reward modeling 101 and text-based feedback 198 . Paired with simulators, this approach yields emergent capabilities in competitive games 160 ; 179 , mathematical reasoning via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 155 , and autonomous LLM agents 193 . Clinical consultations naturally fit this formulation because the patient’s psychiatric state remains latent, information emerges sequentially through targeted inquiry, and optimal management depends on prior conversational decisions.
blocks.zh: 张等. Super区分了单步对接与多回合代理加固学习 . 这种方法具有模拟器,在竞技游戏中产生突发能力 160;179,通过Group相对政策优化(GRPO) 155 和自主LLM代理 193 (英语). 临床咨询自然适合这种配方,因为患者的精神状态仍然潜在,信息通过定向调查依次出现,最佳管理取决于事先的对话决定。

blocks.en: Concurrent systems have begun applying dialogue RL to clinical interaction beyond T = 1 T{=}1 : Doctor-R1 88 uses experience replay to ground updates in successful trajectories, DoctorAgent-RL 41 validates proactive questioning with patients, DiagAgent 140 trains agents within an EHR-grounded world model, SALUS 48 applies per-step GRPO with multi-agent role decomposition, and Multi-Agent CFlow 184 mitigates premature diagnostic closure using hierarchical action spaces. However, these systems focus on general medical dialogue loops or structured diagnostic ordering rather than psychiatric presentations and rapport-gated communication. Our simulation framework jointly optimizes multi-turn inquiry, clinical documentation, management planning, and patient-centered communication within a long-horizon RL environment.
blocks.zh: 同时期系统开始将对话RL应用到T=1 TQQ1以外的临床交互:博士-R1 88使用经验回放在成功的轨迹中进行地面更新,博士-RL 41验证主动询问患者,DiagAgent140列车代理在EHR基站世界模型内,SALUS 48应用了多代理角色分解的每步GRPO,多代理CFlow184利用分级行动空间来缓解过早诊断关闭. 然而,这些系统侧重于一般的医学对话循环或结构化的诊断订单,而不是精神陈述和亲和的交流。 我们的模拟框架共同优化了多回合调查,临床文献,管理规划,以及长视RL环境中以病人为中心的沟通.

blocks.en: Mental healthcare AI spans early conversational systems, rule-based interventions, language biomarkers, and foundation model agents. Early work highlighted safety vulnerabilities when conversational agents encountered crises 112 , while structured digital interventions demonstrated clinical impact: Woebot reduced depressive symptoms in a randomized trial 43 , and Limbic Access increased referral completion by 15% among 129,400 UK NHS patients 59 . Human-AI collaboration has also shown benefit, with AI suggestions improving counselor empathy by 19.6% on crisis hotlines 156 and public evaluations rating LLM responses higher in quality and empathy than physician responses 5 . Scoping and systematic reviews map generative AI applications across behavioral healthcare 70 ; 116 ; 57 , position papers outline responsible deployment frameworks 166 ; 175 ; 31 , and recent meta-analyses quantify the clinical evidence base for LLM chatbots 202 ; 34 .
blocks.zh: 精神保健AI涵盖早期对话系统、基于规则的干预、语言生物标志和基础模型代理。 早期工作凸显出对话代理人遇到危机时的安全弱点, Woebot在随机试验中减轻了抑郁症状43,Limbic Access在129,400名英国NHS患者中增加了15%的转诊完成率59。 人与AI的合作也显示出了好处,AI的建议在危机热线上提高了咨询员的同情心,提高了19.6%。 公共评价认为LLM反应的质量和同情度高于医生的反应。 5 (英语). 范围界定和系统审查绘制了跨行为保健的基因AI应用图 70;116;57,立场文件概述了负责任的部署框架 166;175;31,以及最近的元分析量化了LLM聊天机器人的临床证据基础 202;34。

blocks.en: Fine-tuned foundation-model agents represent a further shift: Therabot reduced depression and anxiety in a randomized trial 65 , and a three-arm RCT found a conversational AI agent non-inferior to face-to-face group therapy for depression and superior for anxiety reduction 159 . Specialized models include MentaLLaMA 195 for social media depression detection, SoulChat 19 and MindChat 157 for emotional support, AutoCBT 194 for autonomous Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, PsycoLLM 69 for psychological evaluation, and PsychAgent 196 for evolving therapeutic skills via rejection fine-tuning. In clinician-facing settings, PsychFound 183 and Kim and Rodriguez Super demonstrated decision-support utility, while multi-agent architectures have been applied to structured clinical interviewing 79 , psychotherapy fidelity assessment 78 , and psychiatry residency training 146 .
blocks.zh: 精细的基建模型代理代表了又一转变:Therabot在随机试验65中减轻了抑郁和焦虑,一个三臂的RCT发现一个对话AI代理非易怒性用于抑郁症的面对面小组治疗,而优于焦虑减轻159. 专业模式包括:社交媒体抑郁症检测的MentallaMA 195,情感支持的SoulChat 19和MindChat 157,自主认知行为治疗的AutoCBT 194,心理评估的PsycoLLM 69,以及通过拒绝微调进行进化治疗技能的PsyAgent 196. 在临床医生面前的环境下,心理治疗基金183、Kim和Rodriguez Super展现了决策支持的效用,而多代理架构则被应用于有条理的临床面试79、心理治疗忠贞评估78以及精神病住院培训146。

blocks.en: In parallel, computational language and speech processing has yielded objective digital biomarkers predicting psychosis onset 23 . Existing mental health AI systems largely operate as single-turn classifiers, open-ended support chatbots, or offline prediction tools, rather than training a clinical agent via reinforcement learning to execute complete psychiatric intake encounters that integrate diagnostic investigation with structured, patient-centered communication.
blocks.zh: 与此同时,计算语言和语音处理产生了客观的数字生物标志,预测精神疾病发作。 现有的心理健康AI系统主要作为单回合分级器,开放式支持聊天器,或离线预测工具运行,而不是通过强化学习来训练临床代理人执行完整的精神病摄入相会,将诊断调查与结构化的以病人为中心的通信相结合.

blocks.en: Simulation fidelity sets the upper bound for agent competence training in medical education 7 ; 22 . Building on generative multi-agent simulations 129 and early clinical dialogue ontologies 38 , recent platforms introduce multi-agent virtual hospitals 95 , persona-driven profiles 86 , temperament-conditioned consultations 171 , state-aware simulators 98 , generative patient state evolution 115 , and dynamic clinical environment evaluation 106 . Agentic evaluation suites also assess tool use in provider-facing EHR workflows (MedAgentBench 73 , FHIR-AgentBench 93 ), clinical data modeling (HealthAgentBench 103 ), and patient-facing primary care workflows across multi-turn exchanges (PatientAgentBench 178 ).
blocks.zh: 模拟忠诚为医学教育中的代理能力培训设定了上限 ; ; 22. 以基因多剂模拟129和早期临床对话本体学38为基础,近期平台推出多剂虚拟医院95所,由人驱动剖析86所,有温和条件的诊疗171所,有状态意识的模拟器98所,基因患者状态演化115所,动态临床环境评价. 106 (英语). 代理评价套件还评估提供方-提供方EHR工作流程(MedAgent Bench 73,FHIR-Agent Bench 93),临床数据模型(HealthAgent Bench 103),以及跨多回合交流的病人-提供方初级护理工作流程(PatientAgent Bench 178)中使用的工具.

blocks.en: Existing patient simulators predominantly function as cooperative environments where simulated patients willingly disclose clinical information upon request. In actual psychiatric practice, patients frequently withhold history, minimize symptoms, and resist treatment recommendations 10 ; 39 ; 25 . Our simulation environment addresses this gap with a stratified information disclosure architecture in which critical clinical facts remain gated behind specific behavioral triggers, including direct targeted inquiry, empathic rapport, and sustained trust.
blocks.zh: 现有病人模拟器主要作为合作环境发挥作用,模拟病人可应要求自愿披露临床信息。 在实际的精神病治疗中,患者经常隐瞒病史,将症状最小化,并抵制治疗建议10;39;25。 我们的模拟环境通过分层的信息披露架构来解决这一缺口,在这种架构中,关键临床事实仍然被特定行为触发因素所掩盖,包括直接有针对性的调查、同情关系和持续信任。

blocks.en: PsychBench 104 established an evaluation framework for LLMs in psychiatric practice across 16 models with a 60-psychiatrist reader study, while PsychiatryBench 46 extends evaluation across multiple tasks, MindBench.ai 35 engages clinicians, researchers, and individuals with lived experience, and PsychEval 128 introduces a multi-session evaluation spanning 369 cases across five therapeutic modalities. MindEval 138 tests models on extended 20–40 turn mental health dialogues, MENTAT 90 provides a clinician-annotated dataset of real-world tasks and ambiguity, MedDialogRubrics 54 develops fine-grained clinician rubrics for multi-turn consultations, and ALFA 96 aligns models for targeted questioning during diagnostic reasoning, complementing interactive general-medical benchmarks such as CRAFT-MD 77 and AgentClinic 152 as well as static single-turn benchmarks such as MedQA 74 , MedMCQA 126 , and PubMedQA 76 .
blocks.zh: Physic Bench 104在16个模型中建立了精神医学实践LLMs的评价框架,并进行了60名精神病学家的阅读者研究,而Phychotic Bench 46将评价延伸至多个任务,Mind Bench.ai 35将临床医生、研究人员和有活经验的个人纳入其中,PhychoEval 128则引入了涵盖369个病例的多会评价,涉及5种治疗方式。 MindEval 138测试模式在延长的20-40转心理健康对话中,MENTAT 90提供了一个临床医生附加说明的关于现实世界任务和模糊性的数据集,MedDialogRubrics 54开发了精细的临床医生名词来进行多回合咨询,ALFA 96在诊断推理中将定向询问的模式相配合,补充了互动的通用医疗基准,如CRAFT-MD 77和AgentClinic 152,以及静态的单回合基准,如MedQA 74、MedMCQA 126和PubMedQA 76。

blocks.en: Whereas existing frameworks primarily assess static medical knowledge, single-dimension conversational fluency, or isolated diagnostic accuracy 8 ; 75 , psychiatric intake requires establishing trust to elicit gated information, reasoning under diagnostic ambiguity, and formulating management plans aligned with the patient’s relational context. Our simulated intake evaluation provides 127 expert-curated scenarios with stratified disclosure requirements to assess whether an agent can elicit information from guarded patients and formulate safe, appropriate care plans.
blocks.zh: 现有框架主要评估静态医学知识、单向对话流利性或孤立诊断准确性8;75,接受精神病治疗需要建立信任,以获取门面信息,在诊断模棱两可的情况下进行推理,以及制定符合患者关系背景的管理计划。 我们的模拟摄入评价为127个经专家验证的假想提供了分级披露要求,以评估制剂是否能够从受看管的病人那里获得信息并制订安全、适当的护理计划。

blocks.en: Deploying AI in psychiatry presents distinct safety risks, illustrated by documented adverse events such as a chatbot providing calorie-counting advice to eating disorder patients 187 , over-validation of distorted client thoughts 72 , stigmatizing responses 114 , unsafe medical guidance 33 , and omission of crisis resources such as the 988 lifeline during emergencies 178 . Frameworks for responsible healthcare machine learning emphasize avoiding clinical harm 188 and verifying factual grounding 192 , while equity audits highlight algorithmic disparities in clinical risk prediction 122 and clinical vignettes 199 , motivating health-equity evaluation toolboxes 135 and intersectional analyses 27 . Adversarial red-teaming methodologies for general LLMs 133 have recently been extended to mental health support 167 , where regulatory frameworks such as the EU AI Act classify systems interacting with vulnerable populations as high-risk 164 .
blocks.zh: 在精神病学中应用AI具有明显的安全风险,有记录的不良事件说明了这一点,例如一个聊天机向失常患者提供卡路里计数建议 187,对扭曲客户思想的过度验证 72,污名化反应 114,不安全的医学指导 33,以及在紧急情况下忽略988条生命线等危机资源. 178 (英语). 负责任的保健机学习框架强调避免临床伤害188并核实事实依据192,而公平审计则强调临床风险预测122和临床图199中的算法差异,激励健康-公平评价工具箱135和交叉分析 27 (英语). 最近,第133号普通课程的横向红队方法被推广到心理健康支助167,其中《欧盟AI法》等监管框架将与弱势人群互动的系统归类为高风险164。

blocks.en: Our evaluation framework incorporates adversarial safety testing through a dual-taxonomy design (clinical safety and mental health relational competence) validated via independent modified Delphi consensus, providing a structured methodology for detecting clinical safety vulnerabilities under deceptive, manipulative, and boundary-testing patient presentations.
blocks.zh: 我们的评价框架通过经独立修改的德尔菲共识验证的双重分类设计(临床安全和精神健康关系能力),纳入了对抗性安全测试,为在欺骗、操纵和边界测试病人的介绍下发现临床安全弱点提供了一个结构化方法。
